English: TSC reminds parents in Kiambu County that bursary allocation registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) nigo gikobasoka abamama na ababa ase Kiambu County ing'a ogokwandika amakobeso abasomi nigo gwatigwete ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: ODPP opens the electoral calendar centres in Nyamira County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Oborire: ODPP okoigora amasomo yobochori yense yokaunti ya Nyamira engoromomi.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Embu County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii gazeti yakenyere amamenyi ba Embu bono gosoka ase okomoaregania omonene bw'ID giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge.

English: Notice: KNEC announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KNEC nigo yanyorete amang'ana igoro yechingaki chio goikora abana ase obokonyi bwebursary ase amasomo ari Mombasa County.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Tharaka-Nithi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Ebiro ebi: Minisitiri ya Ekero - Ekero ya Oborwaire ekorwa ebiateko oborwaire ase Tharaka-Nithi. Abamenyi baborigwe koba enkoromba chie'chiumbu chibekire eriogo koba ogw'echi.

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Kakamega County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gietenererete giechibango kiaboririe abamenyi bekaunti ya kakamega baria entongori bogoria ID yageni na yageni yia omoroberio bwechinyomba chierigori rianse.

English: The Ministry of Education equipped 10 TVET institutions with modern labs under the AfDB TVET Phase II project to enhance training quality.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu iliandaa taasisi 10 za TVET na maabara ya kisasa chini ya mradi wa Awamu ya Pili ya AfDB TVET ili kuboresha ubora wa mafunzo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi ekabeka  chikorechi 10 chiobobundi nochusi (TVET) ebinto biegesayansi  bia bono goetera AfDB ase omoroberio II o'TVET gokinia oboikeranu bwokwegeria.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Nyandarua County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: KTDA eragabie chimbeyo chie obori ebiitirwe ase abanyamwaka aaria Nyandarua County ase omotienyi 10.

English: The Commission calls upon business owners to stay alert to during the election period.
Kiswahili: Tume inatoa wito kwa wamiliki wa biashara kuwa macho wakati wa uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiarure okoboria gochia ase abaonchoreria koba maiso chingaki chiobochori.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Nyamira County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri yarure ogokurera abamenyi a Nyamira County koerikia obokoreri yarure ogokurera ase okobwatanigwa abanto, nayasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia egonde policing (Nyumba Kumi) obokoreri.

English: COMESA promotes terracing among farmers in Kirinyaga County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: COMESA inakuza ustahimilivu miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egokonya abaremi gokora amaterasi ase Kirinyaga County buna egechande kio ogokonya oboremi gokora buya ase omotienyi 2.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Isiolo County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Komishoni ya Abarimu berekera egonde a Isiolo yekaunti sira amagancha a bionsi ase gacha esekoli eke.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Garissa County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure ogokurera ase okobwatanigwa abamenyi ko Garissa goetera chinchera chiancheire na yaboririe abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kabwatanigwa.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of dairy cows in Wajir County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Ekegusii: Omonya: FAO nigo erachire okogenda kwa chingombe chie chiri ase Wajir County nigo kwarete oborwa bwe chimbwa.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Nabambo: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiama bia siasa yatekaine korwa aserikari yekaonti yekwale yatekaine emekutano yebirengererio bia abanto koba goikera amang'ana igoro yebirengererio bia abanto.

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Chokoro: EACC okoigora ekeyia yobokano yao aase ogotemera chingaki chiomobasekano aaria Laikipia.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera egonde a Murang'a gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egokwibokia abanto banto ng'a obokonyi bwo gochera obokoreri bwo goitigwa nigo bori bwo bwerere goetera ebitaseni biao obochari bwa Turkana County.

English: Learners sitting for Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) and Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) will now be required to shade their answers using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofanya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KPSEA) na Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Wadogo ya Kenya (KJSEA) sasa watahitajika kuficha majibu yao kwa kutumia karatasi za Utambuzi wa Alama za Optical (OMR).
Ekegusii: Abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa na korengwa echikuru chiboroso (KPSEA) nabana bechisekenderi chia inse (KJSEA) bono mbagaberigwe kongororia amachibu yamatemwa abo ase risakara riria riamatemwa.

English: Support distance learning 2024.
Kiswahili: Saidia kujifunza kwa umbali 2024.
Ekegusii: Segeta amasomo goetera eintaneti omwaka 2024.

English: TSC reminds parents in Busia County that adult literacy classes registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: TSC nigo egokora omobuko ase abaibori ba Busia County ng'a ogosara kwamasomo abakure nigo kwigorete ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a trauma counselling forum in Garissa County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Garissa Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia abachiri ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo kigochie koba na omoroberio wogoteba na abanto baria barwete ase ekaunti ya Garissa ime ya omotienyi 10. Abanto bonsi nigo baranyare gocha.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Kilifi County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Ekegusii: NDMA yaboririe obamenyi ebesa yao omoroberio Kilifi County goetera chinchera chiancheire gikera ogokonya gwao gikera omoroberio ebesa yao goikera ogokonya gwao.

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Nandi County this June.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS asegeta chingi chia goikorwania obokengeka aigoro yaito ya Nandi ebuagi.

English: KNEC advises students in Homa Bay County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia miongozo ya marekebisho.
Ekegusii: KNEC yateba endorero ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay gindigwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma oigoirwe.

English: Mechanisms through which the ICIPE push-pull technology conquers the fall armyworm. ICIPE. PlantwisePlus Knowledge BankVideo Factsheet 12 September 2024.
Kiswahili: Njia ambazo teknolojia ya ICIPE ya kusukuma-kuvuta inashinda minyoo ya jeshi ya kuanguka. ICIPE. PlantwisePlus Knowledge BankKaratasi ya Ukweli ya Video 12 Septemba 2024.
Ekegusii: Ebitambokero goetera ebio ICIPE bigosegeta etekinorochia mbire nobobui goita amakonde buna chingeti. ICIPE. PlantwisePlus Knowledge BankVideo Factsheet 12 September 2024.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Wajir County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragire abaremi ba Wajir County konyora obwanchani bwa mbecha chitarerwa ase ogotera amachibu amaya ase chibage.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Trans Nzoia County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this October.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS koriaga chindagere chisukuru chia Trans Nzoia goting’igua oboikeranu bwamaagacho bwebirasi bia abana bia October.

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Ekegusii: Egesaku: KNEC okoigora ogosaba kwao chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara abe Meru County.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Nyamira County on agroforestry this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya kilimo cha misitu Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekerio: Orosagia rwa Oboremi na Chindagera (AFA) nigo rutoore abaremi ase Nyamira County igoro y'oboremi bw'emiti ase omotienyi 10.

English: IEBC reminds needy students in Garissa County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: IEBC ribaga abana baria bare nokogania bo Garissa County bona ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria egera ticha siku.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Kilifi County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NDMA atabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kilifi na gosiira gacha nia otengereza chinkwana chia oboweli.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Machakos County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross kiororete abanto ba Machakos County koripoti kera oboremo obo bakorora ase abanyamwaka b'obobwenia bwa chikaunti konyora okwongerereka kw'ebikoru bi HIV/AIDS.

English: Ministry of Energy and Education promote education on renewable energy technologies in schools and TVETs.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Nishati na Elimu kuhamasisha elimu juu ya teknolojia za nishati mbadala katika shule na TVETs.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechinguru chiomorero amo neyechisemi ngosegeta bare chisemi chigetekinorochia ase chinguru chiomorero bwerisase (sola)  ase chisukuru nechokorechi chiobobundi nechisemi chikwegendereria( TVETs).

English: Notice: OGP launches ward-level service delivery in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Ogochika: OGP ase okonya ase okobwatwa kwabakagerwa abwo abarendi boborendi bwenyoro ase ekaonti ya Narok.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisii County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Ekegusii: DCI obasemirie abamenyi baboria choria Kisii County kwerikia buna abakorwega kwabokoreri baboria chikura chisukuru.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-Citizen katika Homa Bay County.
Ekegusii: Chinga: KRA okoigora ekeyia chingi chokorwa chenyoma yao ase ogotamera chingaki chiomobasekano ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay.

English: KEPHIS urges wheat growers in Vihiga County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawasihi wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi la kuanguka mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS ekisoma abiriria wakwa mungu wa Vihiga kuoyera amagoro hii kugindigwa madawa yeyote yeyo yamagorwa kuyera matunda akiwa mungu wa mabere.

English: Support marginalized communities 2022.
Kiswahili: Saidia jamii zilizotengwa 2022.
Ekegusii: Sira chingongo chiria chitigarete magega omwaka 2022.

English: NTSA urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: NTSA yabasemirie abamenyi ebo Trans Nzoia egikori kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kwa ebo korure korora bwango ogcha ebo egonde.

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Busia County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Busia kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Gazeti ya Kenya gosanga abamenyi abakwao ase ekaunti ya Busia gosanga ebiro ebio ekirwania chikampeini cha kusoma kuhara.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for revision guides for learners in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Ikinywe: Okoigora TVET okoigora amakora ase makorero ase abanyamigereri ase ekaunti ya Nyeri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo bwe' komiti yebiama bia siasa orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura bamenyete ime ya Elgeyo-Marakwet via SMS kwa 70000 kwa mwenyere okeani okoboria.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Baringo County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this November.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokwata abaremi ase ekaunti ya Baringo ase ogotigwa okwegerera obwongo oboyia bwokosiarera amache mogondo ase omotienyi 11.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs coffee farmers in Vihiga County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ria amabere ria Kenya (Kenya Dairy Board) rigoikoria abanyamwaka be'kawa ase Vihiga County igoro yechingira chipeya chio'kogora na goitera amagena ase omotienyi 9.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns millet farmers in Garissa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okotanga ebisira biokorima (Pest Control Products Board) nigo korigete abarima bamaembe ase Garissa County igoro yebisira biokorima na korigia okokora ekeene ase obwango.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Nandi County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bw'Oboremi na Oboreri bw'Ebitungo nigo bwoibokire abamenyi ba Nandi County buna okoborenda amabura nigo konyora oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Homa Bay County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yoborwaria - Ekitengo kio oborwaria bwobwibari nigo gokosaba abamenyi ba Homa Bay County tibakonyaka na obororo bwo obotito, na bakorane na omonyabwenge orenge ogoetwa obomanyi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Nyamira County this May.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie okogania obokorwa bwamasomo nebigosomigwa kwa esabu esia Nyamira amaumuntia, egera omwana omwana.

English: Increase access and availability of quality seeds through the accreditation of seed companies and agro-input suppliers. • Harmonise regional technology release ...
Kiswahili: Kuongeza upatikanaji na upatikanaji wa mbegu bora kupitia uidhinishaji wa makampuni ya mbegu na wauzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo. • Kuunganisha utoaji wa teknolojia ya kikanda ...
Ekegusii: Menta goikera na okonyorekana kwembusuro engiya goetera ebiombe biria biitabire ase okoonia embusuro namoyo gose amariogo oboremi na baria bakobionia angennechinka chiaito. • Bwatania tekinorochia yorogongo yarure...

English: Notice: KMTC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KMTC yararie amatuko okorendera abakure ase amasomo okosoma na okwandika ase amasomo ari Vihiga County.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa: IPOA orure ogokurerwa ase okomentekana gwa kubwate niSIM-swap ekero ekio akamenta abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Siaya.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Lamu County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: ODPP agasaba abamenyi abio amang'ana goikerania ebiro ebio goLamu goikerania esafari yamagenderero ekaonti.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Mombasa County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eribokire abanto ase Mombasa County buna oboikaro bwa chigokoro chiorore na chigokoro chiameno bwoire ase chichiro chigendererete.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NDMA b erekera abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi baborigwe gosimeka amakora omosiongoroko yebinyoro kwa abakurirwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya, kabe are nechimbebe, kwa kurekera ngoro ngoro ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Baringo County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori biokomanyia amachiko amabere nigo bigosaba abasabi ase Baringo County gochia ase ebisarori biokomanyia ebiakare ebirie hakuhi na abanto ase okwenera okwongera okomanyia.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Makueni County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (Kenya Dairy Board) nkorora kere nga abaremi bechinyama ase Makueni County bagwenerete gochia gochia amang'ana ase ofisi yobuveterinari eria eri hakuhi na abwo, nigo konyora oborendi bw'echinyama chiao.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Embu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwa Obong'aini - Egechama gia Obong'aini bw'abanto nigo korigiria abanto ba Embu County kocheka okonyua amanyoro na esukari erio gotanga oborwari obo bwo gochaka.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Isiolo County that input on development planning forums is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire neboere ase ekiboria Isiolo ime yosiria abamenyi gwesokia nakechumia obokoreri ase machokoro amagenderero omorembe na nayo apri.

English: KALRO urges poultry farmers in Taita-Taveta County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizoteuliwa kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo egosaba abaremi b'ebinyoni ase Taita-Taveta County gobeta etugo yabo chisindani ase ebirengo bi'okobetia konyora obosaa bwa rabies obwamenyeka.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nairobi County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: DPP b erekera abakorera choria kwa Nairobi County nere b erekera esimi ya okonyora GBV ya okonyora obokonyi 1195.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Siaya County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Siaya mwezi Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ndege: Ofisi ya Rijestari ya Vipartii vikoigora vinywa vya ushauri wa vinywaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya hii Etureti ya Kebaki.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Nandi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera abamenyi obo Nandi egonde kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kirendia egonde ekenene kirendia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo.

English: TSC reminds youth in Vihiga County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: TSC ekobasoka abasubati ase Vihiga County buna oboikoni bwa HELB bwoire ase okosomwa kwokorunga chinguo na okobora.

English: TVET advises students in Bomet County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia vitabu vya kiada na nyenzo za kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: TVET ogokorora endorero ase Bomet County gindigwa kwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie.

English: Effective labour management ensures productivity and worker welfare. Learn about hiring, training, and fair treatment practices.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi mzuri wa kazi huhakikisha ufanisi na ustawi wa wafanyikazi. Jifunze kuhusu kuajiri, mafunzo, na mazoea ya haki ya matibabu.
Ekegusii: Oborendi obuya bwomukazi oboikeranu ase etugo. Egera obomanyi igoro yokorisia, amorokererigua, na korema obukazi ase engencho engiya.

English: KALRO urges millet growers in Mandera County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Mandera watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO kumwoga majembe majiwo mwa milleti mu Mandera County agindigwa amoyo akiyorekereka kabla embura koyera amagoro hii

English: TSC calls on the community in Vihiga County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TSC erekera egonde e Vihiga County ekorwa chiropoti kengima konsi bire nega gacha chisukuru chonsi nende.

English: SHA reminds the public in Vihiga County that input on the county budget process is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: SHA kubororia abamenyi Vihiga kaunti erio kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari yekaunti yamang'ana igoro yogosanga nagokwanerana ni okwemwera November.

English: Stay alert! Schools, monitor for abduction risks.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho! Shule, fuatilia hatari za utekaji nyara.
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso Chisukuru, Bwatia komanya bun abana babaise koibwa korwa esukuru.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Makueni County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Echibaga cha Makueni chabana baria bare nokogania ticha ogosaba kwa endorero kwa ribaga riabeene ria chibesa chiria.

English: KMTC advises students in Kakamega County to collect materials from the county education office to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Ekegusii: KMTC okoborigwa endorero bekaunti ya kakamega kwerikia ase omoroberio ebirengo bioboikeranu kwa ofisi ya ekeombe kwa bekaunti ase okobwatia komanya buna amasomo yegedichitari agoikeranigwa.

English: The Ministry of Education announces a new initiative to equip all public secondary schools with modern science laboratories.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yararirie omoroberio omoyia koagacha chinyomba chiobosansi chiabono ase chisekenderi chionsi.

English: HELB encourages residents of Embu County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: HELB okobia abamenyi ba Embu okeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese, erio bera tebia igoroyamachiko oboronge.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Narok County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi Obomurembe - Ekitengo kio Obomurembe bwa Abakungu gokoboriga abamenyi ba Narok County gochi goikora oborogi bwa bwango ase echikuru chio obomurembe echio kiri okabere, konyora okonyara kwa amanyinga amange ayo abanto babwate amanyererio yomomero.

English: Increase harvest storage to ensure food security during droughts by preserving surplus from productive regions, reducing post-harvest losses, and enabling rapid distribution to affected areas.
Kiswahili: Ongeza uhifadhi wa mavuno ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula wakati wa ukame kwa kuhifadhi ziada kutoka kwa maeneo yenye tija, kupunguza upotezaji wa baada ya mavuno, na kuwezesha usambazaji wa haraka kwa maeneo yaliyoathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Bucha gesa ya kusoma kurena endagera kwa wakati omorakera kwa kusoma endagera ya kumara kutokana na mikakano ya kumara, kurena matumizi ya kumara ya kusoma kwa makao ya kumara.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Kisii County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eribokire abakoreri boboremi ase Kisii County igoro yomoganda ogokorwa ogwogoteba abanto buna baranyare gochora chindui na chindwanyi.

English: A report documented systemic excessive force during protests and called for prosecutions, crowd control reforms, and stronger conduct enforcement mechanisms.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ilirekodi matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kutoa wito wa mashtaka, mageuzi ya udhibiti wa umati, na mifumo imara ya utekelezaji wa mwenendo.
Ekegusii: Eripoti yarekoorokia buna abasikari bagotumia chinguru chinyinge ekero abanto bakorobererekana na ekaboria ng'a egosoerwa, amaonchorerio igoro buna abakorobererekana bakorendwa, nenchera ebwenerete kobarenda bikorwe.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Makueni County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo korigia abaremi ase Makueni County gochia ase ogotuma chimbegu chiatangirwe chitaragwata amayira mbere yechinsa chia omotienyi 9 chia ogotuma.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekomisheni y'Abakora bwechisemi (TSC) ekongie abana batari esukuru aaria Kiambu County korigisera abana babo ase esukuru ya eserekali eriri hakiri ase omoroberio bw'esukuru ya amabere ya bwerere.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Siaya County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Ekegusii: COMESA egosegeta abaremi ba Siaya County gotang'a ebisasani bia fall armyworm kare goetera chidawa chie oboremi chire n'ebiragero mbere ya omotienyi 4, omwaka.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased meningitis risk in Samburu County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Samburu na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwoborogori bwebitong'o: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oborogori bwebitong'o (SHA) kigoteba nigo kware obwango bwo oborwari bwa meningitis ase Samburu County na koriganiria abanto bonsi goika barenge goikera na amache ayo atari amaya.

English: Children face online risks. Parents should monitor use, apply controls, and teach safe behavior.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanakabiliwa na hatari mtandaoni. Wazazi wanapaswa kufuatilia matumizi, kutumia vidhibiti, na kuwafundisha tabia salama.
Ekegusii: Abana mbare ase hatari goetera eintaneti. Abaibori goika bamongere buna abana babo bagotumia eintaneti, batabge na komanyia abana babo chinchera chingiya chibaretere emechando.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Tana River County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo korigiriria abaremi ba Tana River County gochia ase omotienyi ogocha obwomokoro bwabaremi nigo bare gosegeta chichiro chingiya chie chayi.

English: University of Nairobi to make more course materials available as Open Educational Resources (OER).
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Nairobi korosia amasomo yechikosi chinyinge na gochibeka eintaneti erio goikerwa nabana abange ase bosa (OER).

English: KALRO advises farmers in Mandera County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Ekegusii: KALRO ogotebererigwa abachuma Mandera County okorenda ebichuni biria bigosaria endagera gindigwa amakorwa agokwana agotebererigwa esagati ogokomera amagoro.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Bungoma County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokwaniria abamama baria bare n'ebiremo ase Bungoma County buna ogwancha ebitabu biogosaria abana chindagera chio obonyinge nigo bire biogotara ase chinyomba chionsi chia mbinga.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Ekegusii: Egururu: Direktorat ya Omosaria Oboitaai (DCI) orure ogokurerwa ase okomentekana gwa omoroberio omuya wokomera obwana obwengencho ase okomera obwana obwengencho ya Murang'a.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Kericho County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Ekegusii: Ekomiti yebirio biamashira ya Kenya (Kenya Dairy Board) egosaba abaremi ba Kericho County korusia ebitoki biabo ase abaguri abare na ebarua yobokoreri gusa nigo baranyare gokonya korwa chibei chinyinge ase amapera.

English: FAO urges pigs farmers in Makueni County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia FAO nigo kigobaboria abanyamwaka bwechimbori ase Makueni County konyanya abasikari bwechimbori ase ofisi yebaganga bwechimbori erio konyanya amanyoka ayio, konyora buna nigo kwaretwa amanyoka ayio arimo oborwa bwechimbori.

English: Wide announcement on how counties counties are showcasing varios foods and their trademarks immediately
Ekegusii: Okoraria ase oboagare buna chikaunti chikoorokia chindagera ao ao na ebimanyererio abwo kengima

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens the electoral calendar centres in Bomet County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Korongo: Abisi yaAuditor-General okoigora amarago yokoroisia oboteneneri chintunda chiBomet chisae koba maiso ase okorwegwa kuobokoreri

English: Frameworks to support coffee subsector reforms will be ready by the end of the year Farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to prepare for upcoming changes and improvements
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kusaidia mageuzi ya sekta ndogo ya kahawa itakuwa tayari ifikapo mwisho wa mwaka Wakulima na wadau wanahimizwa kujiandaa kwa mabadiliko na maboresho yajayo.
Ekegusii: Igoro za kusasa chikagwa zinganigwe zingaikorwo gosira omoerio bwomwaka bwa hii. Abaremi na abakorwo baaiganiigwe ase kusasa gosira mirembe na mirembe yaaikorwo.

English: Explore options for long term storage of eggs to take advantage of better market prices or bridge supply gaps
Kiswahili: Chunguza chaguzi za kuhifadhi mayai kwa muda mrefu ili kutumia fursa ya bei bora za soko au mapengo ya usambazaji wa daraja
Ekegusii: Rigia komanya emeroberio ende erengete obogachi obuya bwerigesa riamagena ekero magori yamagena ere engiya na orengete oboonia bwechingaki chionsi

English: CDC encourages mothers in Laikipia County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: CDC nigo egokora abamama ase Laikipia County gochora risakara ri'oborwaria ri'omwana na mama erio gokomera oborwaria bw'omwana oo.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Mandera County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Mandera na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Obotuki bwa abanto: SHA (Social Health Authority) neyaburiirie abanto ase okwong'erera kwa amarwaire aya cyclosporiasis ase Mandera County na goboria abanto kuripoti chimbere chionsi chio oborwaire obo ase abanyamwamu bwa abanto.

English: OGP urges residents of Kericho County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya kericho gotumia bwekereko bia internetu kufungura chikoro kufite kere omokorokoro obokurumi.

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Isiolo County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: IEBC orure okoboria ase abamenyi nobarimu a ekaunti ya isiolo sira amagancha a bionsi ase egera.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Ekegusii: Omadongo: NPS okoigora onyano okabere okwekonya kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera bwenyao buekaunti Meru.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Nairobi County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross kigokera abamenyi ba Nairobi County tibakaba nabokongu ase oboite, korende baborigwe gochia ase omonyabwate orenge ogoetwa obonyabwate.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yasororire abaremi babana ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County gochia ase oborwari bwa chinkliniki obwateeretiwe buna ebitundu bi'omwaka o'omotienyi 10 ogokonyera obobuto bwabamama.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Makueni County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria kikao cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kioroire omonto omonene orenge na oboremi bw'ebirengererio ase Makueni County gochia ase chisesio chiokogokia abanto chitariki chi'erere ase oboremi bw'ebirengererio.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for passport services in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Echokoro: OGP okoigora ekeyia omorobokano bao ase ogotomereka pasipoto aaria ekaonti ya Migori.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Chokoro: KMTC yasomiya igoro yokorenda abana ase esukuru Kiambu.

English: KICD urges youth in Nakuru County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KICD ogosia obosae bochabu Nakuru ekaonti korenda kwegara amakora gokora kwa rigesa ria kwegara.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in West Pokot County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ebu: NPS ekaegere egonde ekolegese ebuagi omorobore kwenyara wokorenda ase okorengana omorobore we chuaka West Pokot.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Machakos County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Julai.
Ekegusii: KTDA enyonyore ekitokoriti e Machakos ekigindigwa amoyo echiokoriti kwanza kabila embura kwa kufikira ogokomera kwa engoromomi

English: After harvesting, the buds are soaked in sunlight, sliced, sliced, and then dried again until they are well dry; since the buds are easily attacked by insects, store them in special bags (PICS).
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, anika kunde juani, zipige kwa fito, zipete, kisha zikaushe tena juani hadi zikauke vizuri; kwa kuwa kunde hushambuliwa haraka na wadudu, zihifadhi kwenye mifuko maalum (PICS bags).
Ekegusii: Okogesa, egechuni zinwe zinakobosa mu orwomo, zinakosaga egechuni, zinakobosa mu paka za PICS.

English: Every Kenyan must join the fight against corruption.Uuphold our dignity and justice.
Kiswahili: Kila Mkenya lazima ajiunge na vita dhidi ya ufisadi. Tulinde utu na haki yetu.
Ekegusii: Nere buya kera omo'Kenya kobwatisia esegi gotanga obokorekanu. Segeta amasikani nekeene.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Kajiado County to collect materials from the county education office to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi (TVET) mbaorogetie endorero eri Kajiado kondera okogania ebirengo bioboikeranu oko kondera ofisi yechisemi yobokondera okogania buna amasomo yegedichitari agoikeranigwa.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Ekegusii: Amanyiso a CDC: chikiriniki chia obotununi bwa amaka nigo chigokora chinsa chionsi chia omotienyi 5 ase chikiriniki chia oborwaro ebiitirwe ase Lamu County.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Mandera County to prepare for possible flooding this September.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenywa abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Mandera bokwetegwa na etureti ya kebaki.

English: NCPB promotes terracing among farmers in Narok County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza ustahimilivu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokonya abaremi gokora amaterasi ase Narok County ase ogokora kwayo kwo ogokonya oboremi gokomera ase obororo bwechiheo ase omotienyi 6.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Turkana County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya kirema amamenyi ya Turkana County okobwaterana nabasae ase okorosia amachiko, ting’igua obogambi bwekenyoro.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Tharaka-Nithi County on progress of the county integrated development plan this February.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Februari.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen aambiriria abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi okwese okosaga omonugunoobarema omonuguno kuhara okotokorwie okwese okosaga omonuguno oborogwo omwese okwese okotokorwie okwese okosaga okwese okwese omonuguno oborogwo omwese okotokorwie okwese okwese.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Vihiga County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kibororia egonde korwa echingencho ao ao nobomanyi bwabo erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu Vihiga egetamo.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Kwale County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS yaenekirie endorero bese bokwale gochibesa gindigwa kwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma oigoirwe ase chikombuta chikoboko cinse yomoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari.

English: DPP calls on residents of Garissa County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: DPP berekera abamenyi okofya Garissa Ekirengo ekibwaterana nokwemurunganania kwabo ase okweseka abendeni bokwemurukkanania kibende nabo.

English: KEPHIS urges beans growers in Embu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Embu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS kororagia abarima ebihunde mu kaunti ya Embu gukoresha egorokoro eribombye ku mbuga esamikire bwere omwoyo ogworororoka omwaka guno.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Mandera County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mandera Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ogokororia: NDMA gokorongegetwe ogokoronge bwokorwa chinka chiabo chinsa gete nkwabegetwe aaria ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera ya November.

English: Reuters captured escalating violence in Nairobi protests, including burning vehicles amid outrage over a blogger’s death in custody.
Kiswahili: Reuters ilishikilia kuongezeka kwa vurugu katika maandamano ya Nairobi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuteketeza magari katikati ya ghadhabu juu ya kifo cha mwanablogu katika kizuizini.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbabwatete buna eburaburu yarenge aaria Nairobi, na gosamba chirori ase obororo bwogokwa kwomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera ase eseri ya porisi.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo ekobasoka abanyene etugo ase Nyandarua County goika gochera etugo chikaonti chinde buna batari na echibali erio gotanga afia yetugo.

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development revised TVET curricula to align with industry needs for the 2019/2020 academic year.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) gianhioreirie keboyia amasomo yomwaka bamasomo a TVET korengana nokogania nokogania gwechifakitori omwaka 2019/2020.

English: KUCCPS calls on the community in Kakamega County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS b erekera egonde bekaunti ya kakamega kwerikia sira amagancha ase gacha abwekaine bwechana.

English: This conversation seeks to understand what Government and private sector have done in presenting DPI in boosting agriculture.
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo haya yanalenga kuelewa ni nini Serikali na sekta binafsi wamefanya katika kuwasilisha DPI katika kukuza kilimo.
Ekegusii: Enkwana eye nerigie komanya eki eserikari egokora amo neki abanyabiasara ase okobeka DPI erio kogendereria chingencho chioboremi.

English: To inoculate soybean seed, mix a sugar-water sticker solution, coat the seed evenly with it, then add the rhizobium inoculant and mix gently until every seed is covered; protect the inoculated seed from direct sunlight and keep it in the shade until you plant it.
Kiswahili: Ili kuchanja mbegu ya soya, changanya suluhisho la stika ya maji ya sukari, paka mbegu sawasawa nayo, kisha ongeza chanjo ya rhizobium na changanya kwa upole hadi kila mbegu ifunikiwe; Linda mbegu iliyochanjwa kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja na kuiweka kwenye kivuli hadi uipande.
Ekegusii: Kuokosa miro, okosa chung'wa amache, ogotuba miro gacharachara, gesa inokulanti ya rhizobium na okosa kwa gacharachara hadi miro yote yamagotubwa; gacha inokulanti yamiro kwa nyama na gacha kwa kinywa hadi uokosa kwa ogokomera.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches ward-level service delivery in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua huduma za huduma katika Wilaya ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Nya: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia abanto igoro yeserikari yechikaonti ya Kilifi.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free tobacco control outreach in Machakos County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Machakos Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Omonya omonene: Ministeri y'Afya nigo erabe negechiko chio ogotanga oborwaire bwa tobacho ase Machakos County chingaki kia omotienyi 7.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Mombasa County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo ekobasoka abanto bwa Mombasa County buna ogoteba amache nigo okong'ania oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: IEBC urges residents of Garissa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: IEBC osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Garissa koengereria emeroberio yechisemi chiabanto koba gotoma obokoreri bwa kubora kw'obosania.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Mombasa County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KTDA negenderete gosegeta abaremi ba Mombasa County goikera chinyomba chiokogwata amache ase emegondo yabo nigo barakonye goikera obororo bwa chimbura chire gochinduka.

English: NTSA warns residents of Garissa County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: NTSA yaboririe abamenyi koGarissa gochinchera chiancheire gikorenda obosombi (NTSA) yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire gikorenda ebesa ekenywa obokoreri bweserikari giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chiancheire gikorenda obosombi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Siaya County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Oboremi na Endagera (AFA) nigo kigoibokia abanto ba Siaya Kaunti buna ogotara amaterasi nigo okong'onyora oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: KRA updates residents of Laikipia County on progress of county development projects this March.
Kiswahili: KRA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Machi.
Ekegusii: KRA yasegetire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Laikipia ngokonyeka bare korwa ase amagenderero ao ao egetamo ao ao

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Nyamira County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nyamira County abamenyi oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru 2023 goting'ia esagati.

English: Great resolutions including individuals in a summit meeting G20. Finance and agriculture of G20 in Washington DC.. na..
Kiswahili: Maazimio mazuri ikiwa ni pamoja na watu binafsi katika mkutano wa kilele wa G20. Fedha na kilimo cha G20 huko Washington DC.. na ..
Ekegusii: Amangana engencho yomonto na aya okoinyoria nabwatekaine nokowa amangana amanene as omosangerekano obeene o G20 Bwechibesa na Oboremi korwa Omominisita o Washington D.C. na...

English: FAO warns maize farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Ekegusii: FAO inyaga agwandi a Kiambu kuokera chuma chenya okuokera chuma chenya na kurekeshia magari magari

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a depression awareness forum in Baringo County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KEMRI egakora omotienyi ogokoraria abanto ase obongo omotienyi (depression) ase Baringo County ase omotienyi 10. Abanto bonsi nigo bagetigwe.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Okwari: KUCCPS okoigora ogosaba kwao chiria chirengete endorero baria batari kwenyara kwa Embu County.

English: Ministry highlighting role of community health workers in delivering nutrition services as part of Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikisisitiza jukumu la wafanyikazi wa afya wa jamii katika kutoa huduma za lishe kama sehemu ya Mpango wa Afya Ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Ewizara komorekera emeremo ya abakori emeremo yobochenu bwegenka ase okoenana amaegerio yechindagera buna ensemo yogosira obochenu ase bonsi

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ebiombe bieserikari yobobundi nochusi okoigora amabaga ase abakenya abasomu bechingencho ao ao ase ensemo yobokoreri bweserikari ya Narok.

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of goats in Trans Nzoia County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia KEPHIS nigo kigoretie okogenda kwa chimburi ase Trans Nzoia County goetera oborwaere bwa Newcastle obo bwakomire.

English: Launch of voluntary certification recognizing employers who implement nutrition, mental health, and fitness standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa cheti cha hiari kinachowatambua waajiri wanaotekeleza viwango vya lishe, afya ya akili, na siha.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa gw'esatibigeti yokwerwa eyio egoancherana abariki emeremo abare bagoikerania ebirengo biechindagera, oborwari bw'obongo, amo na okoba nechinguru kemobere.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes agroforestry among farmers in Kajiado County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo gikogenderera gokomera oboremi bwo gochaka emete ase abaremi ba Kajiado County buna eyemo yemeremo yabo yogoikerania oboremi ase obokebago bwa omotienyi 9.

English: KEMRI launches a September awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Busia County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Ekegusii: KEMRI gochakia gosegeta yokomanyia etureti ya kebaki bwobokonyi bwobochabu bwobokorwa ase Busia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Machakos County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwe Ebisara bia Oboremi na Oboreri bwe Ebisara bogokora abaremi ase Machakos County goika gochia ase obwanchani bwe obotuni bwa chibei chio gotigira nigo bwo konyora chibei chinyia ase ebisaka.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Medical Association ogokorwa chinyagitari chionsi chieserikari ao Kisii County nkorwa chire obobwenia ao ao bogokorerwa bobe choria.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Tharaka-Nithi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo erorete gochia ase ababokeri babana ase Tharaka-Nithi County konyorera ekarati yobochari bwa mama na omwana ase omoroberio ogokonya abamama ogoika omotienyi 9.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Kilifi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ewizara y'Obonyamu - Ekitengo kia Obonyamu bwa Abakungu nigo egokora abamenyi ba Kilifi County gochia ase Huduma Centre ya ange gochia korwa obokonyi bwa ogosomera obonyamu bwa chigoro chire ase obokonyi.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: Ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (Kenya Gazette) nkorosia kere nabi nia Kirinyaga gota obokorwa bochokoni kwa obokemanyia na korwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokaonti kwa omotimoko omuya na omotimoko omute.

English: Hydroponics allows soil-less growing of cattle. Learn about systems, nutrients, and managing a hydroponic setup.
Kiswahili: Hydroponics inaruhusu ukuaji wa ng'ombe bila udongo. Jifunze kuhusu mifumo, virutubisho, na kusimamia usanidi wa hydroponic.
Ekegusii: Oboremi bwebimeri bia roche nigo egkonya riroba . Manya igoro yomoroberio oyio, obotobu na buna orachake oboremi bwebimeri biaroche.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Vihiga County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) kiararirie abaibori nabarimu nchisemi nkorwa Vihiga komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Nyandarua County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Amanyisibue: Ekambi y'oborwaria ey'erere eyakoretwe na KEMSA ekaba ase Nyandarua County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces SHA registration for residents of West Pokot County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gie oborwairi na ogokonywa nigo kiarure ogochika kwa ogokwandika kwa SHA ase abamenyi ba West Pokot County gochaka ase omotienyi 5.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: NTSA okorwa egonde ekenene ki'abasikari nkiarigete amangana ameng'e agoteba buya emeremo na egekageire korwa abarendi boborndi bwebinyo ase ekaonti ya Nairobi ngochomoni engoromomi.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Baringo County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za maziwa.
Ekegusii: FAO egokonya abaremi ase Baringo County korigisita na chikuoperativi chire na cheti erio konyora chigori chine ch'amata.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Ekegusii: Gorogoro: IEBC otakororia goika ase ebirengererio bia abanto chi West Pokot yuokwerukia ase omoroberio yosoma na korika goikera amaswari ase abanto.

English: To control anthracnose in African eggplant, buy a Mancozeb-based fungicide from a registered agro-dealer (avoid Mancozeb-Metalaxyl mixes), mix 40g per 20 litres of water plus 2 tablespoons of liquid soap as a sticker, and spray mid-morning or late afternoon avoiding wind and drought-stressed plants; observe a two-week pre-harvest interval.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti anthracnose katika biringanya ya Kiafrika, nunua dawa ya kuua kuvu inayotokana na Mancozeb kutoka kwa muuzaji wa kilimo aliyesajiliwa (epuka mchanganyiko wa Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), changanya 40g kwa lita 20 za maji pamoja na vijiko 2 vya sabuni ya maji kama kibandiko, na nyunyiza katikati ya asubuhi au alasiri kuepuka mimea inayofadhaika kwa upepo na ukame; Zingatia muda wa wiki mbili kabla ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Kuokorera anthracnose kwa African eggplant, okogora fungicide lile Mancozeb kutoka kwa agro-dealer lile liko namba (sikiliza fungicide lile Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), kumika 40g kwa 20 litres amache na 2 tablespoons sabuni ya likido si ya kumia, na kusabara kwa mchana kati au mchana wa mwisho kusikiliza mafua na omorakera-stressed plants; sikiliza echuma ya biombera pre-gesa interval.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a July awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Julai juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo kianchire oborori bwokomanya abanto igoro yogocha amaboko ase omotienyi 7 ase Turkana County.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Bomet County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egokora abaremi ba Bomet County amachego igoro yomokoro ogosomwa okwoborobereri bwokonyorokereria amache obwomwaka obo ogokwenda gochi.

English: UN urges transparent investigations after protest fatalities.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa wahimiza uchunguzi wa wazi baada ya vifo vya waandamanaji.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwechinse chikwegambera (UN) bwaboririe obutuki bwa maiso marore nyuma yabarobererekani koumia.

English: Teachers Service Commission introduces formal certification for STEM teachers to improve quality of instruction.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu giansire korwa chisatifiketi chiabeene ase abarimu begesayansi, etekinorocghia, obobundi nechisabu (STEM) erio goikerani ogotebereria abana gwakeene.

English: IEBC advises residents of Kiambu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Ekegusii: IEBC yamogambi abasi okiambu buekaunti okoboria ase baria batagete obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua e-Citizen.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Chere: NDMA kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoria korwa emechando kwa mabinga Embu.

English: Farmers in Kericho The Principal Secretary of Agriculture visited the Tebesonik Tea Factory and Charera Water Project to address your concerns and promote sustainable development
Kiswahili: Wakulima Kericho Katibu Mkuu wa Kilimo alitembelea Kiwanda cha Chai cha Tebesonik na Mradi wa Maji wa Charera ili kushughulikia matatizo yako na kukuza maendeleo endelevu.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross eribokiete abanto ba Busia County igoro y'oborito bw'ogochia na obocheri obuya ase obogima bw'enyomba.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Laikipia County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekegereria abanto bose Laikipia County bo kw'obokwana kwa bosa kwa makambi ma medicine gokorwa ritangani bono ekebeseke ekebariri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Garissa County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Abisi yebwetegereza biegesiasa yebiama bia siasa obooririe abamenyi bia bisi yebwetegereza bia Garissa yasikia choria yebisi yabo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Tana River County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia okorora na ogokorera oborwari (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo korigia abanto ba Tana River County ng'a babere amache amanywanyi mbere yogoika nigo konyora gochira oborwari obo obwago gochira.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces eye and dental camps for residents of Kirinyaga County starting this October.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Social Health Authority (SHA) nigo kigoika chinkambi chiokorwaria amaiso na chinyo ase abanto bose banyabanto ba Kirinyaga County gosekerera ase omotienyi 10.

English: KALRO urges sheep farmers in Mandera County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KALRO nigo korigiririe ababori bweching'ombe ase ekaunti ya Mandera kobeka chindano ase eching'ombe chiabo ase amang'ana amanyekane goetera oborwa bwa Newcastle obo bwarete amang'ana amange.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2018 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2018 to apply for TVET courses closing April 30 2019.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2018 na wagombea wa zamani kuanzia 2000 hadi 2018 ili kutuma maombi ya kozi za TVET zinazofungwa Aprili 30, 2019.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire enyongo yaye portal ase omwaka 2018 ase abana baria bakorire amasomo esekenderi KCSE na abwo magega korwa omwaka 2000 to 2018 gotoma ogosaba kwabo gosoa chikoso chia TVET nyuma yechitariki 30 chiomotienyi 4 omwaka 2019.

English: Start or improve your beekeeping. Learn about hive management, colony health, honey harvesting, and marketing bee products.
Kiswahili: Anza au uboreshe ufugaji wako nyuki. Jifunze kuhusu usimamizi wa mizinga, afya ya koloni, uvunaji wa asali, na uuzaji wa bidhaa za nyuki.
Ekegusii: Ansa gose kong'ia obotugi bwao bwechinchoke.Egera komanya buna okorenda emetana, amasingira amaya yechinchoke, honey harvesting, kogesa oboke, na buna okoonia rigesa riechinchoke.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Machakos County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: IPOA yarure abamenyi baborigwe Machakos koba maiso erio gokoboria obwasioku ase obokoreri.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Ching'ori: OGP okoigora ekeyia omoroberio buma chindagera chigoonhorerigwa ching'ombe chierigori rianse bekaunti ya kakamega.

English: CDC launches a May awareness campaign on tobacco control across Busia County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Ekegusii: CDC nigo egwateire omwaka bwa omotienyi 5 gokorora abanto igoro yobobe bwa etaba ase Busia County.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Nyamira County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet mwezi Septemba huu.
Ekegusii: Chuma: Nyashoro ya Oboremi na Nyakimiri na Kebaki ito to miro yakebaki kwa aboremi a Nyamira etureti ya kebaki

English: KALRO invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this November.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Novemba hii.

Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Siaya na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
