English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Kisumu County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria: HELB ngoteba bare igoro yemeroberio yokobwaterana buna yakong'irie oboronge bwa mwanayabanto aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu kwa obokorwa bwa oboronge.

English: Over 200 000 households are benefiting from the 1 million kitchen gardens initiative Households are encouraged to participate for fresh produce and a healthy diet
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya kaya 200,000 zinanufaika na mpango wa bustani za jikoni milioni 1 Kaya zinahimizwa kushiriki kupata mazao mapya na lishe bora.
Ekegusii: Mwaka wa maria kumi na mbiri nyumba zilizopata faida kwenye mifumo ya mifuguo ya maria kumi na nyumba zinazotewa kufanyika kufikiwa na chakula chenye afya na chenye kuvutia

English: NCPB advises farmers in Migori County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna NCPB nkorosia ere abaremi ase Migori County korandika amarena gokora amasomo aya atari ase ogotara erio gochia ase amasomo aboremi ayio ayo agokwiza.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Tharaka-Nithi County this December.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Red Cross nkoribokia abanto buna okororwa oborwa bwa malaria ase obwango nkorwa ase chisentra chionsi chia obochari bwa amagaka ime yense ya Tharaka-Nithi County ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: IEBC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: IEBC nigo ekoborokia chitariki chiokorengwa ase amasukuru amakoro ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bw'Oboremi na Oboreri bw'Ebitungo nigo bwoibokire abamenyi ba Kirinyaga County buna okoborenda amabura nigo konyora oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Baringo County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: Komisheni y'Abakora imiaka y'abakenya (Teachers Service Commission) nigo egokwaniria abasae ba Baringo County ng'a obonyaganyi bwa HELB nigo bwoire ase abwo barakore amachiko na obonyakanyi bwo gokora chinguo.

English: To treat vegetable seeds against disease before sowing, submerge them in water heated to the recommended temperature for the recommended time (for example, spinach, cabbage, pepper, tomato and eggplant: 50°C for 30 minutes; lettuce and celery: 47°C for 30 minutes), then cool the seeds immediately in clean water and dry them before sowing or storing.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu mbegu za mboga dhidi ya magonjwa kabla ya kupanda, zitumbukize kwenye maji yenye joto kali kwa joto lililopendekezwa kwa wakati uliopendekezwa (kwa mfano, mchicha, kabichi, pilipili, nyanya na biringanya: 50 ° C kwa dakika 30; lettuce na celery: 47 ° C kwa dakika 30), kisha upoe mbegu mara moja kwenye maji safi na uikaushe kabla ya kupanda au kuhifadhi.
Ekegusii: Kuokorwa ching’eni chikorwachia okorwa oboruaire nyingi okorwa, botambe beria amache agwachia goika gokorwa gokorwa, okoroiseria okobosa amache orwomo okorwa, na okobosa okorwa.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kitui mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Ekegusii: Nde: NDMA okworokereria egonde egonde enchera ya bono oatoirwe aaria Kitui etureti ya kebaki.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kwale County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NCPB itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Machi hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB itoto kumetegesa magumu mieno ya mungo kwa matuji a Kaunti ya Kwale mwa waka wa egetamo

English: Creating awareness through the web and education on different foods, will be helpful for community health workers in assisting their people
Ekegusii: Okomanyia igoro yechindagera ao ao chireo goetera omotandao amo namosomo, mbikonye abakoreri bobobwenia banka erio kobakonya ase ogotebereria aabande

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Busia County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Ekegusii: Obwaziri bwa Afya obasabire abamama na ababa ase Busia County kogocha abana abari ase emiaka etano gose ase okomanya onye bare ne HIV/AIDS ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 9.

English: 15,000 full secondary scholarships for arid counties ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Å“ apply before Nov 30 via county office!

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Kwale County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo esabire abanainchi ba Kwale County batakwanwa na obororo bwo obokongu bwo omomoyo, na kwerika ase omotebereria orengeirwe.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Tharaka-Nithi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: ODPP erinya omoguta korwa omochi a Tharaka-Nithi kiyera obambo okiyerinya obambo omoguta.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi koegerera chiafisi chia eserekari agasa kochichiri kwa obongo na omotimoko omuya ase chiafisi chia eserekari.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Laikipia County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Ekegusii: KALRO yasegetire abacheni ba Laikipia kaunti gokorera ribaga eri riabeene amagori magori makorere kwa obokori bw'abokori bw'avokado.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokera abamenyi ba Bungoma County batakonyara gochia gose okorwa ase obororo, na bagetere chichera chiokobokonywa ase obochenu bwobongo chire chitarimo chinchera.

English: Farmers in dry areas are encouraged to explore dryland arrow roots a resilient crop that requires minimal water Contact Modern Tech Nurseries for planting materials
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo kame wanahimizwa kuchunguza mizizi ya mshale wa nchi kavu na mimea inayostahimili unyevu inayohitaji maji kidogo Wasiliana na Modern Tech Nurseries kwa ajili ya vifaa vya kupanda.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Marsabit County this November.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa homa ya dengue unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross eribokirie abanto buna okogemwa kwa dengue fever kwa bosa nigo kure ase chinyomba chiomonyagetari chiose chia serikari ime ya Marsabit County ime yechimo ya omotienyi 11.

English: KEPHIS informs avocado farmers in Uasin Gishu County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS tebia abaremi bachafokado ba Uasin Gishu kaunti ekeyia marigiti kobwatania etureti ya kebaki.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Vihiga County that input on development planning forums is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya nyarigetie amaoni korwa abanainchi ase Vihiga County ng'a eserikari negenderere nechnkwana nabanainchi ase okorwa ebirengererio biamagenderero buna enyia eng’atiato.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kojikiria chinchogu chenya chenya kwa mokorokoro gochakiria mabereko ya mokorokoro ya mokorokoro.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Taita-Taveta County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) korwa abamenyi gwesokia nia Taita-Taveta orure okoboria gochia ase eserekari eyuo kobeka ebango enene ase emerongi gose mogoka.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Isiolo County to a free training on fertiliser application this February.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo gokoroka abaremi ba Isiolo County ase amasomo atari gochara ase okomanya buna bagokora na chifetiraisa ase omotienyi 2.

English: This publication describes climate-smart agriculture (CSA) case studies from around the world, showing how the approach is implemented to address challenges ...
Kiswahili: Chapisho hili linaelezea tafiti za mifano ya kilimo kinachozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi (CSA) kutoka kote ulimwenguni, likionyesha jinsi mbinu hiyo inavyotekelezwa ili kushughulikia changamoto ...
Ekegusii: Egatabu eke nigo geworokereria igoro yoboremi borengete ogsareka kwerire (CSA) ebikworokereria korwa chingongo aoao chience, chikworokia bua omoroberio oyo ogokorwa gokonya omochando oyo ...

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Chuma: Nyaranga ya Kioo kwa Kiwango cha Kibinu kichukuliwa chuma ya kuhoma mabambo na kuhoma nyumba za kioo ma Kisii County

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: NTSA okonyire abamenyi bekaunti ya Kakamega bwechinyomba chierigori rianse komanyia mesaji yomonto yonse yodegeta abasikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwonsi bwokoruta chipomu.

English: The Ministry of Health aims to scale the uptake of the malaria vaccine among children aged between 6 months to 14 years.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inalenga kuongeza idadi ya watoto wanaotumia chanjo ya malaria miongoni mwa watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 6 hadi miaka 14.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Afya yarigiri komenta enamba ya abana bagotumia esindani y'Esosera/malaria ime ya abana bare emetienyi 6 goika emiaka 14.

English: Eliminate school levies completely – CS orders nationwide crackdown!
Kiswahili: Ondoa kabisa ushuru wa shule CS yaamuru msako wa kitaifa!
Ekegusii: Rusia chibango chionsi. Omominisita bwechisemi orure ogchika Kenya engima!

English: early) and practices such as push-pull technology i) Cultural control, such as weeding ii) Physical control iii) Biological control iv) Chemical control.
Ekegusii: gotanyorwa) na kwegera ayarengete tekinorochia yoboremi bwabono i) enchera yaito yekienyechi buna koburugera endare, ii) gotanga rosana komera ase ebimeri, iii) gosiarera amariogo iv) na korenda buna amariogo agotumeka.

English: KEMSA announces outpatient services for residents of Machakos County starting this April.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuanzia Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: KEMSA yatangazete oboikoni bwa abanyamwaka ase abamenyi ba Machakos County gosegerera korwa omotienyi 4 eyio.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Ekemanyisyo kia CDC: chikiriniki chiogotera abana chigenderere gochakera omotienyi 9 ase chikiriniki chia oborwaro biari chiatangirwe ase Uasin Gishu County.

English: TVET encourages residents of Lamu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Ekegusii: TVET obabwateranirie abamenyi ba Lamu County kwebaterania kwebogesaku kiabo kubera tebia kwebogesaku komanyia buna chibesa chiechikanti chiabo.

English: Government distributes mosquito nets in malaria fight. Kilifi County is one of the beneficiaries. Nets program was flagged over procurement irregularities. MOH wants to distribute 15M nets in 22 counties
Kiswahili: Serikali yasambaza vyandarua katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria. Kaunti ya Kilifi ni mojawapo ya wanufaika. Programu ya vyandarua iliangaziwa kwa ukiukwaji wa sheria za ununuzi. Wizara ya Afya inataka kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15 katika kaunti 22
Ekegusii: Eserekali yaenanire chineti as esegi ya Malaria. Ekaunti ya Kilifi neyemo yabo ase chiria chigochi konyora. Omoroberio bwe'chineti nigo oetwe oborabu igoro ya ogotabwati amachiko y'ogochigora. Ewizara ya Afya nigo etagete koenana chineti milioni 15 ase chikaunti 22

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for poultry in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborimi na oboreri bweching'ombe yarenterete ogokurerwa kworogongo bwechancho ya endwari ya rabies ase chinkoko ase Busia County ase omotienyi 6.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Samburu County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragire abamama ase ekaunti ya Samburu gocha ase oborwari bwa abana ase rituko rierigirwe erio korenda obochari bwabana babo.

English: KEPHIS warns maize farmers in Bomet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria kirengererete oboremi bwechimera (KEPHIS) nigo kegosabura abaremi bwechimera ase Bomet County igoro yechisemi chiebibara na korigiria ogotema ogokonya amang'ana.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Kericho County that school feeding programme registration is open this July.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya gia okorora ekerigirwa (KICD) gokoremereria abamama ase Kericho County mbu okoregisita ase chiganda chia okoria chiganda chia esukuru nigo kigoire ase omotienyi 7.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Kitui County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Julai.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Obochenu - Ekitengo kia Obochenu bwa Abana na Abakungu nigo kogocha abanyabana ase Kitui County gochia nabana babo baria bare ase emiaka etano gose egose gochwa gocherwa oborendi bwa HIV/AIDS ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 7.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Tana River County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete obosae ase ekaunti ya Tana River koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge cha amakora ase chinsemo chia okonyarekana.

English: AFA advises fish producers in Nairobi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia AFA nigo kioboririe abanyabwate bwe chinswi ase Nairobi County kourusia chinswi chiabo goetera abaguri abare na echitifiketi chokogura chinswi chingaki chiokogesa chinswi kire gochia.

English: Correct details on CBA portal now.
Kiswahili: Sahihisha maelezo kwenye lango la CBA sasa.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana amaikeranu bono igoro yechisemi chiria chirengete okwenya gwa kera omwana nao chire ase (CBA) bono.

English: ODPP advises residents of Nyeri County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: ODPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyeri gindigwa intaneti via e-Citizen portal nende osabire ID.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya kuboriria abamenyi a Kitui County bogoria igoro yobochori yambochore ase ambochore a voting day ariwo chintunda chiobochori.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorenda obosombi (Communications Authority of Kenya) yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire na yiasabire abamenyi koeneki Nyeri County koenekia amangana ebesa obamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chireo chiokobamanyia nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia.

English: COMESA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in West Pokot County this October.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA nkoatangasire ogosegeta etugo chimbwa (rabies) ase chinkombe ase West Pokot County ase omotienyi 10.

English: DCI urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: DCI osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Trans Nzoia koegerera chinchogu chekobwaterana kwa bungo bwebiriria chinguru, chinguru okochinse okobwaterana ase oboamo erio gokinana nechinchera chiobokebago.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges parents and teachers in Nyeri County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiyakorire nyakombe na nyakosomwa a Nyeri County kurengana nokogerera amagancha a egera a kireng'ana.

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announced reforms to TVET curricula to align with industry needs for 2018/2019.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie oboonchoreria bwamatemwa ase amasomo a TVET korengana nokogania gwechifakitori omwaka 2018/2019.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a maize collection centre in Kitui County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyia: Ekeago kia Kenya ekio kiororera obuya bwebituma (KEPHIS) nigo kigokonya ekeago kio gochokia ebituma ase Kitui County ase omotienyi 10.

English: NCPB urges cattle farmers in Isiolo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekioboria ebitongwa (NCPB) nigo kogocha abaremi b'eching'ombe aiga Isiolo County korua amangana igoro yeching'ombe chire oborwa ase ofisi y'abaveterinari erie hafi, konyora amangana y'oborwa bwa anthrax.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Kericho County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Obochenu egokora abanto bwa Kericho County batagokwa n'obororo ase obotuni, na bagende bagakora na omonyabwate obwanchani oboigirwe.

English: Ministry of Health launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Ebitengo bi'obochari biarete ekenya kia omotienyi 8 gokonya abanto bamenye amangana igoro y'oborwari bwa ebirasire (hypertension) ase Uasin Gishu County.

English: NTSA warns residents of Nakuru County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: NTSA yasemerie abamenyi e Nakuru County kubwense ogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges maize growers in Embu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Embu kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Chakavu cha Kenya cha Ogokomera Egetuma na Amagoro ya Embu kumwita okogesa ogokomera kwa amaroba oyera okogesa okogomera amagoro hii.

English: To influence technology while using smack technology,like applying planting plants (desmodium leaves)that predate other pests and herbs in the field.
Kiswahili: Ili kuathiri teknolojia wakati wa kutumia teknolojia ya smack,kama vile kupaka mimea ya kupanda (majani ya desmodium)ambayo hutangulia wadudu na mimea mingine shambani.
Ekegusii: Ogosegeta omoroberio otekinorochia nenchera ierengete goyumia ebimeri biria bigoseria ebimeria biri bende bikorenta emechando mogondo (amato edesimodiamu) goseria ebichuni na amakonde korwa ebimeri osimegete mogondo...

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KEMSA nikigoibokia abanto bose ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County ng'a ogosabwa obwate bwa NHIF/SHA nigo bwakorwa ase chinchera chire chigendereretwe.

English: KTTC renamed to focus solely on training TVET instructors.
Ekegusii: Ekorechi yabarimu yobobundi KTTC yarokirwe erieta riyia erio korenga gosomia abatimu bechisemi chiobobundi TVET chioka.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Baringo County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa ufikiaji wa Julai.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) egokora gosegerera abamama na abataata ase Baringo County gochia na abana abato barenge ase emiaka etano gosegerwa oborwaire bwa meningitis ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 7.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Kirinyaga County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abamanyi b'oborwaro bwa Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo gokoboria abamenyi ba kaunti ya Kirinyaga goika gokorua chindano chi'oborwaro chionsi chigokenerwa konyora, konyara nigo oborwaro bwa HIV/AIDS bwakomanya gochia igoro.

English: KRA urges residents of Nyeri County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: KRA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya nyeri kwerikia buna abanyene ekaunti yabo gosira eserekari naboigo kwerwa ase amagenderero mochokoro.

English: Agriculture is the backbone of Kenya's economy,contributing to over 25%of the country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Agriculture employs over 70% of the country's workforce and plays a crucial role in the livelihoods of many Kenyans. However, unsustainable farming practices have resulted in land degradation, low crop yields, and food insecurity. Sustainable agriculture is an approach that can address these challenges, ensure food security and promote economic growth.
Ekegusii: Oboremi negete kiomogongo kieboki bia ense yaito ya Kenya, bokogesa 25 igoro yemia ase ebitoki biense yaito (GDP). Oboremi mborigete goetania 70 igoro yemia yense yaito ya Kenya goetera baria bonsi bagora gose barikire ase oboremi, naboigo bagokora emeremo yengencho ase as okonyora goke goke kwa'abange. Nonya nogo, chingencho chioboremi botari oboikeranu bwasaririe obotobu bwemegondo, rigesa rike, na oboremu bwe'ndagara obonene. Oboremi bwokwegendereria nomoroberio iobeene as omochando oyo, erio goikerania omoigoto na gokinia ebitoki.

English: A minimum export price for tea has been established at the Mombasa auction All tea producers and sellers must comply to ensure a sustainable industry
Kiswahili: Bei ya chini ya mauzo ya chai imeanzishwa katika mnada wa Mombasa Wazalishaji na wauzaji wote wa chai lazima wazingatie ili kuhakikisha tasnia endelevu.
Ekegusii: Amagori yonsi ya chaa imegunduliwa kwa aukisi ya Mombasa Machaa mabingwa na wamayiana kufanya mambo yaliyoyafikiwa ili kuhakikisha usimamizi wa kifaa

English: IEBC reminds residents of Meru County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: IEBC yaboria abamenyi buekaunti orure Meru bono okoboria ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua e-Citizen.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Homa Bay County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorora abasomi (TSC) nigo korigiririe abasabi ase Homa Bay County koba nabasabi bagochia ase TVET goetera KUCCPS ase ogosomia okwacha.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Trans Nzoia County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: DPP manyia abasikari nobogendia obobe gochia ase abanto Trans Nzoia nobogendia obogendia obaboririe abagambi gose amagenderero yeserekari nobogendia obogendia igoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nyandarua County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ekerero ya oboruaire ogendererete na ogokorera osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nyandarua ko bogoria ID ya kihoro kwa kogoria omorwaire ogotanga bw'omotwe gw'okorera omorwaire ogotanga.

English: High class course is built on a foundation of ICT4D in agriculture to add knowledge and capacity amongst staff of IFAD and...
Kiswahili: Kozi ya darasa la juu imejengwa juu ya msingi wa ICT4D katika kilimo kuongeza maarifa na uwezo kati ya wafanyakazi wa IFAD na...
Ekegusii: Ogosoma oko kwaigoro nigo gokoagacha igoro ya ayabwenerete ICT4D ime ya ekosi yoboremi kwangoyia chisemi nobangaini nokobua gati ase abakoreri IFAD na ...

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Tana River County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiabakori bwechisemi (TSC) gokosaba abanto bose bwa Tana River County goseka abana babo ase esukuru yeborora eri hakuhaku nigo babere babwate obwanchwa bwechisukuru chie sekondari chia chigari chitarigwakanerwa.

English: NCPB advises avocado producers in Siaya County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: NCPB egasirira abarima ebibiri bya avocado eki Siaya kaunti korwa bonane bagwire muno sosiyete imwe iri nayo akambere mbere y’okwotonora ebibiri.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Kisii County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Red Cross nigo korigia abanto bose bwa Kisii County gokoroga amaboko na sabuni na amache amayera chingaki chionsi nigo korigia okonyora oborwae obo nigo bwakorwa.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Busia County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiyabire abamenyi a Busia koenekia ayio kiyabire abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro, kiyabire abamenyi koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kubonye kuyabire.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Makueni County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: chikoti chia Kenya okoigora ebitambokero ebitangani ase Makueni ekaunti eng’atiato.

English: Technology, AATF..started 1993, Tanager works with company families of ACDI/COCA to ensure agriculture benefits all persons.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia, AATF.. ilianza 1993, Tanager anafanya kazi na familia za kampuni za ACDI/COCA ili kuhakikisha kilimo kinawanufaisha watu wote.
Ekegusii: tekinolochia, AATF ... Giachagetwe 1993, Tanager nogo aagokora emeremo nefamiria ya ACDI/VOCA eyio ere obomo bwechikambani erio korora nga oboremi gokora emeremo emiya ase abanto.

English: TSC reminds needy students in Vihiga County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: TSC ribaga endorero baria bare nokogania Vihiga County ao ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie ticha sani.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-citizen katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Nabamia: e-Citizen okoigora ekeyia goitabwa neserikari koba e-Citizen ogotoma chingaki chiomobasekano ya Garissa.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Uasin Gishu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kupitisha aina zilizothibitishwa za mbegu zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Mei.
Ekegusii: KTDA amwokoroma mifarmia mi Uasin Gishu gosoroma mivuti yiyate omorakera amwokomera amagoro amaumuntia

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Nandi County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: KALRO egokang'a abaremi ba Nandi County goikara ase chichama chiebiara chire na echeti, nigo egokonya abaremi konyora chibei chibiya chiebirio biemegondo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Nyamira County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: Egesaku gia okorora na goikerania oborwaire nikio korigiriria abamama ase Nyamira County gochia ase chikirini chio oborwaro chio ogotebwa, nigo korigiriria obonyamasi bwomwana.

English: Ministry of Health announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Machakos County starting this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuanzia Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi'obochari bi'Eserikari y'Obonyang'anyi nigo ebitangazete ogotebwa kwa ebiara bi'okorwaria chimpio (dialysis) ase abanto b'omwaka Machakos goetera omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a tea collection centre in Embu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Embu Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana: COMESA neegure echinyomba chogotera chinchai ase Embu County omotienyi o omotienyi 6.

English: TSC invites youth in Wajir County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Februari hii.
Ekegusii: TSC egokwaniriria abasubati ase Wajir County kwerikia ase amategeko okwaka na ogotara chuma ase omotienyi 2.

English: Public awareness campaign strengthening intelligence sharing and trust between communities and security agencies.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya uhamasishaji umma kuimarisha ushiriki wa kijasusi na uaminifu kati ya jamii na mashirika ya usalama.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yokomanyia abanto nigo egokong'ia okoererania kwobotuki na komenta okwegenana gati yabanto nabarendi boborendi.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Nyamira County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: HELB egokang'a abana abatarasoma ase esukuru ase ekaunti ya Nyamira kobasoka obonyamoke bwo obosomi mbere yengaki eria erarengire ase amachiko okwaka okwabasomi abakure.

English: Government urges pensioners to register to avoid payroll suspension To all government pensioners, you are urged to register on the e-Citizen platform by the extended deadline of 10th May, the government spokesperson said.
Kiswahili: Serikali inawasihi wastaafu kujiandikisha ili kuepuka kusimamishwa kwa mishahara. Kwa wastaafu wote wa serikali, mnahimizwa kujiandikisha kwenye jukwaa la kielektroniki la Citizen ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho iliyoongezwa ya Mei 10, msemaji wa serikali alisema.
Ekegusii: Eserekari yababorie ababarure emeremo asengecho yobogotu kwerikia erio gotanga omoroberio bwogwakanua gotuguterwa are ase abakoreri abagotu bonsi. amatuko yokwerikia amentirwe goikera chitariki 10 omotienyi ogatano.

English: USDA influences new cultivation .
Kiswahili: USDA huathiri kilimo kipya .
Ekegusii: USDA nigo egosegeta ebokoro bioboremi bokorenda obotobu bweriroba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: Chokoro chokoro ya Kenya b erekera egonde ase Wajir gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Makueni County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe getenenerete ya Kenya yagwiria abakorwa be Makueni bokoraria na korosia ebitambokero bioborendi ase chindagera ase chinsagia ao ao na gacha gosiira gokonya koyemanyia amang'ana ayio.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette osabire abamenyi ba Trans Nzoia ekaunti koigeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana yokorobereria obotumeki bwechibese y'ekaunti yabo.

English: DCI reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: DCI gacharia omomenyi ase ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta okoboria okoborwaire bwa gochakia gosiira gacha omochiende gwanse obotikeranu.

English: U.S. Embassy warned citizens of risks during ongoing protests, advising avoidance of demonstration areas due to potential violence.
Kiswahili: Ubalozi wa Marekani uliwaonya raia kuhusu hatari wakati wa maandamano yanayoendelea, ukishauri kuepuka maeneo ya maandamano kutokana na uwezekano wa vurugu.
Ekegusii: Obobarosi bwa america aiga Kenya (U.S. Embassy) mbakurerete abakenya kwerenda chingaki okorobererekana kwagendererete, na korwa ogosemia abanto gotaika ang'e ase okorobererekana kore ase obwoba bwobotindi boreo.

English: Cloth the child with cloths that brings warmth to it, and don't expose them to coldness in the first months
Ekegusii: Boyia abana chiyànga chikorenta riberera ase omwana na etànge kobatenenki ase embeo enkendu, ase emetienyi emetangàni

Kiswahili: Angalia historia ya familia yako ya ugonjwa wa akili na uraibu, tafiti kadhaa zimeonyesha kuwa ugonjwa huu huwa unaenea katika familia, lakini unaweza kuzuiwa. Kadiri unavyofahamu zaidi mambo yako ya hatari ya kibiolojia, kimazingira na kimwili, ndivyo unavyozidi kuwa na uwezekano wa kuyashinda.
Ekegusii: Rigereria omogano bw'oborwaire bw'obongo amo nokonarereria ase enyomba yaino, obotuki obonge bwaorokirie ng'a oborwaire obo nigo bogotara ase enyomba, korende nabo bogotangwa. Buna okomanya mono igoro y'amang'ana aya are n'obobe ase oboibori, ase obomenyo, na ase omobere, nario oramanye enchera yokoyabua.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a milk collection centre in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KALRO egokonyora ekero giokonyora amate ase Mandera County ase omotienyi 2.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for national ID applications in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Nabamia: e-Citizen okoigora egetaseni gia ekeyia yao ase obokoreri bwa ID aaria Garissa ya mocha.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes organic farming among farmers in Migori County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Ekegusii: Bodi yechinyama chia Kenya (Kenya Dairy Board) egokora ogokwanera oborimi bwa kera na kera (organic farming) ase abarima ba Migori County buna ebitundu biogokonya oborimi ase ogotebia amagera amabe ase omotienyi 1.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Turkana County to a free training on post-harvest handling this December.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi'oborimi na ebirio (AFA) nigo bikogwata aborimi bose ase Turkana County ase okwengerwa okw'erongo ase ebirio nyuma y'okwengerwa ase omotienyi 12.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Kakamega County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Kakamega na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Ogochaka obochenu bwabanto: Minisiteri y'Obochenu nigo egokonya igoro y'obokongu bw'oborwaire bwa cyclosporiasis ase Kakamega County na gosegeta abanto barore ng'a nigo bagokonya goika amangana ase abakori b'obochenu bwa ensemo.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Bomet County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: TVET egera endorero baria bare Bomet County ao ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria ticha ribaga.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Kitui County on water harvesting this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya uvunaji wa maji Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KALRO nigo egokwenda gochia goigwate abaremi ba Kitui County ase ogotacha amache ase omotienyi 5.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Garissa County this June.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Garissa Juni hii.
Ekegusii: TSC ngokora kere omoroberio bwogosomia abanto igoro yamachiko yoboronge bwomonto mu kaunti ya Garissa ebuagi.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: childhood immunization clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo korwa ase Obotungwa bw'Obobwenia: Chikliniki chi'okwenerwa kw'abana chigakora bosa omotienyi 12 ase chinyagitari chioborokereri ase Migori County.

English: WSWS detailed mass mobilizations following a blogger’s custodial death, marked by tear gas, water cannons, arrests, and teacher solidarity strikes.
Kiswahili: WSWS ilielezea uhamasishaji wa watu wengi baada ya kifo cha mwanablogu mmoja chini ya kifungo, kilichoonyeshwa na gesi ya machozi, bunduki za maji, kukamatwa, na mapigano ya mshikamano wa walimu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene giense getenenerete oboitoni bwegesiasa, na buna omoganda omonene ogotenenerwa goetera obokoreri beintaneti (WSWS) nkiarigete ase oboikeranu buna abanto barangereretani ekero omoriki amangana bwogwetenenera akwete ase amabko abasikari, abatekaine nokorasa ebinto bierioko, amache abwate easidi, okobwatwa, na abarimi buna bagirete egasi ase kwogokwa kwoyomwabo.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens polling procedures centres in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) okoigora ekikamiri ekiyakamiri ekiyakamiri ime ya Wajir ekaunti omonugunoobarema hii.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free food safety outreach in Marsabit County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bwokorangeria: Ekeombe gia Kenya Red Cross kigakora ogoteba ogotari gochia ase ogotema obochenu bw'endagera ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 12.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha kusanyiko la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kojikera ekaunti yabo tebia kubera okoboria ase amagenderero yabo.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Laikipia County to register their children at the nearest public school under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya mchana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: IEBC nigo egokang'a abana batari chinsukuru ase Laikipia County gochia gokwandika abana babo ase chinsukuru chia serikari chire habe goetera ogosomera chinsukuru chia sekondari chia bwerere.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Nandi County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this January.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giobosae aaria ekaonti ya Nandi kwa amorokererigua ya okorwania na okoragania eng'atiato.

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejea kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Abisi y'Auditor-General orure oyera obwati amarago yokoroisia oboteneneri y'ekipasi e Kwale.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Baringo County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DPP omwegere motokisti na abantochenu Baringo County obekeire etiire obisaini gotanda gojegwara wateri gose omonto omurwe gokonyera oborwaire bwa mobasekano gopepekei gokonyera gojungwaya.

English: Acquire knowledge on mushroom farming by getting into workshops aimed at farmers and business farmers.
Kiswahili: Pata maarifa juu ya kilimo cha uyoga kwa kuingia kwenye warsha zinazolenga wakulima na wakulima wa biashara.
Ekegusii: Nyora obomanyi bwaime ase oboremi bwamoba as ogosoa amasomo arengete abaremi na abaremi bebiasara.

English: malaria vaccine that was tried in Kenya has beed confirmed by WHO
Ekegusii: Eriogo ri'esosera erio riatemetwe Kenya riancheranirwe na WHO

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama ya makazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Ekegusii: Chokoro: DPP okoigora etoigo chokobaa oboraro nechinchera chiokobaonchoreria gochia obogime obuya aaria Laikipia.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for drought in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Chia: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria omosaria (DCI) nkiarogereretie buya chifaeri chiebina goikerania omorakera ase egasi Uasin Gishu.

English: EACC reports 400 active cases and over KSh 28B recovered.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorwania obokengeka (EACC) kiamanyirie igoro yebina 400 bigendererete kotini n goetania chisiringi chibirion 28 chiairaniigwe.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Machakos County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba maombi ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Echumi riabeene ry'amasomo ryabaisa abana baria bare nokogania Machakos County kw'oborwa kw'okorwa kwa ribaga ticha.

English: EACC invites residents of Tana River County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: EACC yachakire abamenyi batana river kwerikia buna baa korwa ase amagenderero ao erinde korwania chikurio chia mweri.

English: Search where tea is groŵn and produced by many farmers. This reduces cost of transporting and market access to small scale farmers.
Kiswahili: Tafuta mahali ambapo chai ni groŵn na kuzalishwa na wakulima wengi. Hii inapunguza gharama ya usafirishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima wadogo.
Ekegusii: Rigia komanya ase chiafukado chiria chachoririrwe na goatananwa as chigotoka na kogorwa ase ebirengo ebi'nene. Eye nekonnabiogo kwororobia engencho ya oogosoa echiro ase abaremi bebirengo ebike.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Marsabit County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 11.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Nairobi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DPP ewizara yobotugi obaboririe abamotokisi na abachenu ase Nairobi Ekaunti korwa chindagera chia mobaso kera rituko ase aborokigwa chirifu chimii inye goetera amariko amayia gokeani enchara na gokonya abaremi basaywe.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Homa Bay County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiabasigari kiaboririe abamenyi korwa Homa Bay kobwaterana korenda abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Nyamira County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii ya Kenya nebangete oyera korigeria keboyia chingaki abanto babwenerete korwa isiko kogenda chinka aaria ID ekiagera oborendi bwabeire buya ake Turkana.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Taita-Taveta County on progress of county development projects this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika wilaya hii mwezi Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire chiobisi chiay3 ime ya Taita-Taveta nakobria abamenyi gwesokia naboria obokoreri gose ekaunti gotoka no oborwaire bwa etureti ya kebaki.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Marsabit County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo yebiombe biegesiasa orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura ya Marsabit koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia ayabarigete boyia via SMS kwa 70000 koba goetera okoreta abanto.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: NTSA kiborire abamenyi ase Tharaka-Nithi koba maiso erio kwenekia obokoreri obwasioku.

English: addition; Inadequate market information resulting to limited market access and narrow ... agricultural, mineral, natural and foresty resources; (iii) ...
