English: The Kenyan government will construct three dams in West Pokot Turkana and Marsabit to address water scarcity Counties must identify suitable sites for the dams by next week Completion is expected by June 2020
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya itajenga mabwawa matatu huko Pokot Magharibi Turkana na Marsabit ili kukabiliana na uhaba wa maji.
Ekegusii: Serikali ya Kenya itakusimba maiko matatu mwa West Pokot Turkana na Marsabit kusindika uchafu wa amache Maeneo yametokuwa na entonu yako yametokana na maiko hayo yametokuwa na echuma ebuagi 2020 itakokoma

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Busia County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'Obobari - Ekitengo kiobobari bwa abakungu nigo egokora omonyo abamama abanyamwaka ase Busia kaunti buna okorwa ase oborwaro bwa abamama abanyamwaka nigo obwate obonyinge bwa chigari ase chinsitichiusoni chiabarai.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kisii County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire abanto bon Kisii County baborigwe koenana amang'ana obogaang a via bokurumi bonded EACC erio obeke amang'ana ao yobokurumi.

English: KEMRI announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Kericho County starting this May.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuanzia Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egosoka obokonyo bwa NHIF/SHA ase abamenyi ba Kericho County gosekerera ase omotienyi 5.

English: EACC reminds residents of Siaya County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: EACC oboririe abamenyi yekaunti ya siaya gotuka kuerikia erio gotingia obokoreri.

English: Security Sector Counter Violent Extremism partners held public forums in Mapenya and Mkunumbi to build resilience and counter extremist messaging.
Kiswahili: Washirika wa Sekta ya Usalama wa Kupambana na Vurugu za Kidini walifanya mijadala ya umma huko Mapenya na Mkunumbi ili kujenga ustahimilivu na ujumbe wa kukabiliana na itikadi kali.
Ekegusii: Ensemo yoborendi ase okobwaterana korwana nobokebago bwogosaria amongo koba ekabago gikoruta chipomu mbagete nechinkwana nabanainchi aaria Mapenya na Mkunumbi kobaa chinguru gotenena na korwania obokebago bwogosaria amongo goetera ogotoma amang'ana ameng'e esimi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Laikipia County to a free training on fertiliser application this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwoboremi na obokori bwemichie nigo bogoteba abaremi ase ekaunti ya Laikipia gochia ase ogosemia okobwatekanu bwoboremi ase ogotumia chifetira ase omotienyi 1.

English: By 1 month ago Premium New push for universal social security policy Push for a transformative universal social security policy in Kenya, advocating for a system that provides retirement benefits to all citizens, including the vast informal sector.
Kiswahili: Kufikia mwezi mmoja uliopita Premium New push for universal social security policy Push for a transformative universal social insurance policy in Kenya, kuhimili mfumo ambao hutoa faida za kustaafu kwa raia wote, ikiwa ni pamoja na sekta kubwa isiyo rasmi.
Ekegusii: Nyuma yomotienyi oyomo oetire okonacha kwoborendi ase obogotu nakorwa ogosegeta ase amaonchoreria abene ase omoroberio bwabagotu,  Nagosegeta amaonchoreria abene ayuo araenekie ekwirikia ase bonsi ase omoroberio bwabagotu nonya mbaria batari ase emwremo yeserekari korikigwa bene.

English: Attention maize farmers The Kenyan government has enacted an immediate ban on maize imports due to health concerns regarding mycotoxins This will help improve local maize prices
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mahindi waangalifu Serikali ya Kenya imepiga marufuku mara moja uagizaji wa mahindi kutoka nje kutokana na wasiwasi wa kiafya kuhusu sumu ya mycotoxins Hii itasaidia kuboresha bei ya mahindi nchini.
Ekegusii: Egetuma gusiiro, serikali ya Kenya tayiyo kusinyiira kuhara amagori egetuma kwa kinyo kwa kumwana kwa mycotoxins kwa kinyo kwa gosiira oyera amagori egetuma wa gusiiro

English: NPS alerts residents of Garissa County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: NPS yasemirie abamenyi boGarissa bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu gosoa ebiombe biobosaria gose goetera goaka esimi.

English: KNEC calls on the community in Bungoma County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KNEC yerekera egonde bekaunti ya Bungoma kobeka bosio okorwani kwa amagancha ase egera gacha abwekaine bagosomera.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Okorari: Direktorati ya Omosaria Oboitaai (DCI) nkiarogereretie okorari ogochaki ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetani Kiambu.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Makueni County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Chuma chokonya Kenya inao manyia bari batarareirwe na igoro yogokorer abande bobe ase Makueni County na nchera ende yonsi kore na enamba yesimi yogokonya GBV yose yonsi kore.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nakuru County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Medical Association nigo kigoibokia abanto ase Nakuru County mbu ogosaria oboisi bwa dialysis bwa gokonywa nigo bwakorwa ase chisenta chiochigirwe.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Management Information System KIAMIS is being scaled up for a digitized and transparent agricultural sector Stay informed on updates and usage
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Taarifa za Usimamizi wa Kilimo wa Kenya KIAMIS unakuzwa kwa ajili ya sekta ya kilimo ya kidijitali na uwazi Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu masasisho na matumizi.
Ekegusii: Sistema ya Taarifa ya Kilimo ya Kenya KIAMIS inaongezwa kwa sekta ya kilimo ya digital na transparent Bera kuhusu mazungumzo na matumizi

English: DPP calls on the community in Makueni County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: DPP b erekera egonde ase Makueni gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: World Health Organization approves rollout of Lenacapavir (LEN), an injectable HIV preventive medication; Kenya selected as one of the nine early adopter countries
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni laidhinisha utekelezaji wa Lenacapavir (LEN), dawa ya kuzuia VVU inayoweza kutiwa sindano; Kenya imechaguliwa kuwa mojawapo ya nchi tisa zilizotumia dawa hizo mapema
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioborwaria bw’ense WHO giancheranire okoenana Lenacapavir (LEN), esindani yogotanga Enyamoreo. Kenya yachorirwe koba eyemo yechinse kianda chiogochakerwa.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions and share knowledge about potato and sweet potato production for sustainable food systems
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa kilimo biashara wamehimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala na kubadilishana maarifa kuhusu uzalishaji wa viazi na viazi vitamu kwa mifumo endelevu ya chakula.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria na abakolwa kwa agribusiness kusindwa kuchokogaba na kuchokokoria kuhusu uchokoria wa nyarogi na nyarogi za mungai kwa system za endagera za kumwana

English: Feed your baby when they show hunger signs, not on a strict schedule. Watch for cues.
Kiswahili: Lisha mtoto wako anapoonyesha dalili za njaa, si kwa ratiba kali. Kuwa mwangalifu kwa vidokezo.
Ekegusii: Rageri abana ekero baorokire ebimanyerio bia enchara, tari kobakongeri chinsa chia endagera Egera ebimanyererio

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Vihiga County that adult literacy classes registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ewizara y'Emasomo nigo egokomera abanyabanto ase Vihiga County buna okoregisita amasomo abakuru nigo kwarukire ase omotienyi 10.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Enyaroka: COMESA egokora omotito bwokwomanya okorenda ebisero na oborwa ase abanyamwaka ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Laikipia County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Nabwetigo: Kenya Red Cross yarabwatigwa okobeta etugo chisindani aaria Laikipia County amaumuntia May.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Busia County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wananchi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya umakini wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross kisemirwe abamenyi Busia County koba maiso ase engencho yobwoba bwokoruta chipomu.

English: All gatherings, sports,celebrtions and worship gatherings have been suspended. Religious meetings may continue with their worshing programs if they observe prevention measures. Schools will also remain open if they observe protocols but sports have been suspended.
Ekegusii: Emesangererekano yonsi, chigosori, emeyega amo na emesangererekano yechikanisa yatenenigwe. Chikanisa nabo chikoba nesangererekano yamasabo onye rioka chikobeka esabuni yogosibia amaboko. Chisukuru nabo chigotigara koigorwa korende chigosori gati ye chisukuru chiatenenigwe.

English: Poor handling causes stress and injury. Use non-slip floors and proper restraint equipment.
Kiswahili: Ushughulikiaji mbaya husababisha msongo wa mawazo na majeraha. Tumia sakafu zisizoteleza na vifaa sahihi vya kuzuia.
Ekegusii: Ekero etugo ekoirwa ase enchera etari engiya nigo ekoba nobwoba, ogochandeka ebirengererio an koumia. Beka etugo aase atari noboterere na yesibe buya.

English: Huduma Kenya announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya yatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya yachakirie oyera mara gatano na rimo aye korwara e-Citizen registration korwa Elgeyo-Marakwet Ekaunti.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches an October awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio ogotang'ana na ogosaria oborwari (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo koretie omoroberio bwo ogotema obwenge igoro yoborwari bwa sukari ase omotienyi 10, ase ekaunti ya Samburu.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Siaya County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eribokire abakoreri boboremi ase Siaya County igoro yomoganda ogokorwa ogwogoteba abanto buna baranyare gochora chindui na chindwanyi.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Nairobi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KALRO egokora amasomo yechinchera chiamo chiokogwata amache ase abaremi ba Nairobi County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Nakuru County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ogore: NDMA ariakorera egonde omosiongoroko ekaonti ya Nakuru ebuagi.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Garissa County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera abamenyi bensemo eyuo ya Garissa okoboria amakora omosiongoroko okoboria chifisi chiobomo bwechinse okoboria ase ogokurerwa igoro yogoakwa chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya.

English: Locust affected countries are encouraged to implement the recommended strategies for locust management and prevention discussed at the Desert Locust Control Committee meeting in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Nchi zilizoathiriwa na nzige zimehimizwa kutekeleza mikakati iliyopendekezwa ya kudhibiti na kuzuia nzige iliyojadiliwa katika kikao cha Kamati ya Kudhibiti Nzige wa Jangwani jijini Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Maendeleo yale yenye ngige yamekujulishwa kuhakikisha watafsiri na kutekeleza mifumo yale yameletwa kuhusu utawala na kujenga ngige yaliyotolewa katika mifelde ya uhusiano na ngige ya miji katika Nairobi

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased malaria risk in Garissa County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Garissa na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Omotuki omoroberio bwogoaka: Eserekari ya Kenya Medical Association yasemirie ugaga bucha obokoreri bo Garissa County na yasemirie egonde koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri ugaga obokwerwa goseta nga obokoreri boikera bonsi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Kajiado County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi inawakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: Abisi yomonene bworogongo yasegetire abamenyi Kajiado gotanga yose gotumia bobe ekero abasikari bagokora emesako ekio kiagerete abanto gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio na amaochorerio yobogori.

English: DPP warns residents of West Pokot County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: DPP yasemerie abamenyi obochikuru West Pokot omoroberio bwense ogosegeta abanto komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura.

English: IGAD has issued warning on poor food quality in African Countries. Its data confirms that 71% in AGAD Union do not have enough food
Ekegusii: IGAD yerure ogokorera igoro yendagera etari engiya ase orogongo rwa Afrika. Chisabu chiaye chiaorokirie ng'a emerongo ebere na eyemo ase emià yobomo bwense chia IGAD mbabwati ndagera eisaine

English: Maximize your returns from coffee by understanding market demands, reducing post-harvest losses, and exploring value addition opportunities.
Kiswahili: Ongeza mapato yako kutoka kwa kahawa kwa kuelewa mahitaji ya soko, kupunguza hasara baada ya mavuno, na kuchunguza fursa za kuongeza thamani.
Ekegusii: Kinia okonyora kwao korwa chikagwa ase okomanya echiro yaye, gokenia ogosareka kwerigesa riaya, na korogia buna oragese obuya bwaye.

English: Fix the future! Join automotive repair courses.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mwisho: Sera ya elimu jumuishi sasa inashughulikia taasisi zote za TVET "kila mwanafunzi anakaribishwa!" kila mwanafunzi anakaribishwa!
Ekegusii: Agacha obogima bwa motwe! Soa chikosi chiokorosia chirori.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Bomet County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Bomet na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Omoigwano bwobuto bwechiombe: KEMSA ekureire igoro yoboremo bwechiombe bwa Rift Valley Fever ase Bomet County na ekobaboria abanainchi konyora amanyia ase abakora bwechiombe abanyinge abare ase oboroberio bwechiombe.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Marsabit County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: COMESA nigo egokora omotangano ogokonyora abaremi ase okorora ebirio biarengwa ase Marsabit County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Kakamega County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokorenda obosombi (Auditor-General) yaboririe abamenyi gotindeka Kakamega giasabire abanto bono koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire giokorenda e-Citizen.

English: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Use a VPN if you must connect. Most free networks are not secure."
Kiswahili: Epuka kutumia mtandao wa umma wa Wi-Fi kwa ajili ya shughuli za benki. Tumia VPN ikiwa unahitaji kuungana. Mtandao mwingi wa bure hauko salama".
Ekegusii: Erende korwa eWi-Fi yabanto bonsi kobeka chibesa ebengi. Tumia a VPN onye gokonyara gosoa ime. Chinetewaki chinyinge chia bosaare nchibwati borendi buya.

English: CDC advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: CDC egokana abanto ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County bagabie ogokuria omunyu na esukari erio gotang'a oborwae obo bwo gokonywa.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Homa Bay County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaita watu wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: Chung'ororo cha Kikundi cha Mabisho ya Kijamii kuna kubatanisha mikundi ya mwanamke na watu wa Homa Bay kubatanisha kuhusu uchungu wa jinsia na kuta maendeleo ya nyumba inayofaa

English: COMESA urges rice growers in Bungoma County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: COMESA igoherania abaroreri bihugu ya kigana kona Bungoma gukoresha ebitungithia ebikozwe neibere kurogotia engoro ya fall armyworm negete kugaba ebigambo byabo bwambere mukisebe ichi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragete abanainchi ba Nyandarua County batagokua obororo bwo gochia boka, na gochia ase ogotema okogwa amagenderero amabere ase ogotebania obororo bwa chimbere.

English: EACC urges residents of Kitui County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) nkorosia kere nkere nabatuki baye gokemanyia na korwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokaonti ya kitui.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Bomet County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekeire oboremi na obokonyi bwebituma (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoibokia abanto ba Bomet County buna oboremi bwo gokomera amete na ebimeri biongo nigo bokoongera oboremi bwa kera na kera.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Echibere: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure ogokurera ase okobwatanigwa abanto na SIM-swap chikokorera abarwaire ya Samburu.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Samburu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: KTDA neisabire abaremi ase ekaonti ya Samburu gochanda ebituma biokorora emegondo erio gokeani ogotemeka kwemegondo gose ogotemeka kwemegondo ase ogokonya goikera amang'ana amayia amachera.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Uasin Gishu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kenya Dairy Board nekoribokia ababori bebitugo ase Uasin Gishu County gochia goetia etugo chiabo chinchera chiokobeta ase chinchera chiorigirwe gosegeta oborwaire bwembori.

English: DPP urges residents of Meru County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi buekaunti ya Meru kojikia buna obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chikorua chochorekore chokunywa kuenda kuchukana chochorekore.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Wajir County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorora na okogenderera obwarwaire nigo gogosaba abanto ba Wajir County goika gochera gochera amache ayio abwate oborwaire bwokwomoka kwa obwarwaire bwa measles (ebimera) obo bwarengire.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Makueni County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo erangerete abanto ba Makueni County batagaka oborwàire bwa obong'aini na gochia ase ogotebia oborwàire bwa obong'aini obo bwo bwerere.

English: A partnership initiative is advancing the implementation of Kenya’s National Strategy to Counter Violent Extremism, prioritizing prevention measures and strengthening public awareness.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa ushirikiano unaendeleza utekelezaji wa Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Kenya wa Kupambana na Ukatili wa Kimkakati, ukipa kipaumbele hatua za kuzuia na kuimarisha ufahamu wa umma.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokobwaterana nogendererete goikerania emeroberio emonene ya'Kenya igoro yogokinana nobokebago bwogosaria obongo goetera amasomo amabe, orenfgete buna obokebago boratangwe na gokongia emeroberio yokomanyia abanto amang'ana.

English: Explore loan schemes tailored for expansion of enterprise from Kenya Post Office Savings Bank. Compare interest rates and terms.
Kiswahili: Chunguza mikakati ya mkopo iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya upanuzi wa biashara kutoka Kenya Post Office Savings Bank. Linganisha viwango vya riba na masharti.
Ekegusii: Rigia komanya igoro yamakobeso ayio arakonye gokinia oboonchoreria bwao korwa ebengi ya Kenya Post Office Savings Bank. Renga komanya igoro yechibesa chiria ogakana as ogokobesa korwa asebare na amachiko abo.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: KICD eragete abana batari amasomoni ase Lamu County gochia goseka obonyamasi bwebursary mbere yengaki eragete ase ogoteba bursary.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces SHA registration for residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County starting this December.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuanzia Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo erorete okorangerigwa kwa SHA ase abanto barenge Elgeyo-Marakwet County gochaka omotienyi 12 eyi.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Tharaka-Nithi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: HELB eekurire omogwati na omokorojaji ari Tharaka-Nithi okuririra omwana omwiririka 116.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches an August awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Red Cross nigo kiochakigwe omoroberio bwokomanya abanto ase oborwa bwa sukari (diabetes) ase omotienyi 8 goetera ase Taita-Taveta County.

English: IPOA urges the community in Homa Bay County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Ekegusii: IPOA atige egonde ase Homa Bay County ase okobagera mangana ao ariabonge nabi na bao bensoni goeera okubira chinkwana ase esimi okubuokera.

English: Notice: IEBC launches community-based development programmes in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Egekoro: IEBC giaansire egonde gokonya ase okobwatwa kwabakagerwa abwo babwatetetwe chibicha buna bare komorwania egonde aaria Narok.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Nandi County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Ekegusii: omogabana bw'ekendia ya kenya orure okoboria ase abamenyi bekaunti ya nandi kwerikia mabw'omwiti gwekaunti yabo bera tebia gwekaunti yabo.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: IEBC egwete emeremo emia yobokori bwa chigari ase ekitengo gia obokori ase Mandera County.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Kericho County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: KMTC egera endorero baria bare nokogania ase Kericho County ao ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria egera ticha sora.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Kakamega County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Ekegusii: Kenya Gazette yarurire abamenyi gotindeka Kakamega gindigwa ase intaneti ntsa e-Citizen portal nende gindigwa ogosaba e-Citizen.

English: DP Kindiki Urges Tolerance for New IEBC Commissioners, Warns Opposition.
Kiswahili: DP Kindiki Aomba Uvumilivu kwa Kamishna Mpya wa IEBC, Anaonya Upinzani.
Ekegusii: omokonyi  bwomorai bwense Kindikì orure okoboria abakomisona abayia koba abaremereri. nakorwa ogokurera ase abarai bokoamereria eserekari.

English: Be innovative in fish pond farming aimed at checking climate change and drought. Introduce drought resistance crops and align farming with technology.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mbunifu katika ufugaji wa bwawa la samaki unaolenga kuangalia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na ukame. Anzisha mazao yanayostahimili ukame na uoaanishe kilimo na teknolojia.
Ekegusii: Ogoonchoreria engencho yogokora oboremi bwechinswe chiechindani borengete ogoochoreria kwerire nemechando yaye buna eguragura/eng'era.. Egera igoro ya yembusuro ekoremereria ayio na tekinorogia ase oboremi obwo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) ekobatebria abanto bonsi buna ogosimwa kwa echolera nigo kure ase chinchera chiomobwate chionsi chia Kisumu County ase omotienyi 1.

English: Recent prosecutions of officials show commitment to tackling economic crimes.
Kiswahili: Mashtaka ya hivi karibuni dhidi ya maafisa yanaonyesha kujitolea kwao kukabiliana na uhalifu wa kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Okonacherwa ekina kwa abaofisa bwango iga nekiorokererio giesirikari korwania obosaria bwobogoko bwense.

English: KEPHIS warns sorghum farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokonya abaremi b'amabele ase Murang'a County igoro y'oborwire bw'ebinyamwamu na kobaambia korigia obokonyi bwa hano.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Taita-Taveta County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egosaba omonto omonene orenge na oboremo bwo obwongo ase Taita-Taveta County goika ase chisesheni chio obotumi bwo obwongo chitarie chio obogere.

English: The UN Office of Counter Terrorism emphasizes collaboration with partners to counter evolving tactics.
Ekegusii: Chifisi chiobomo bwechinse (UN) echio chigokinana nobokebago babekire chinguru okobwaterana ase oboamo erio gokinana nechinchera chiobokebago.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises coffee producers in Lamu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo korigia abanyaboremi bwa kofi ase Lamu County gochia gokora ebitwero biabo ase abanyabiasara abare na ebarua yobwate gokora ebitwero, mbere yogocha kwomwaka ogokwomora.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges coffee growers in Kakamega County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bi'oborimi na obokoreri bwetugo nibiororie abanyamwaka bwa kofi ase Kakamega County gochia ase gochia gochia chimbegu chi'oborimi chiekererwe chitaragwata amang'ana erio gokinia amayembe ase omwaka oyu.

English: A multi-agency program enhanced ATPU officers’ capacity in ideological awareness and counterterror response.
Kiswahili: Programu ya mashirika mengi iliongeza uwezo wa maafisa wa ATPU katika ufahamu wa kiibada na kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Oboamo bweitengo ao ao bieserikari mbwakongetie chinuru chiekeombe keria kiabasikari gekorwania gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (ATPU) korora na komanya buna kogosaria ebirengererio nokomenya amo.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Uasin Gishu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: DCI komanyia abanto basabirwe choria gose Uasin Gishu goetera eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi, negetengo kigenderi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges farmers in Wajir County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service korigia abaremi ba Wajir County goika bagende ase ogotigwa oboremi bwa kera na kera bwo ogotebigwa nigo gokonyia goikera chimbura chire gochachauka.

English: KICD encourages residents of Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: KICD okorera abamenyi ba Nyamira County korenda kwerenda amakwania gw'oboronge bw'abamenyi, bera tebia igoro yamachiko yoboronge.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Laikipia County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: NDMA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Laikipia koegerera chinchera chingiya arria ase ebiateko omorero amagoro.

English: Ministry of Housing has not contracted any agents to collect payments for affordable housing units. Application is done through Boma Yangu portal only.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Nyumba haijawapa kazi mawakala wowote wa kukusanya malipo ya nyumba za bei nafuu. Maombi yanafanywa kupitia lango la Boma Yangu pekee.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobokoreri bwabanto nkoinyoria ere abakorogia egasi nga baria bakorigia gosoa ase okwegera mono igoro yamosomo abo nigo agwancherwa na gosoa bosa. Kana monto onde bwensi oragosabe riaki.

English: 2,169 people have been dignozed with Covid 19 virus out from 9,428 people tested translating to 23% of infections. The MoH has confirmed that there is no death regiseterd already.
Kiswahili: Watu 2,169 wamepatikana na virusi vya COVID-19 kutoka kwa watu 9,428 ambao wamechunguzwa na kutafsiri hadi 23% ya maambukizo.
Ekegusii: Abanto 2,169 banyorekanire babwate ebinyinyi bia COVID-19, korwa ase chisampuli 9,428, ekerengo kia abaambokerigwe kere 23%; Ewizara y’Oborwaria yatebire gokwa nkoiyo kwabeire.

English: NPS calls on the community in Mombasa County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: NPS b erekera egonde a Mombasa gose gokorer abande ase esukuru na kereka kinyama kogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru.

English: Using simple hand signs helps babies express needs early, reducing frustration for both caregiver and child.
Kiswahili: Kutumia ishara rahisi za mikono huwasaidia watoto kueleza mahitaji yao mapema, na hivyo kupunguza kuchanganyikiwa kwa mlezi na mtoto.
Ekegusii: Gotumia ebiorokererio bi'amaboko nigo egokonya abana abake komanya eki baganeti bwango, erio gokei obokongu ase omoreri n'omwana .

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Samburu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Echibarasa ya Kenya yabooririe abasi entongori bakansi yogoaka chikura batarere abisi ere ange na IEBC yogoaka komanyekana Samburu.

English: AFA informs horticultural produce farmers in Kericho County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: AFA igo ementie abaremi b'ebirime bia horticulture ase Kericho County igoro y'emigano emia y'okorandia ebirime biabo ase omotienyi 4.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Gotema gwanse gwamo omosaria gweboitaai korure okorese okweta ebesa ase Taita-Taveta korura omweta okoboria gochiako obotikeranu okweta ebesa oboitaai okweta omweta omokorese okweta omweta okweta ebesa oboitaai okweta omokorese okweta okweta omweta omokorese.

English: SHA advises residents of Nakuru County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: SHA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Nakuru bogoria yonsi amasakara aogokora nyuma yechitariki ogosomia buya gochia ogokora emeremo yao nyuma yechitariki ogosomia buya ogokora emeremo yao.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Uasin Gishu County to prepare for possible drought this November.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenywa abanto be Uasin Gishu omorakera omorera November yio.

English: NCPB reminds livestock keepers in Kiambu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: NCPB nkoribokia abanyamwamu ase Kiambu County kobatisa chinyamwamu chiabo ase chinchera chie chigoro chie chinyamwamu erio gokonya obochenu bw'echinyamwamu.

English: KALRO advises milk producers in Baringo County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KALRO egera abeorora amagi akarwi Baringo guserebesa goyitorera mugambwa gotsikitigwate goronga omahera gotegeterikia egisibiti.

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Kiambu County on progress of county development projects this September.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Septemba.
Ekegusii: Eserikari ya omokonyi bwo'morai bwense Auditor-General yababwateranirie abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Kiambu na yasegetire kwebwaterania kwebonyeka amagenderero yabo ykaonti etureti ya kebaki.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): free antenatal care clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera korwa ase SHA (Social Health Authority): ebitaro biokorora abanyamwaka bitorokwe na chigari bitorokwe kera omotienyi 6 ase ebitaro biogotebwa ase Kakamega County.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Siaya County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Ekenya Red Cross ekenene kiaboririe abamenyi ta Siaya County kobwaterana korenda abarendi boborendi chingaki korenda komweseka emwendo ekenene.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Wajir County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: DPP inao ngeria bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Wajir County, na enao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe nchera ende yonsi kore ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe.

English: IEBC invites residents of Kajiado County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Kajiado County kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: IEBC osegeche abamenyi bekaunti ya kajiado kichimbebe na oborori korwa ebirengererio biosegeta obokoreri obuya kiechombe nechimbebe na obochori kiabororirie abamenyi.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Wajir County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuwaajiri wasimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waweze kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Wajir koegerera chinchogu chakoruegwa kwa obokoreri obuya, kubera tebia kwa obokoreri obuya.

English: NPS reminds residents of Embu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ukame.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Embu kojikira amagenderero yebotambe ase omorakera omorokoro.

English: KICD calls on the community in Narok County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KICD b erekera egonde a Narok County b erekere ebikoru binde bionsi bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura, gacha igoro chisukuru chikuru.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kakamega County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Chikorikia choria chia Kenya komanyia abakenya baria banhete ense yabo Kakamega gochia eripoti ase porisi stesheni ende yonsi, negetengo kiabeen kegosugurikia buna ogotibongwa.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekerechi ya Kenya Medical Association eragete omonto omonene orenge ase obororo bwobwongo ase Homa Bay County goetera ekaunti eyio goetera namba ya simu ya obwongo etari yogocha chinsara.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Kisii County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: IEBC yekorenda abamenyi Kisii County bono obokoreri bweserikari giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Ekegusii: Echumbe ekenya oboririe okoyera omoroberio buma chindagera chigoonhorerigwa chuma chindagera chogoonya chwekaunti ya isiolo.

English: Notice: OGP opens voter education centres in Garissa County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano: OGP okoigora emesangerekano yogosomia buna chikura chigoakwa Garissa chikuru chisukuru November.

English: Announcement of Minitry of Health, private sector, NGOs pledge to strengthen school meals, market nutrition, and community gardens.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Wizara ya Afya, sekta binafsi, mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yaahidi kuimarisha milo shuleni, lishe ya sokoni, na bustani za jamii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria korwa ewizara ya obochenu, chisegita chia abanyene, na ebiombe bitari ebieserekari barure chiira gotingia chindagera chisukuru, okoragera ase chichiro na okogonkia nase chinka

English: IPOA calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: IPOA berekera egonde ase Nyeri County ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore na b erekera enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Embu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa kiararirie abantu ba Embu County korengana kwa forum yobw'omwega bw'omwega kwa bera tebia kwa kwereria kwa devolution.

English: AFA promotes organic farming among farmers in Kisii County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia AFA nkogenderera gokora amabera okorora oborimi bwobwoni ase abarimi ba Kisii County ase omotienyi o omotienyi 10 bwo ogokonya abanto goikara ase oborimi obo goetera egechera kia ogokonya ebi binto bitoe goikara ase amachiko amabe ya chimbura.

English: Adapt driving techniques for rainy season conditions.
Kiswahili: Badilisha mbinu za kuendesha gari kwa ajili ya hali ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso buna okogendia erori chingaki chiembura ekero epara ere entereru, ritaturi rireo na kegendia erori ng'ora ng'ora.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a milk collection centre in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KALRO egokonyora ekero giokonyora amate ase Busia County ase omotienyi 6.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Kiambu County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za eneo hilo kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NDMA b erekera abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kiambu koegerera chinchogu cha omosiongoroko.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Uasin Gishu County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service kigokora abanyaboremi ase ekaunti ya Uasin Gishu goikerania gochora ase ogotenywa okwo obwange erio gocha ase ogotenywa okwo okwamasomo amabori.

English: IEBC advises students in Kakamega County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Ekegusii: IEBC oboririe endorero bekaunti ya Kakamega gindigwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chibesa chiogogokonya gosoma oigoirwe ase abana bechiyunifasiti.

English: NCPB urges dairy cows farmers in Taita-Taveta County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Ekegusii: NCPB nigo erorete abaremi banchara ase Taita-Taveta County koboria amang'ana ase chinyamuchera chire oborwa gochia ase ofisi yoboragori bwe chinyamuchera erio konyora obokonyi konyora oborwa bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Narok County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Ekegusii: Egisera y'okorora chindwara na okogokia nigo egosaba abareeri ase Narok County korigisita karia kadi ya afya ya mama na omwana buna ekerongo kye kampeni ya afya ya mama ya omotienyi 1.

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Ekegusii: Okororie: KNEC okoigora omoroberio bwogosegeta okorosia amasomo abeene egedichitari ase abana ba Marsabit County.

English: TSC offers training programs for teachers on effective digital pedagogies for modern classrooms.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene kia abarimu (TSC) nkorwa kere omoroberio bwogosomia abarimi igoro yogosomia ase enchera yegedichitri ase abana bebirasi bia bono.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of West Pokot County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kierekere abamenyi korwa West Pokot korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro kwa'amanani kwa'ebirengererio omosiongoroko.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Tana River County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo bwe' Biama bia Siasa ogokire abanto ase ekaunti ya Tana River okonene okoreta abanto korwa ebirengererio buna amachiko ase esagati.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) as defined by FAO comprises of three main pillars: 1) sustainably increasing agricultural productivity and incomes, 2) adapting ...
Ekegusii: Oboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura (CSA) buna ekeombe ekene kiendagera giense (FAO) nigo kerengete chisoro isato 1) oboremi bwokwegendereria obwo bokogesa rigesa na 2) ebitoki goetera goetera ogoonchoka gochia oboremi bwabono...

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Taita-Taveta County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: Esekretari ya TVET okorwa obosae bose Taita-Taveta ase ekaunti okoboria okobora amakora ao ao chiense kwebitabu bwa voter registration okobeka ebango enene.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Nakuru County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuanzia Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bw'Oborwaria - Ekitengo kioborwaria bw'obokungu n'abana, nigo korigia obokonyi bw'ebitengo biokorwaria chimpio (dialysis) ase abanto b'ase Nakuru County, gosekerera omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Enyanya: Eminisitiri yechisemi yanchwire omoroberio omoyia obwogoteka na obworeti ase esukuru yebichuma (vocational centre) eria eri ase Homa Bay County.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kilifi County this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto Ministeri yobwogosomia bwomonto ogokora kere omoroberio bwogosomia igoro yamachiko yoboronge mokwani Kilifi esagati.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Kajiado County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo abasomi ba yunibasiti (Universities Fund) nigo kigochania abana baria batari amasomoni ase Kajiado County goikena ase eprogramu yechisomo chiabakuru goetera obokonyi bwebesa bwa bursary.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nyamira County that free primary education registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Universities Fund ekobasoka abaibori ase Nyamira County buna okoregiswa kwegosoma kwa primary okwa bwerere kwarigirwe omotienyi 1.

English: IPOA reminds mobile money users in Narok County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: IPOA agokorire abasikari ebesa bokomweta Narok County komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu naro agokorekeka ase chiamate chiao gochia ase omogambi gose abasikari kegima kubera SIM-swap ekiobosaria.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Ekegusii: Ogokonya: NTSA ogokonya ogokonya gweserikari gochando goikera ebesa gochando gochanda abamenyi gwekaunti ya Isiolo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kericho County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: IEBC yarure okoboria ase abanto go Kericho kaunti koba birori ase okoenekia oborendi ase bamenyete riete.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Chinga: DCI kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebiateko omorero ogwateka e Kakamega County.

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Bungoma County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this May.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorwania obokurumi ime yense kiarure okoboria gochia ase chikaunti go Bungoma kobeka amachiko amakong'u gotanga ogokorera abande bobe na korwa obosemia ase abana baria bakoreirwe bobe amaumuntia.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Trans Nzoia County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: NTSA nereka kwa nyama nese nese nese choria kwa Trans Nzoia okonyora obokonyi ase gokonywa GBV 1195.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Nyamira County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Ekegusii: IPOA b erekera egonde a Nyamira gose gokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na gokera nyinyi gose gochisukuru.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Baringo County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragire abamenyi ba Baringo County gocha ase ogosimwa oborwaire bwa abanto bonse goetera obogere, erio gwetanga oborwaire obo oboigo bwo konyarwa.

English:
Feeling low?  Reaching for alcohol wont lift you up  its a depressant that can make things worse.

Kiswahili: Kujihisi umevunjika moyo? Ukijitahidi kupata kileo, hutapata kitulizo - ni dawa ya kushuka moyo ambayo inaweza kufanya mambo yawe mabaya zaidi. Chagua uponyaji wa kweli: zungumza na mshauri, jiunge na kikundi cha msaada, au utafute msaada.

English: Application of GM technology has helped farmers earn money by issuing seedlings resilient to pests that affect food crop in the field.
Kiswahili: Utumiaji wa teknolojia ya GM umesaidia wakulima kupata pesa kwa kutoa miche inayostahimili wadudu wanaoathiri mazao ya chakula shambani.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio o tekinorochia ya GM okonyire abaremi korosia chibesaase okobanyorera embusuro yechintetere chiria chikoamereria ebichuni biria bigosaria ebimeri ase okobiria buna endagera yaboase omogondo.

English: Announcement promoting community-based mental health outreach as anchor to Kenya's Mental Health Awareness Month theme of "Community for Support".
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kukuza uhamasishaji wa afya ya akili unaozingatia jamii kama mhimili wa kaulimbiu ya Mwezi wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili nchini Kenya ya "Jumuiya ya Usaidizi".
Ekegusii: Okorari gosegeta amaegerio igoro yobochenu bwobongo erengete amariko amamwamu kero kiomotienyi bwa obosemi ase obochenu bwobongo orogongo rwa Kenya na "Ekeombe ekenene Kiobokonyi"

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens the electoral calendar centres in Wajir County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir mwezi Juni huu.
Ekegusii: Kubochori: Kenya Gazette okoigora chintunda chiobochori chime cha Wajir ekaunti ebuagi.

English: NPS warns residents of Kirinyaga County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: NPS ogokurerwa abamenyi bekaunti ya Kirinyaga kwarwetwe gosorora omorakera omene riete.

English: KICD urges residents of Mombasa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kutuma maombi ya bursari kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: KICD nkorosia abanto bwa Mombasa County gochia goseka chibesa chiokosomera (bursary) mbere y'erite riokwera erio banyare gochera ase omorego ogokuria abana ase chisukuru.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Machakos County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechichai ya Kenya egokora abaremi ase Machakos County gosegeria okoregisita ase obotebia obwogotigwa gochia ase obotebia bwechiagera bwechiagera.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Korwania: IPOA okoigora aiga ekegendo giokorwania obokengeka (GBV) ekaonti ya Nandi.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Isiolo County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
