Ekegusii: Chokoro: Kenya Gazette okoigora ekeyia chikorwa chenya chokorera chikio ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay.

English: These violations have occurred amid deep political divisions and the fragmentation of state institutions, fostering a pervasive culture of impunity that undermines media freedom, journalists' safety, and the public's right to information.
Kiswahili: Ukiukaji huu umetokea katikati ya mgawanyiko mkubwa wa kisiasa na mgawanyiko wa taasisi za serikali, na kukuza utamaduni ulioenea wa kutokujali unaodhoofisha uhuru wa vyombo vya habari, usalama wa waandishi wa habari, na haki ya umma ya kupata habari.
Ekegusii: Okobunwa kwa amachiko aya nigo kwabete ase eminano endito yegesiasa nokobagekana na gotakora emeremo amo ase chinsemo chionsi chiserikari, naigo korwa ribaga ase chingencho chiegesaku kogendereria obosareku ayio undermines media freedom, journalists' safety, and the public's right to information.

English: Notice from KEMRI: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Omonwa korwa KEMRI: okogabera abaana endagera yobonyinge ase chinyagitari nigo egokora chinsiku chionsi chia omotienyi 11 ase chinyagitari chire chigabere ase Uasin Gishu County.

English: NCPB warns sorghum farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene giokogura chindagera (NCPB) nkogaburia abaremi bamasoya ase Uasin Gishu County igoro yechinyamuchera chigokora obobe na gokora omotwe bwo ogotaboka chinchera chokobagoria chinchaki.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Vihiga County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire abamenyi gwesokia naVihiga ya gosanga nobokorekanu chiobisi chiababerego.

English: NDMA urges the community in Nandi County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: NDMA nayemera egonde aiga ekaonti ya Nandi naichuo naintwe ase ogoikera abanto isiko gokwanerana (Nyumba Kumi) korwania obokengeka.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Meru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Obotungati bwe Ebisero na Oborogi bwe Ebitugo nigo bogokora omokutano ogwogoteba buna chindagera chiokorwa nyuma yechisero ase abanyamogondo ba Meru County omotienyi o omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Nabwetia: Ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe ekeyia okoigora ekegikia ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe e-Citizen okorikia buna Narok County.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Baringo County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo korigia abaremi ase Baringo County gochia ase ogotuma chimbegu chiatangirwe chitaragwata amayira mbere yechinsa chia omotienyi 3 chia ogotuma.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya keriagwo abakoriria abakorimo Kirinyaga County okobwatanigwa abanto okobwana okoyemanyia amangana ase embeo kiarure ogokurera abasikari igoro yegokoreri gia morero gacha gosiira gacha gokurira abakorimo abakorimo.

English: IPOA urges the public in Bomet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: IPOA baboririe abamenyi nchiria Bomet tobaisa okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera yao yebayetebie.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Bomet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: KTDA egokonya abaremi ba Bomet County gotanga ebisasani bia fall armyworm kare na kare goetera okonyora ebitiba ebiarokirwe mbere yechingaki chiokomera chia omotienyi 10.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Mombasa County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this October.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Egetang'ani kia Oboremi na Chindagera (AFA) nigo korigia abaremi ba Mombasa County ase amasomo atari gochiwa chibesa igoro yogoika amangana (record keeping) ase abaremi omotienyi 10.

English: KEMRI launches a September awareness campaign on safe water storage across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo ekwate omoroberio bwogosomora abanto ase obwate bwa amache amaya ase omotienyi 9 ime ya Vihiga County.

English: Thwe launch of farming to win a trophy in trial phase, and there after to expand up to the schools in the arid areas
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa kwoboremi bwamatemu yokorwanerera ebikombe as okwegera, na koranda goika chisukuru ase eroro

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Nandi County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Registrar ya Biombe bia Siasa okoririre abanrto naba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi bogoria ID yago ngoro gokona eketanaga gokona ebirengererio bine na amatoro ya amatuko ya koreta abanrto.

English: The Angololo dam project will supply water and irrigation to 270 000 people and benefit farmers in Busia and Bungoma counties in Kenya and districts in Eastern Uganda
Kiswahili: Mradi wa bwawa la Angololo utasambaza maji na umwagiliaji kwa watu 270,000 na kunufaisha wakulima katika kaunti za Busia na Bungoma nchini Kenya na wilaya za Mashariki mwa Uganda.
Ekegusii: Mwami wa Angololo kutege amache na kutege kumwami kwa 270 000 abakorioshi na kutege kumwami kwa abakorioshi wa shamba kwa Busia na Bungoma kwa Kenya na magokoro kwa boganda bwa Kusini

English: KRA advises residents of Kiambu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Ekegusii: KRA yasabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kiambu batarere abisi ere ange na koerikia Huduma Centre yogoaka chikura.

English: FAO urges dairy cows farmers in Nakuru County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: FAO nogo egosegeta abanyamwaka b'ebisena biokonyua amata ase Nakuru County kobwata ebisena biabo ase ebitari biokobwata ebiro biokobwata, konyora amangana ayo okorora oborwaire bwa anthrax.

English: Mental well-being is essential for a productive and healthy workplace. Prioritize mental health just as you would physical health.
Kiswahili: Ustawi wa akili ni muhimu kwa mahali pa kazi penye tija na afya. Panga afya ya akili kama vile unavyoweza kuipa kipaumbele afya ya mwili.
Ekegusii: Okoba buya kw'obongo nigo kore okw'engencho gotwara chinsemo chiemeremo chibwate okobioka na afya. Tang'ania afya y'obongo buna oratanganie eya kemobere.

English: DPP warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: DPP yaboririe abamenyi koBaringo kubereka ebesa kwenywa kwenywa na yasemirie abamenyi koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge kabereka ebesa.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kakamega County this March.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso Kenya Gazette giachakirie egetamo giokokomanyia obogaang a Kakamega kiabagafana gikoro.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches community-based development programmes in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Noto: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo bwe' Komiti yebiama bia Siasa yobwakia programu yebiakiriria egonde kwabeire aria ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta.

English: Always ensure to wash clean food containers for the child so as to kill germs
Ekegusii: Botambe sibia na koberia chichupa chia abana na amagonki goita ebinyinyi otaraera omwana endagera

English: DPP urges residents of Bungoma County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Bungoma kojokoliane narebarendi boborendi chingaki bagokora omosiongoroko.

English: Meet with others to build good relationships with people as important for your mental health.
Kiswahili: Kutanika na wengine ili kujenga uhusiano mzuri na watu ambao ni muhimu kwa afya yako ya akili.
Ekegusii: Umerana n’abande erio obe ensemo y’obogisanio obuya. Okoagacha obogisangio obuya n’abanto nigo kore okuya ase afya yao y’obongo.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Kirinyaga County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: KNEC egokora abasabi ase Kirinyaga County gochia ase ekero kioroigwa ekegeto kia obomanyi bwo'omwaka ase okwenera okobua.

English: Kakamega County gov't orders closure of all public mortuaries, Governor Oparanya advises residents to bury their dead immediately.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Wilaya ya Kakamega inaamuru kufungwa kwa makaburi yote ya umma, Gavana Oparanya anawashauri wakazi wazikwe wafu wao mara moja.
Ekegusii: Eserekali y'ekaunti ya Kakamega yarure ogochika kwogosieka chimocheri chi'echinyagitari chieserekali, Omogabana Oparanya oboririe abamenyi gotindeka abakure kegima.

English: TSC calls on the community in Uasin Gishu County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: TSC b erekera egonde a Uasin Gishu goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera gacha amagancha chisukuru.

English: Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Agriculture and Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mithika Linturi in March 2023 urged Kenyans to consume more rice, potatoes, ...
Kiswahili: Caniius Kanangoire Agriculture wa Kenya na Livestock Development Katibu Mithika Lintuuri mnamo Machi 2023 waliwasihi Wakenya kula mchele zaidi, viazi, ....
Ekegusii: Goetera omorai Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Oboremi na Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mithika Linturi egetamo 2023 nasorerete aba' Kenya koria endagera yomochere as obonge, amarabwoni, ...

English: Notice: HELB launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Ngeri: HELB nere nembiria burukania abana bare noboremaru nabana bande ase chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara kwomwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria ase chisemi chikorwa ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Siaya County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri yarure ogokurera abamenyi a Siaya County koerikia obokoreri yarure ogokurera egonde (Nyumba Kumi) yamagenderero.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Migori County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: NCPB eragereria abaremi ba Migori County gocha na kitambulisho kiao kia taifa erio gocha ase amasomo yoboremi arerete.

English: HELB urges youth in Nyandarua County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: HELB yasegetire obosae bo Nyandarua ekaonti korwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo erio gotingia amakora obotumeki.

English: DCI urges the public in Kisii County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: DCI enywa abang'ore Kisii kuogotunya uchero wa kusoma mizizi kwa wenyi wao kwa service provider kufuata uchero wa kusoma mizizi kwa wenyi wao uliwothiwa kwa kusimba na kusimba

English: Notice: KRA launches community-based development programmes in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Gotema: KRA gwanse obotikeranu egonde gwanse obotikeranu kwebitabu biosoma kwabeire aria Taita-Taveta.

English: Basic Education Statistical Booklet 2020 released.
Kiswahili: Kijitabu cha Takwimu za Elimu ya Msingi 2020 kimetolewa.
Ekegusii: Ebitabu bikworokereria Amasomo Oboroso 2020 biasokire

English: Climate-smart agriculture is an approach designed to link agricultural production and food security to climate change adaptation and mitigation, in order to ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa ni mbinu iliyoundwa kuunganisha uzalishaji wa kilimo na usalama wa chakula kwa kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na kupunguza, ili ...
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwoboremi borengete ebimeri biria bikoremereria ogoonchoka kwerire na egurargura nomoroberio erengete kobwatania oboremi , rigesa amo na omoigoto bwendagera buna riiranerio gochia oggonchereria kwerire na gotanga omochando oyio, erio...

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kiambu County this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Echikaro chiafundi chiakerania goika ase ebikaranso bia amasomo chiomotienyi egetamo chiKiambu.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Machakos County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Ekegusii: Mwami wa Kominyeti ya Kenya akereka egonde ya Kaunti ya Machakos kuwesha kuhesha kuhusu uchungu wa jinsia na kuta maendeleo ya nyumba iliyofaa karibu.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Mandera County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera wasigawane PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Omosaria Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogotunya abange ba Mandera County toba okogaba enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio oboitaai obokebago na oborendi ase omoroberio bwokogenderera.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kilifi County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this drought season.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati huu wa ukame.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kilifi koegerera na kogerera chinchogu chiimbu korwa nyomba, na mono kegima omorakera amagoro.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-C citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen yachakorie abakon abe Elgeyo-Marakwet gindigwa via intaneti ntsa e-Citizen portal nende yamwoneka ogosaba kwao goitabwa abana.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Tharaka-Nithi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ria Pest Control Products Board rigoibokia ababori bwebitungo ase akaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi goika goikera amakuru amabe ase ebitungo biabo ase ofisi ya abaveterinari erio goikera obokonyi bwoboroche bwebitungo.

English: KRA urges residents of Mombasa County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: KRA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Mombasa kwerikia chinchogu agasa kuchichiri kochoria obisi.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Garissa County on water harvesting this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya uvunaji wa maji Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: NCPB eragete gochaka abaremi ase Garissa County igoro yogocha amache ase omotienyi 11.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Vihiga County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria korigotera ebinyoro biogokora oboremi (Pest Control Products Board) kigochania abaremi ba Vihiga County goika bagakora omonyo ase chigoro chio gotera gochia ase abaremi nigo bagokora chigoro chio oboremi bwa chindagera chio oboremi bwa chimboga na chindunda.

English: Report bullying incidents immediately.
Kiswahili: Ripoti matukio ya unyanyasaji mara moja.
Ekegusii: Manyia abarimu kegima igoro ebikoro bigosaria oboamate gati ya bana.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Makueni County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwaapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokora abamama na ababa ase Makueni County gochia gosekeria abana babo abari ase emiaka etano igoro yoborwaire bwa HIV/AIDS ime y'omotienyi owa omotienyi 12.

English: Farmers can access subsidized fertilizer by dialing 707 on their phones
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kupata mbolea ya ruzuku kwa kupiga 707 kwenye simu zao
Ekegusii: Abakoriria amoyo aingi kwa kutegeka 707 kwa nyufa zao

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Wajir County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Mei hii.
Ekegusii: Amaumuntia: Egeikaranso kiKenya Gazette giachakirie amasomo igoro yogotanga obogaang a naikerete ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Wajir ama amaumuntia.

English: Parents must register Grade 6 learners for KPSEA by February 28, 2025.
Kiswahili: Wazazi lazima wawaandikishe wanafunzi wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28, 2025.
Ekegusii: Abaibori goika barike abana babo bageredi 6 ase amaosomo yenasari KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiomotienyi 2 omwaka 2025.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Nabwetia: Ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe ekeyia okoigora ekegikia ababui akegikia ID abakorwa Kirinyaga.

English: COMESA urges dairy cows farmers in Uasin Gishu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.

English: DPP calls on the community in Baringo County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a milk collection centre in Nairobi County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Machi hii.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Makueni County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nandi County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nandi kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Wajir County on conservation tillage this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Etebwa: Ewizara y'Oboremi na Oboreri bw'Ebitungo egatigie abaremi ba Wajir County igoro y'ogotema chindagera ase eng'ana omotienyi 10.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Narok County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio Obomurembe - Ekeombe kio Obomurembe bwabana nigo kigocha ase abareeri ase Narok County gosegerera okoregisera ekarati yobomurembe bwabangina na abana buna ebing'ana ase omwaka o omotienyi 3 ogokonya obomurembe bwabangina.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kirinyaga County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y’Obonyamasi - Ekitengo kia Obonyamasi bwa Abakungu nkoribirie abanto ase Kirinyaga Kaunti igoro y’obwenerete bwa ogotunika amache ase enchera engiya korenda obonyamasi bweka.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Garissa County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Garissa Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Egore: NTSA okoboria egonde ekombo korwania okwegena gose egonde Garissa riete.

English: EACC updates residents of Siaya County on progress of ward-level service delivery this November.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Nyandarua County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this drought season.

English: This summit discusses the transformative power in technology and how it can advance agriculture in Africa and foster sustainable growth and resilient food systems.

Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.

English: KNEC urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.

Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.

Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie egonde ki Samburu County korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro bokoru binde biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Ogokurera ase bonsi: DCI okoigora esimi ya okonyora obokonyi ase GBV obokurumi bonded bwonsi ase obokoreri a Nyandarua County.

English: NPS alerts residents of Kwale County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na inashauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: NPS nkiangete abamenyi bia Kwale goeera ekenyori kia gosikirwa goetera entaneti na gosaba banainchi berende okobagera magariro yao goeera ekenyori kia gosikirwa.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Marsabit County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika wilaya ya Marsabit dhidi ya udanganyifu wa mikopo.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yosabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Marsabit kojokoria okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene.

English: FAO warns maize farmers in Kwale County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: FAO erokorokia abanyamaembe bamaembe ase Kwale County igoro yebinyamuche biokwona ebitoke na kogana konyora obonyamukire bwa bwango.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Kirinyaga County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yagasaba abamenyi abakorwa ebirengererio biabo goikerania ebiro ya kurengereka voto Kirinyaga County.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NDMA obaboririe abamenyi ba Samburu Abarwaire kwa kweti kwarikia ase omoroberio bwosereka kwa kweti gacha kwarikia ase omoroboroboka bwosereka.

English: Tea growing Counties are urged to stay informed on the ongoing legal dispute over proposed tea regulations as Governors challenge their implementation in court
Kiswahili: Kaunti zinazolima chai zimehimizwa kufahamu kuhusu mzozo unaoendelea kuhusu kanuni za chai huku Magavana wakipinga utekelezaji wake mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Maeneo yee agara chaa yote yee bera tebia kuhusu matukano yee maeneo yee mithari yee chaa yee maeneo yee kabuna yee kutebia mahakamu

English: On May 5 2015 KUCCPS opened its portal for 2014 KCSE candidates to apply for TVET diploma and certificate courses with a deadline of June 15 2015.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Mei 5, 2015, KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2014 kuomba kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Juni 15, 2015.
Ekegusii: Chitariki isano omotienyi 5 omwaka 2015 ekeombe keria getenenerete kegochora abana gochia chiyunifasiti nechikoregi (KUCCPS) nkiaigorete eintaneti yaye ase abana besekenderi baria bokorete amatemwa a KCSE omwaka 2014 batome ogosaba kwabo ase chikosi chiobundi, nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase ekosi yechipuloma naboigo yechisatifiketi nyuma yechitariki 15 chiomotieni 6 omwaka 2015.

English: Take your child for regular weight and height checks to detect growth issues early.
Kiswahili: Mpeleke mtoto wako kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa uzito na urefu mara kwa mara ili kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema.
Ekegusii: Ira omwana orengwa chiratiri botambe na obotambe omanye gose bokongu mboreo bwogokina

English: Police credit community policing efforts for a marked decline in murders, defilement and other serious crimes in Mwala Machakos County
Kiswahili: Juhudi za polisi za kulinda jamii kwa kupunguza kwa kiasi kikubwa mauaji, unajisi na uhalifu mwingine mkubwa katika Kaunti ya Mwala Machakos
Ekegusii: Abasikari baitabire oborendo bwebinyoro ase ogokeie obosareku bwogoita, gotibonga na amamocho ande amabe aaria ekaonti ya Mwala Machakos.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Mandera County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: NTSA yasororire abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Mandera ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose oroche rorew nomorindo bwamache amagoro yamache.

English: Access to credit: Access to agricultural credit can have a significant ... market, access to extension services, and access to irrigation. Furthermore ...
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa mikopo: Upatikanaji wa mikopo ya kilimo inaweza kuwa na ... soko, upatikanaji wa huduma za ugani, na upatikanaji wa umwagiliaji. Zaidi ya hayo ...
Ekegusii: Goikera amakobeso yechibesa : Goikera amakobeso yechibesa chioboremi noro ngosira kegima ... echiro, naboigo goikera obokoreri bwoboremi korwa ofisi yabaremi , nabo igo goikera ooroberion bwokonyorokereria amache chingaki chieguragura as ebimeri. Mono kegima ...

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches county development projects in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Nyesa: Kenya Gazette ariokorera matundu ya mukongozo ekaonti ya Nakuru.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Kilifi County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giokorenda obosaria (Directorate of Criminal Investigations) yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera chinchera chiancheire ebesa yao Kilifi goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetera esimi yao kubonyeke omosaria ebesa yao.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Social Health Authority (SHA) nigo kigochanireria abanto bose bwa West Pokot County ng'a batagendi bagokora obororo bwa chinsiri, na kigochanireria abanto gobaria abanyanya babo bari ase obororo ng'a barabe barasaba obonyonyi.

English: OGP urges residents of West Pokot County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP obaboririe abamenyi ba ekaunti ya West Pokot okwenyara fora ya koremoro kwenyara bwichuma okwerikia abanto abake mono nabwo boka berikirie.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo korwa ase Obotungiri bwoborigari: chikiriniki chiabakungu abamanyi gochiara chigakora chincera chionse chia omotienyi 3 ase chikiriniki chigendererete ase Kirinyaga County.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Nairobi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS eria abaibori na barimu a Nairobi County aka esimi 116 komnyia obokonyi ase abana.

English: Control coffee berry disease in an environmentally friendly way using Integrated Pest Management (IPM) techniques suitable for rice.
Kiswahili: Dhibiti ugonjwa wa beri ya kahawa kwa njia rafiki kwa mazingira kwa kutumia mbinu za Usimamizi Jumuishi wa Wadudu (IPM) zinazofaa kwa mchele.
Ekegusii: Tanga amarwaire ekaagwa as enchera etari goita amakonde ase riroba gose gosaria amasingira ase ogotumia chingencho ao oa chiogotanga ebichuni gose amakonde (IPM) mose ase oboremi bwomochere.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Ekegusii: Kwara: NDMA okoigora abwenge ase ogokonywa kwebirengererio goetra okobakwanera buna Machakosyamanyirie.

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: Nabamwiti: EACC okoigora ekeyia gia chingiru kia ID ase ogotamera chingaki chi Kirinyaga.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs tea farmers in Tana River County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'oboremi na oboreri bw'ebinyamu nigo bikomanyia abaremi b'echayi ase Tana River Kaonti ase chingencho chipeya chio ogotunda ebiturwa biabo ase omotienyi 12.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Isiolo County on progress of ward-level service delivery this September.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya omogabana biegesiasa bia siasa orure okoboria abamenyi gwekaunti ya Isiolo gosira eserekari naboigo kwerwa ase amagenderero amo nogokina gwekaunti yabo etureti ya kebaki.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Garissa County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen yambooririe abasae baikire emeika yogoaka chikura, batarere abisi ere ange na IEBC tarere enyomba y'oboringoria ere ange naye otari konyorwa erio otange obokong'u obwo.

English: Kenya confirms 9 more coronavirus cases bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 59. Tracing of contacts of the 59 confirmed cases ongoing.
Kiswahili: Kenya imethibitisha visa vingine 9 vya virusi vya corona na kuongeza idadi ya watu waliothibitishwa kuwa na virusi hivyo hadi 59.
Ekegusii: Kenya koenekia abanto 9 komentekana ase okoambokerigwa oborwaire bwa COVID19 bonsi amo goika abanto 59. Emeroberio ya okobwatia baria basangire gose goikana ang'e na abwarwaire abwo 59, negendererete

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Ekegusii: Erokoso: Kenya Red Cross okoigora okobu esing'oreka esikia okobu esing'oreka okobu esing'oreka emurang'a County.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Meru County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokibukia abamama abanyabwate ase Meru County inga okwenera okwanchwa kwabana nigo kuri obwanto ase chifasiliti chiensi chia gavamenti.

English: AFA invites farmers in Vihiga County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this June.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Juni hii.
Ekegusii: AFA eragete abaremi ba Vihiga County ase ogotenywa okonyora amagenderero ase okorika amakande abaremi omotienyi 6.

English: NCPB urges cattle farmers in Samburu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia NCPB nigo korigia abaremi b'ebisoro ase Samburu County gotiga gokonya ebisoro biabo gochia ase chikaunti chindi batari na ebarua y'orusa, konyora amakuru arengerete oborwari bwa anthrax.

English: It is wrong for farmers to apply any fertilizer without knowing what nutrients are lacking in the soil for the crop they intend to grow; farmers should seek advice from any KALRO station to have their soil tested.
Kiswahili: Ni makosa kwa wakulima kutumia mbolea yoyote bila kujua ni virutubisho gani vinakosekana kwenye udongo kwa mazao wanayokusudia kukua; wakulima wanapaswa kutafuta ushauri kutoka kwa kituo chochote cha KALRO ili kupima udongo wao.
Ekegusii: Ere agasa amoyi agindigwa agasa kujua madhara yasi yamaroba yamwe yamwe yamwe yasindia mazao ame agara; majiji amenya kumwita madhara yamaroba yao KALRO.

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Okorari: KNEC okoigora ekeyia ebitàmunusi ebisakane na ebisakane ebinyamariro ase senta ya vocational ase ekaunti ya Kiambu.

English: KICD invites youth in Bomet County to enroll for tailoring and design training this September.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: KICD eragete abasubati ase Ekaunti ya Bomet gochora okwiyandika ase oboremi bwo gocheka chinguo na okobora chinguo ase omotienyi 9.

English: FAO invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on post-harvest handling this March.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Machi hii.
Ekegusii: FAO egokwaneria abaremi ase Taita-Taveta County ase amasomo atari gochia chimbesa igoro yobokoreri bwe chindagera buna bwakomera ase omotienyi 3.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete abantu abe Tharaka-Nithi giabakorera amasomo yabo ase ebinyoro yobokoreri bwechikaonti chiabo ase egegikorera.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cattle farmers in Nandi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bi'oboremi na oboreri bwe chinyama nigo bigosaba abaremi bwe chinyama ase Nandi County goitera chinyama chiabo chindano ase chinkoro chigachigirwe goetera oborwaro bwa anthrax obwarekwa.

English: CDC reminds the public in Narok County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC kigokora abanto ba Narok County komanya obwenge bwo gwocha amaboko ase oborongo bwe chinyomba.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Korwetso: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani okoigora okwokwori okwokwori ase GBV omorero ase chingaki chinyinge bekaunti ya kakamega.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Nyandarua County this September.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: HELB igokora goika ase ebikaranso bia amasomo yegeintaneti igoro yobokoreri bwechikaonti chiomotienyi etureti ya kebaki ase Nyandarua.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Marsabit County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Etebi: KEPHIS egokaba chimbeyo chie chimboco chie chireti ase abaremi ba Marsabit County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Mombasa community policing forum convened by KEPSSI and local leaders to curb juvenile gangs in Likoni
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la polisi jamii la Mombasa laitishwa na KEPSSI na viongozi wa eneo hilo ili kukabiliana na magenge ya vijana huko Likoni
Ekegusii: Ogocha amo kwabarendi boborendi aaria ekaonti ya Mombasa gwakoretwe nekeombe keria kiobomo bwechisukuru chioboroso (KEPSSI) ase okobwaterana nabarai bebinyoro gokinana na ebiombe biobosaria nabana abake aaria Likoni

English: Managing risks in livestock requires planning. Learn strategies for diversification, contracts, and coping with specific risks like drought.
Kiswahili: Kusimamia hatari katika mifugo kunahitaji kupanga. Jifunze mikakati ya mseto, mikataba, na kukabiliana na hatari maalum kama ukame.
Ekegusii: Gotanga amarwaire ase etugo negento kiengencho. Soma buna oragarei oboremi, obokoreri, na buna orekongie ase eguragura.

English: This manual has been prepared to assist agricultural extension officers and community leaders in disseminating a list of Climate-Smart Agriculture practices.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo huu umetayarishwa kusaidia maafisa wa ugani wa kilimo na viongozi wa jamii katika kusambaza orodha ya mazoea ya Kilimo cha Hali ya Hewa.
Ekegusii: Egatabu eke nigo kegokonya abaofisa abatebereria boboremi na baria bebinyoro gokonya ase ogoetia amangana aya igoro yoboremi obuya na buna bogokorwa.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate  from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Haipendekezi kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo. Baada ya kupata chanjo kamili utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa wavuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.
Ekegusii: Kobetwa chisindani cao ao teancheiri. Ekero kwanyorire esindani, nabo okonyora esatibigeti yao ya COVI-19 korwa ase omtandao o MOH https://portal.health.go.ke

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Mandera County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross kigokumanyia abanto bori ase Mandera County ng'a goikera obonyamokoro bwamaso na ameno bono nkorwe ase chinsitua chire igoro.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji maombi yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: KNEC riokorwa abana baria bare nokogania Homa Bay County kwao ogosaba kwao endorero bare nokogania ticha riasa.

English: The government aims to reduce wheat imports by 17 by 2027 by increasing local production Farmers are encouraged to utilize available support including subsidized fertilizers and improved seeds
Kiswahili: Serikali inalenga kupunguza uagizaji wa ngano ifikapo 17 ifikapo 2027 kwa kuongeza uzalishaji wa ndani Wakulima wahimizwa kutumia msaada unaopatikana ikiwa ni pamoja na mbolea ya ruzuku na mbegu bora.
Ekegusii: Serikali ina tundu ya kureba mafuta ya kimai kwa 17 kwa mwaka wa 2027 kwa kupucha uzalishaji wa miji. Wafugaji wanaingwa kuwagindigwa msaada yaliyopo ikiwa amoyo yaliyopungwa na mahindi yaliyoyera.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Lamu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yagorogwa abanto bia Lamu Gotenenerete baborigwe koenana amang'ana onsi arengete obogaang a via omoroberio bwechisimi chiamorero ya EACC gosegeta gochikorera obokurumi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Kisii County this November.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Red Cross nkoribokia abanto buna okororwa oborwa bwa malaria ase obwango nkorwa ase chisentra chionsi chia obochari bwa amagaka ime yense ya Kisii County ase omotienyi 11.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Nandi County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: NDMA b erekera egonde ku Nandi ku kusoma kwa kumiriria matundu ya kusambwa na kurekera matundu hadi maboko ya kusambwa mu kinyozi cha polisi karibu.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Ekegusii: Echokoro: Kenya Gazette okoigora ekeyia genkio gomosangerekano gwa e-Citizen aaria ekaonti ya Migori.

English: Ministry of ICT partners with NGOs to provide free online coding bootcamps targeting youth in underserved communities.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT nkobwterana ere na NGOs korwa amasomo ameng'e abosa igoro yamasomo ekombiuta goetera eintanetiarengete abasae baria batari goikereka keboraisi.

English: IEBC urges youth in Laikipia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: IEBC yaboririe obosae Laikipia County kobwaterana amakora akechikura akechikura nobochori obonene.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Kwale County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yebirime na oboreri bwechingombe nkogoteba abanyamwaka ase Kwale County barore okoregisita ase amasomo ayo atari gochia gochia ase amasomo ayo amayia yebirime.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges rice growers in Turkana County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawasihi wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa sugu na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Oboremi na Endagera Authority (AFA) kumwoga wakamburu wakorongo Turkana gosoroma matundu omorakera oyera endagera amagoro hii

English: National Research Fund hosts annual symposium on latest research trends and outcomes in digital education.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chiomoroberio omonene bwa'masomo okorigia obomnyi oboyia nkorigania ere ogocha amo gwokomanyekania obokongori bwamasomo oboyia nayarorekanire goetera chisemi chiegegedichitari ase chisemi.

English: Pest Control Products Board invites farmers in Migori County to a free training on post-harvest handling this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board kigoetia abanyamwaka ase Migori County ase ogotigwa amachiko amaya ase ogotara ebirio korwa ase obokongoria bwayo ase omotienyi 9.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Busia County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri biogosunga obogima bwomonto - Ekeombe kiobosunga obogima bwabakungu neabana nigo gekogania abanto ba Busia County gochia ase ogopimwa obogima bwa chinyoro goetera ogotanga endwari chira chigokonyeka gotangigwa.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Baringo County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Ekegusii: HELB yasegetire abaibori nabarimu Baringo yochikuru korwa chiropoti kengima kochikuru nobwatekana ng'a abamanyie ebikoru binde bionsi bire nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejea kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: KRA orure okoboria gotema gwanse obotikeranu kwebitabu biosoma kwabeire aria Taita-Taveta.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nandi County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi apigie simu ya GBV ya bure 1195.
Ekegusii: Amosaria oboitaai omosaria nereka nabaofisa naikerete abaokereka choria ase abasubati ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi, berekera esimi ya GBV ya okonyora obokonyi ase abasubati 1195.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a November awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Novemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yachakire ekampeini y'oborabu bwa omotienyi 11 igoro y'oborwari bwa hypertension ase Uasin Gishu County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Bungoma County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria yaboririe abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Bungoma kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kwa nyuma ya chinchogu chwekochi omwita omwita.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Nyaore: Biombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi TVET yembaorogetie chinguru ase ogokonya abana goetera ogosemia abechisekenderi goetera ekaonti ya Nandi.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Ekegusii: KEMSA esabire abarebi babana ase Kisumu County gochia gokwandika chikadi chie obomanyi bwa mama na omwana ase ogokonya ogokora omwaka o omotienyi 10 ogwobomanyi bwa mama.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyandarua County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egosorora omonto omonene orenge ase oborwa bwobongo ase Nyandarua County goika ase ebituo biokogera obokonyi bwobongo bosa.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Baringo County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: KEMSA ekoremereria abanto ba Baringo County buna okobwatekana na chinkambi chiamaiso na chimenyo bono nkorwa ase chichitua chire na obwenereri.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Vihiga County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'eserekari bi'ebitito bi'obogweti (TVET) nigo bigosaba abana batari esukuru ase Vihiga County gochia koregisita abana babo ase esukuru y'eserekari eri hakuhi ase ogotebwa kw'esukuru y'oboremi bw'eserekari etari chibesa.

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Tana River County this September.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Tana River Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC ngokora kere omoroberio bwogosomia abanto igoro yamachiko yoboronge ase ekaunti ya Tana River etureti ya kebaki.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Tharaka-Nithi County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Februari.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross erorire abamama na ababa aaria ekaonti ya Tharaka-Nithi gochia na abana abari ase emiaka etano gose egose ase oborwari bwa Rift Valley Fever goetera omogenderero ogwo ogokonya abantu aaria omotienyi 2.

English: KALRO urges tea growers in Murang'a County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo ekoborobia abariiti ba echaai ase Murang'a County gochengeria oboremi bwa okorandania ememero erio gokonyea oboriri bwe roroba na gokomenta amagweta ase omotienyi oyo.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Kisii County that input on development planning forums is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya nyarigetie amaoni korwa abanainchi a Kisii County ng'a amaoni korwa abanyene goetumia akiri pandia na tekinorochia enyia gokongia gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu na gokwanera igoro yemechando yogosoigwa goetera ebuagi.

English: HELB urges residents of Makueni County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: HELB nigo egokinia abamenyi ba Makueni County gochia gosega obusari mbere ya rituko ria gochira erio gochera obusari obwo.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Lamu County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gotoka ase abana bonsi baria Lamu County nkorora kere nga ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria endorero baria bare ticha nokogania kwabeene.

English: 20,000 junior secondary teachers recruited to support CBC rollout.
Ekegusii: Abarimu 20,000 besekenderi chianse barikirwe gosira omoroberio bwogochakia chisemi chirengete ekeegwa gia kera omwans (CBC)

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Nairobi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'Obochari egokora abanto ba Nairobi County batakonyara gocha ase obokong'u bwo obwime na gokora omwaka omo ase obokong'u bwo obwime gose obororo bwo obwongo gokorera obokonyi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Homa Bay County on conservation tillage this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ogochera: KEPHIS nigo egokwenera goitetia abaremi bwa Homa Bay County ase oboremi bwo ogokonya chinyansi (conservation tillage) ime ya omotienyi 9.

English: Protests caused disruptions; stay alert and follow safety guidance.
Kiswahili: Maandamano yalisababisha usumbufu; kaa macho na fuata mwongozo wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Okorobererekana nigo kwaretete oturubano; kabe maiso na bwatia emeroberio yoborendi.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Medical Association nigo gikobasema abamama abamemere ase Makueni County ng'a okonyora obotumi bwe chindagera chie chika (family planning) nigo keri bosa ase chifasiriti chiensi chieserikari.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Mombasa County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'oboremi n'obokori bwetugo nigo bikoboria abaremi ba Mombasa County gocharia ebisarori bi'obokoreri bwo gofuka ensemo erio gotanga ogotwarwa kw'egetaka ase okorwa ase okobwatekana n'ebiragera bi'emvura bi'okochindachinda.

English: Notice: KNEC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: KNEC neetorete chitariki chiokwiyandikira ase omogano gwokuria kwabasomi ase chisukuru chiri ase Garissa County.

English: EACC highlighted media’s role in exposing corruption.
Kiswahili: EACC ilisisitiza jukumu la vyombo vya habari katika kufunua ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gokorwania abokorekanu (EACC) kiaorokirie buna abariki na gotangasa amangana bare neribaga rigiya kooroki obokorekanu.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Garissa County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: KICD gokwana abamenyi ba Garissa County amabori igoroyamachiko oboronge bwabo.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Nakuru County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: IPOA b erekera egonde a Nakuru gose gokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na manyia ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru goetera egonde yomonyaroka yekipereke yekipereke.

English: To reduce HIV AIDS disease burden, Malaria and continued vaccination on these diseases, in y view I may say, Ksh 28 billion to the World Health Organization and 4.6 billion on vaccination plan is required
Ekegusii: Gokeiyia oborwaire bwa Enyamoreo, Esese na Esosera na kogendereria emeroberio ye'chisindani chia ogotanga amarwaire aya, ase okorora kwane ndatebe, sh28.7 billion ase ekegancha gi'Ense na sh4.6bilion ase emeroberio ya chisindani chia ogotanga amarwaire.

English: KEPHIS promotes water harvesting among farmers in Kitui County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egokora omogano gwokorokia amache ase abaremi ba Kitui County buna ensemo yomwaka ogochire omotienyi 11 bwo ogokora nigo amache nigo arengete gochia ase oborwaria bwa chinchera.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Tana River County that input on development planning forums is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigeikwana abanto ase ekaunti ya Tana River okonene okonya okwana okwana omonugunoobarema okonene okwana okwana obokoreri bwechikaonti.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free tobacco control outreach in Kisumu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Amanyiso abanto: CDC ekoba nigo ekorora oboikeri bwa amarioki ase Kisumu County ase omotienyi 2.

English: Agribusinesses in Kenya can access funding through the partnership between USAID s Kenya Investment Mechanism and Vital Capital aimed at unlocking 400 million in investments
Kiswahili: Biashara za kilimo nchini Kenya zinaweza kupata ufadhili kupitia ushirikiano kati ya USAID's Kenya Investment Mechanism na Vital Capital unaolenga kufungua uwekezaji wa milioni 400.
Ekegusii: Makamati ya chakula na biashara ya Kenya zinaweza kupata malipo kwa kushirikiana na USAID na Kenya Investment Mechanism na Vital Capital kwa uwekezaji wa malipo ya miaka 400 milioni

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Nandi County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Nandi Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: SHA (Social Health Authority) egokora omong'ano ogokonya abanto goika gochireka oborevi bwa chindawa ase Nandi County ase omotienyi 11. Abanto bonsi bariganiigwe.

English: Town dwellers can plant crops. Learn the techniques of using sacks to cultivate vegetables and onions.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa miji wanaweza kupanda mazao. Jifunze mbinu za kutumia magunia kulima mboga na vitunguu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete emechie yechitaoni nabo baranyare korema endagera. Rigia komanya buna chisemi chiogotumia emebuko gosimeka ching'eni nebitunguo.

English: KNEC opens secure containers for KCSE 2025 exams nationwide.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafungua vyombo salama kwa ajili ya mitihani ya KCSE 2025 nchini kote.
Ekegusii: KNEC okoigora getenerete amatemwa KCSE 2025 omwaka 2025, nyuma yamatemwa.

English: New report shows increased blogger harassment; verify safety online.
Kiswahili: Ripoti mpya inaonyesha ongezeko la unyanyasaji wa wanablogu; thibitisha usalama mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Chiripoti chinyia nigo chikworokia buna baria bakorika amangana betenenete bagendererete komigwa; riganetie obokongoria koenekia.

English: Government funds modernization of equipment and lab facilities in STEM resource centers across counties.
Kiswahili: Serikali inachangia kuboresha vifaa na vifaa vya maabara katika vituo vya rasilimali za STEM katika wilaya zote.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarure chibesa koagacha amaagacho a bono  nabiganeirie biegesayansi chisenta chionsi ime yense (STEM).

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nandi County that free day secondary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Universities Fund nigo ekoborokia ababiarani ba Nandi County buna okoregisita kw'amasomo ago bosa aya esukuru chia sekondari kigoire ase omotienyi 3.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Homa Bay County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo gikobasoka abanyamwamu bechinyama ase Homa Bay County gochika chinyama chiabo ase ebiorokererio biokochika chinyama (crush points) nigo konyora obokongoria bwe' chinyama.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges poultry farmers in Bungoma County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa magonjwa ya miguu na mdomo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nikigocha abaremi bwechingoko ase Bungoma County gochera chindui chiao ase chinchera chio gotema chindui goetera oborwa bwa foot and mouth disease obo bwarekerwa.

English: KEPHIS advises maize producers in Homa Bay County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragire abaremi b'ebigori ase Homa Bay County gochia ase omosoko omonyene ogochire abaremi mbere yechitariki chiokogesa.

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If youre really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Chukua pumzi ya kina na kupumzika. Sikiliza mwili wako. Kama wewe ni kweli uchovu, kutoa mwenyewe muda wa kulala. bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili inateseka na mkusanyiko wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.
Ekegusii: Ng'usa omoeso omana gotoerera.Tegerera omobere oo.Onye kwarosire mono,twara chingaki chi'ogotimoka. Kero totarikonyora chitoro boikeranu, ebirengererio biato nigo bigochandeka. Ebirengererio biato nigo bikogenda inse. Chinsa chinde tiga ebinto binde biratimoka.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Samburu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Ekegusii: Ekoriria ekaunyi ya Kenya yaringana erio yobobisi ya Samburu tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-PESA ya PIN nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera ya chikoriria chia chikoriria.

English: KEPHIS advises milk producers in Baringo County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokora amagenderero abanyamwaka b'amata ase Baringo County gochia goteerera amamata ayio ase abaguri baria bare n'ebirua biokogura amamata mbere y'omwaka ogwo ogw'okogetha.

English: Parents: Pay zero fees for public secondary – report any school demanding money to 0800721490 now.

English: KEPHIS advises coffee producers in Busia County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Busia kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.

English: NTSA warns residents of Siaya County to prepare for possible road accidents this September.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandaa kwa ajali zinazowezekana za barabarani Septemba hii.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Kericho County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kakamega County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo gikwibokia abanto ba Kakamega County buna obokonyi bwa okorwaria chimpio (dialysis) bwa chigici nigo bwari aaria chinsitua chire na obokonyi obo.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Kilifi County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bi'Ekegusii bi'oboremi na obomanyi (TVET) nigo bigokora omwamo abana batari esukuru ase Kilifi County konyora obosomi bwa bursary mbere y'erita ria kareng'a ase obosomi obwo.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Bomet County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkorwa ere ababai na barimu ase Bomet gose komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Komanyia: IPOA okoigora egetengo kia beene ase chinyagitari na Porisi amang'ana ogokorerwa bobe ase ogokonya kore baria bakoreirwe bobe mbare noboronge bwabo konyora obobwenia ekaunti ya Mombasa.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Trans Nzoia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: TVET eragete abana baria batari amasomoni ase Trans Nzoia County goika gochaka amasomo yobokuru ase ebitari biokosoma biabakuru.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Embu County on progress of the county integrated development plan this May.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Mei.

English: Raise awareness on workplace harassment, human rights, and civic responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa kuhusu unyanyasaji mahali pa kazi, haki za binadamu, na majukumu ya kiraia.

English: KNEC urges youth in Murang'a County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KNEC yasegetire obosae Murang'a ekaonti korwa goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo erio gotingia amakora oboteneneri.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Mandera County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya mwenyekidhi omosabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Mandera koegerera chinchogu na kusereremia ma matetela kweny osero na koria amaaki ase chokaonti.

English: NCPB informs fish farmers in Kisumu County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia NCPB nigo kigocha amang'ana ase abaremi b'ebisaba ase Kisumu County igoro y'emikono emia y'okorandia ebisaba biabo ase omotienyi 9.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: NDMA chera chingaki na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka Kakamega.

English: CDC urges residents of Tana River County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.

English: All underweight children at delivery, Obokoreri korwa Mama Kangaroo, such children should stay close/intact with their mothers for bodily warmth to the child, andgood breast feeding in cring for child's life

English: Kenya will adjust curfew hours in Turkana and Kainuk due to improved security.
Kiswahili: Kenya itarekebisha saa za kutotoka nje huko Turkana na Kainuk kutokana na usalama ulioimarishwa.
