English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Uasin Gishu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari bwo goikwa na goikwera (medical camp) eyio eragwe na ebitengo biokorora oborwari eraba ase Uasin Gishu County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: NPS orure ogokurerwa ase okomentekana gwa sekuriti ya cyber kwa SIM-swap obokengeka naikerete abamenyi ba ba aaria ekaonti ya Nandi.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Isiolo County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: Ebisera biokomanya oborwari na okobwateka nibigie n'omokomano gwokorokia abanto baria bare ase oborwachi bwa chindawa chiobusiro ase Isiolo County ase omotienyi 10. Abanto bonsi nigo basororirwe.

English: To control fruit flies in mango orchards, make simple traps from small plastic containers with a hanging cotton wick, drench the wick with a 10-20% pesticide solution (such as malathion, fenthion, or deltamethrin) plus a lure like methyl eugenol, and hang the traps in and around the orchard - flies are attracted by the lure and killed by the pesticide.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nzi wa matunda kwenye bustani za embe, tengeneza mitego rahisi kutoka kwa vyombo vidogo vya plastiki na utambi wa pamba unaoning'inia, loweka utambi na suluhisho la dawa ya 10-20% (kama vile malathion, fenthion, au deltamethrin) pamoja na chambo kama methyl eugenol, na utundike mitego ndani na karibu na bustani - nzi huvutiwa na kivutio na kuuawa na dawa ya wadudu.
Ekegusii: Kuokuruka matunda a mango, kuchoma ogosunga a plastiki egeke na ogosunga a cotton, okonyia ogosunga a cotton na chung'wani cha pesticide (kama malathion, fenthion, au deltamethrin) na lure kama methyl eugenol, na ogosunga ogosunga a plastiki na cotton kwa mango na kwa kirengo - okoiruruka a kuokuruka kwa lure na kuokuruka kwa pesticide.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Laikipia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoboremi nigo egokang'a abana batari amasomoni ase Laikipia County gochia goseka obonyamwamu bwe masomo mbere yengaki yagoika ase amasomo abakuru.

English: Solar-powered water pumps offer a clean, reliable way to irrigate your bananas, reducing reliance on diesel or manual methods.
Kiswahili: Pampu za maji zinazotumia nishati ya jua hutoa njia safi na ya kuaminika ya kumwagilia ndizi zako, kupunguza utegemezi wa dizeli au mbinu za mwongozo.
Ekegusii: Chiinchini chia ogoaka amache chigotumia chinguru chierisase nenchera eyemo engikeranu gosiarera amache ase amatoke ao ekiagera egokeania gotumia amaguta ediseri goge chinguri chamaboko.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri yaKenya yarure ogokurera ase okobwatanigwa abanto yia Uasin Gishu gokonya gweserikari yia ebesa.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in West Pokot County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya obaboririe abamenyi ase ekaunti ya West Pokot kwa igoro yokorwa amaaki ase abamenyi ase chiafisi chia eserekari.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Embu County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Embu Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Nesesi: Egeikaranso kiKenya Gazette giachakirie egekoreri giokokomanyia obogaang a igoro yeserikari yechikaonti a Embu esagati.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe yomosaria yobosia yerekera abamenyi yaKisii kobwaterana komenta omosiongoroko oboasioku.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Kakamega County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nkoeboria abareeri abana ase Kakamega County gochia na abana babo ase ogokorwa ogokwanirwa ogokura ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 3 kw'obogwenia bw'abang'ina.

English: Select a cowpea variety suited to your agro-ecological zone and cropping system; in Zimbabwe, Natural Regions IV and V (the drier regions) are suitable for growing cowpea, so consider maturity period, drought tolerance, and pest and disease resistance when choosing a variety.
Kiswahili: Chagua aina ya cowpea inayofaa kwa eneo lako la kilimo-ikolojia na mfumo wa mazao; nchini Zimbabwe, Mikoa ya Asili ya IV na V (mikoa kavu zaidi) inafaa kwa kukuza mbaazi, kwa hivyo fikiria kipindi cha ukomavu, uvumilivu wa ukame, na upinzani wa wadudu na magonjwa wakati wa kuchagua aina.
Ekegusii: Chukera chukuru cha kibere kisokera kwe agro-ecological zone na system y'kukurasa; mu Zimbabwe, Natural Regions IV na V (magari a orwomo) ni entonu kwa agara chukera, kana kwa kurega, kwa kurega omorakera, na kwa kurega enyamokirimbi na oboruaire wakati wa kuchukera chukuru.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Meru County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen aorire abamenyi okaunti Meru okoboria ase achiuwa kuerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: NPS calls on residents of Isiolo County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NPS erekera okoboria ase abamenyi gwekaunti ya isiolo kubatia amachiko buna arure nabarai una enchhera eyemo yoborendi erio omosiongoroko.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of pigs in Nyeri County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Ekegusii: Enyaribuko: AFA yachire okogenda kw'enguruwe ase Nyeri County nigo ekorwa ase oborwaire bwa Newcastle obwamenyire.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere ogocha amo goetera emesangerekano yechisemi chiegedichitari ase chingongo abarimi bare Machakos riete.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Trans Nzoia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure egonde Trans Nzoia okobagera amangana ao abosani abo bembeo goeera eintaneti okobwatanigwa abanto okokurera abosang'ori.

English: ACAT is the foremost agriculture technology transfer platform that facilitates structured dialogue and consensus building on game-changing novel technologies.
Kiswahili: ACAT ndio jukwaa kuu la uhamishaji wa teknolojia ya kilimo ambalo huwezesha mazungumzo yaliyopangwa na ujenzi wa makubaliano juu ya teknolojia mpya zinazobadilisha mchezo.
Ekegusii: CAT nomoroberio obeene bwokoererania chisemi chia tekinorochia gochia ase abarami ogendereretie chinkwana chia oboamo na ogwancheran amo buna enchera eyemo yokoreta ogoochoreia okoronge as oboremi.

English: Judicial leadership endorsed IPOA’s mandate and pledged support for stronger cooperation between the judiciary and the oversight body.
Kiswahili: Uongozi wa mahakama uliunga mkono utume wa IPOA na kuahidi msaada kwa ushirikiano wenye nguvu kati ya mahakama na mwili wa usimamizi.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bokogamba ebina mbaete okoboko ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) buna kegokora emeremo na koenekia kobasira ase okobwaterana gti yechikoti nebiombe biria bikomongera obokoreri bwabo.

English: AFA invites farmers in Nyeri County to a free training on post-harvest handling this June.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Juni hii.
Ekegusii: AFA eretete abaremi ba Nyeri County ase ogotenywa okonyora obwate bwo ogotenywa ase okorageria ebitoki bwo oboremi ase omotienyi 6.

English: The FINAS 2025 Conference on sustainable agri food financing will take place at KICC Nairobi from May 20 22 2025 All stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Kongamano la FINAS 2025 kuhusu ufadhili endelevu wa chakula cha kilimo litafanyika KICC Nairobi kuanzia Mei 20 22 2025 Wadau wote wa kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Konferensia ya FINAS 2025 ya kuhakikisha pesa kwa bidii za chakula na mifumo ya kuzalia itakapotokea KICC Nairobi tangu tare ya Mei 20 hadi 22 2025 Wafanyikazi wote wa oboremi wamehukumu kuuza mawasiliano

English: The government put in place measures control measures when Covid Virus was detected and spreaded to 15 in the past time. New directives were imposed after eight people were diagnized and found to be infected with Covid 19
Kiswahili: Serikali iliweka hatua za kudhibiti wakati virusi vya Covid viligunduliwa na kuenea hadi 15 wakati uliopita.
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabekire ebitambokero ekero ebinyinyi ebinyia bia Korona biamentekanete goika 15 ime ye’chinsa 72 chiaetire. Amachiko amayia nigo achete magega yabanto bande batano na batato gopimwa na konyorekana na COVID-19.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Nyeri County to enroll for ICT skills training this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio oboeri bwe Yunifasiti (Universities Fund) nigo koriganigwe abasubati ase chikaonti ya Nyeri gochia korandika ase oboeri bwo obwengencho bwa ICT ase omotienyi 3.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: NTSA b erekera egonde a Mandera County ku b erekera kubere igoro yomonyaroka gose omomura ase esukuru na ku manyia ogokorera bobe abande goetera egonde yeki bare chisukuru a polisi.

English: The forming of dairy cooperatives will enhance economies of scale, provide access to the market and financing. Cooperatives create more ...
Kiswahili: Kuanzishwa kwa vyama vya ushirika vya maziwa kutaimarisha uchumi wa kiwango, kutoa ufikiaji wa soko na ufadhili. Vyama vya ushirika huunda zaidi ...
Ekegusii: Okorosia kwebiombe bwobotugi bbwechiombe chia amaberenkwangoi obogoko bwa igoro, borwe enchera gosoa echiro na amakobeso. Ebiombe nigo bikorenta mono ...

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Taita-Taveta County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeorokererio: Ekeombe kio abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) kigokora ekeombe giokorua obobwenia ase obwanto bwa Taita-Taveta County ase omotienyi 6.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Uasin Gishu County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa kiararirie endorero bokobaga Uasin Gishu County korengana okogania omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase omoroberio otekinorochia goikerania amasomo yegetekinorochia.

English: Notice: KNEC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bomet.
Ekegusii: Gorochi: KNEC gokwanerana na gokeania amachiko arengete gotanga, gokorera abande bobe, na gera gokwanerana na gokeania okomocherwa gose gochaya abana bande arurwe ase Bomet County.

English: Maintain good livestock health is important. Learn on various diseases, vaccination periods and chicken rearing.
Kiswahili: Kuendelea kuwa na afya nzuri ya mifugo ni muhimu. Jifunze kuhusu magonjwa mbalimbali, vipindi vya chanjo na kulea kuku.
Ekegusii: Ikerania afia engiya yetugo yao buna egento kiengencho. Soma komanya igor yamarwaire aoao, chingaki okobeta chisindani, na oborendi bwechingoko.

English: Encourage passengers to identify unsafe matatus.
Kiswahili: Wahimize abiria kutambua matatu zisizo salama.
Ekegusii: Segeta abakorina chirori buna bakomanya matatu etabwati ebiganeirie ase epara nobogendi obuya.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Makueni County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Registrar ya Biama bia Siasa yoborire abakorogo bia Makueni Gwoko gindigwa ase intaneti neserikari koba E-Citizen portal nabo aborire okoraagwa namba ya kuzindua.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Murang'a County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Emonistiri yoboremi bwa TVET ngosaba abanto bori Murang'a County gosegesia abana babo ase esukuru yonsi eyio eri hakiri nigo bare gochia gochera oboremi bwa sekondari bwa chinsaa.

English: SHA urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: SHA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya Trans Nzoia kong'oria amaswari ase emekutano ya gosanga goikera amang'ana igoro yogosanga nagokwanerana.

English: TVET advises students in Meru County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo.
Ekegusii: TVET ogokora endorero Meru County rika amanyekane nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao egera amasomo akorosigwa.

English: SHA reminds the public in Narok County that input on the county budget process is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Januari hii.
Ekegusii: SHA baboririe abamenyi Narok kaunti kwemanyia boronge igoro yamagenderero yeserekari y'ekaunti yego eng’atiato.

English: TSC reminds parents in Kilifi County that adult literacy classes registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Ekegusii: TSC nigo egokora omobuko ase abaibori ba Kilifi County ng'a ogosara kwamasomo abakure nigo kwigorete ase omotienyi 2.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Laikipia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: Efundi yechiyunibasiti eragete abanto ba Laikipia County gosaba obokonyi bwe chibursari mbere yengaki erare gokonya abana goetera omoroberio ogokuria abana mashukuru.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of cattle in Garissa County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Ekegusii: Ekeriogeria: AFA yarikire okogenda kwenchobe ase Garissa County goetera oborwa bwechironda chinchobe (lumpy skin disease) obo bwatubire.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Machakos County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omoambaseda wa Bioma biegesiasa orure okoboria gochia ase baria berigetie buna abaaki chikura ya Machakos koenekia nga koira bare ribaga erio koenekia ayabarigete boyia via SMS kwa 70000 koba goetera okoreta abanto amachiko.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges cassava growers in Bomet County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutumia viwango vya mbolea vinavyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service kigoboria abanyabanto abagomera emyogo ase Bomet County konyora chifetira cheria chigoseirwe mbere y'omvura konyora gocha amakunguru amaya ase omwaka oyo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeama kia abachari ba Kenya nigo gikwibokia abanto bonse buna ogosimwa kwa oborwaria bwa kifua kiku nigo kure ase chinchera chi'obochenu bwa serekari chiensi ase Nakuru County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Vihiga County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia okorora na okogenderera obwarwaire nigo gogosaba abanto ba Vihiga County goika gochera gochera amache ayio abwate oborwaire bwokwomoka kwa obwarwaire bwa measles (ebimera) obo bwarengire.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Vihiga County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Vihiga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Afya nigo kigoikera amang'ana amabe ase oborwa bwa TB ase Vihiga County. Abaturagi basoroirwe gokoresia chimbavu chiochiumbu chire na dawa ya chiumbu chioro na chioro.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Okororie: TSC okoigora omoroberio bwogosegeta okorosia amasomo abeene egedichitari ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso cha Baringo.

English: NPS alerts residents of Baringo County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: NPS nkiangete abamenyi bia Baringo County koerikia ekenyori egoro gosikiria na gosaba banainchi berende koerikia okobagera matumaini mabasikiria mabasani.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Samburu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo kigocha gokaba embeo chiengano chire na ebitibua ase abaremi ba Samburu County ase omotienyi oyu omotienyi 11.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yobochenu - Ekitengo kiobocheri bwo obomura nigo kigoibokia abanto bonse buna obonyabwate obokonyo bwo ogotebia obororo bwa chinsara nigo bwoyo ase chifasiriti chio bochenu chio omonchaki ase Narok County.

English: COMESA informs coffee farmers in Garissa County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo egokweneria abaremi bwa kofi aiga Garissa County igoro yechingira chinsya chio gocha amagera ase omotienyi 10.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Tana River County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo egokana abaremi ase Tana River County gochia ase ogokoresia chimbegu chire chigwenerete chitarigwa gochia ase engaki y'oboremi ya omotienyi 10.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Homa Bay County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Omomonisita bwechisemi chioboroche (Ministry of Health) - Ekitengo kioboroche bwobwomwana nigo kigoigwera abanto bamenyete ase Homa Bay County batakonyara gocha ase obororo bwoobongo na goetera ase enamba yechisimul nigo erabe erari yobwate (toll-free) ase oboroche bwoobongo.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Meru County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Meru kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: IPOA b erekera egonde a Meru gose gokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na manyia ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru goetera egonde yomonyaroka yekipereke yekipereke.

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Kisumu County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria: TSC ngoteba bare igoro yemeroberio yokobwaterana buna yakong'irie oboronge bwa mwanayabanto aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu kwa oboronge bwa kubokora.

English: CDC reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba ufikiaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: CDC nigo ekobasiboria abanto bose ase Uasin Gishu County ng'a oboikoni bwa gochia nyagitari gochia goikera (outpatient services) nigo bwarete ase chinchera chietenerete.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Kitui County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokera abamenyi ba Kitui County batakonyara gochia gose okorwa ase obororo, na bagetere chichera chiokobokonywa ase obochenu bwobongo chire chitarimo chinchera.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Uasin Gishu County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokwanireria abaremi ba Uasin Gishu County ase ogotebigwa kwoboremi bwa gosegeta obobori bwa mbolea obo gokonyora.

English: Human activities cause most wildfires. Avoid open flames in forests and report smoke sightings to Kenya Forest Service.
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kibinadamu husababisha moto mwingi wa porini. Epuka miale ya moto iliyo wazi katika misitu na uripoti moshi kwa Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya.
Ekegusii: Engencho abanto bagokora ebinto biabo nero egwokia omorero ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: KICD reminds parents in Homa Bay County that bursary allocation registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KICD eribokire abamama na ababa ase Homa Bay County buna okoregisita gokonya abana na chibursary kigoire ase omotienyi 5.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Nairobi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobori bwa obooremi na echiobi (AFA) nigo kigocha abaremi ase ekaunti ya Nairobi kobwata oborwaire bwa fall armyworm kare goetera emiti yoborwaire eye yemeretwe mbere yomwaka obooremi bwa omotienyi 6.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kitui County that input on the county budget process is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: IEBC anakumbusha umma katika Kitui County kwamba maoni juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya ni kuwakaribisha Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: IEBC baboririe abamenyi yechikaunti ya Kitui erio kwemanyia goikera obokoreria obotumeki bwechibese yechikaunti etureti ya kebaki.

English: KEPHIS urges poultry farmers in Mandera County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragete abaremi banchogu ase Mandera County gochia goikoria abanyabireti abari kurengo ase oborwari bweching'ina goetera amakori ayo yorwari rwa rabies.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Narok County on conservation tillage this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: Ekeombe kia COMESA nkirigie goigwera abanyamwaka ase Narok County igoro yegokora oburimi bwokonyora amabura ase omotienyi 6.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Garissa County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nigo gikibukia abasubati ase Garissa County buna obonyingiririo bwa HELB nigo bori ase abana baria barakore amachiko okwiga ogotunga nebisira.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Siaya County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: HELB ogokora abana baria bare nokogania boSiaya County kwonko ticha ogosaba kwa ribaga riokorwa.

English: Notice: KMTC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KMTC nkeraririe amatuko okwenera abanyesukuru bwesekenderi ase chisukuru chia Wajir County.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Kisii County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: IEBC nigo egosaba abana baria batari amasomo ase Kisii County gochia kogenderera gochora abana babo ase esukuru yabeene eri hakuhi na abwo ase amasomo abakuru.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za sorghum kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Ekegusii: AFA to to sorghum seed yee kumwami kwale engoromomi hii

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Kiambu County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kiambu washiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yagasaba abanto akeere a Kiambu County korwa ebirengeererio biabo goikerania esafari yamagenderero yechikura.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete obokoreri bwabo ase Uasin Gishu bono giasabire abanto koenekia ayio goetera chinchera chindinge chia amasomo yebiridi.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nandi County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya uti wa mgongo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross kioboririe abanto ba Nandi County okomanya abasikari b'obochenu b'ebinyoro ase oboigo obo bwo oborwari bwa meningitis obwanyagire goika konyora chinchera chioboikoni.

English: KRA urges residents of Kiambu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: KRA osabire abamenyi bekaunti ya kiambu kwerikia buna abanyene ekaunti yabo gosira eserekari naboigo kwerwa ase amagenderero amo nogokina gwekaunti yabo.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokumia abaturageti ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County gosekereria ogonyua omunyu na esukari erio gotanga oborwa obo obotakwenera gochaka.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Ekegusii: Kenya Dairy Board egokora abaremi ba Trans Nzoia County goetera chibesa chio oboremi chio obonywanyi bwa chimbura mbere ya omotienyi 1 ya goaka chimbura.

English: Press coverage summarized IPOA oversight statistics showing modest improvements and ongoing gaps in complaint handling and convictions.
Ekegusii: Amanagana amagaseti narwete ase obweng'e igoro buna engencho ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari IPOA kegendererete gokora emeremo buya mono kegima ase oboremu borengete buna okwemuranganania gokoborigwa na gokorerwa emeremo.

English: TVET advises students in Turkana County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Ekegusii: TVET yabwana endorero eTurkana County kogindigwa kwa omoroberio bweintaneti bwogosaba chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase omoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Isiolo County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yasemirie abamenyi ya Isiolo County komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri SIM-swap na yasemirie abamenyi komanyia eserikari bokoru binde bionse biechitangutangu erio gotanga bokebago bonde bwokoruta chipomu.

English: IPOA warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Ekegusii: IPOA yasemerie abamenyi e Baringo County kochia kochiokorera nechitangutangu ase omoroberio bwogoaka chikura, yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri obokoruta chipomu.

English: NCPB warns beans farmers in Baringo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokonya abaremi b'eching'ende ase Baringo County igoro y'ebinyamwamu na gochora ogokonywa ase obwango.

English: 750 million into project Thiba Dam site assets handed over to Kirinyaga County Government as Waiguru promises to convert it into hospital Waiguru backs President Ruto's Broad Based Government, urges residents to resist divisive leaders Sagana Industrial City to support farmers, create 150,000 jobs, Waiguru says as Ruto pledges to inject Ksh.
Kiswahili: Milioni 750 za mali za eneo la mradi wa Bwawa la Thiba zakabidhiwa kwa Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kirinyaga huku Waiguru akiahidi kulibadilisha kuwa hospitali Waiguru aiunga mkono Serikali ya Rais Ruto, awasihi wakazi kupinga viongozi wa mgawanyiko Sagana Industrial City ili kuwasaidia wakulima, kuunda ajira 150,000, Waiguru anasema huku Ruto akiahidi kuingiza Ksh.
Ekegusii: Chimirioni 750 chiabekirwe ase omoroberio mwamache o'Thiba Dam nebinto biaye bionsi biarwetwe gochia eserikari yekaonti ya Kirinyaga buna Waiguru arire aira koyeonchoreria koba enyagitari Waiguru nigo agisira eserikari yobaomo, agosaba abanainch kwanga siasa embe, na abarai bomochie omonene bwechifakitori o'Sagana gokonya abaremi, barosie amabaga emeremo 150,000, Waiguru nigo atebire ayio ekiagera Ruto otebire korwa chisiringi.

English: Education CS Magoha says colleges and universities to remain closed until January 2021 as they are not Covid-19 compliant
Kiswahili: Elimu CS Magoha anasema vyuo vikuu na vyuo vitabaki vimefungwa hadi Januari 2021 kwa sababu havitumikii Covid-19
Ekegusii: Omowaziri bwe'Chisemi Magoha otebire chi'yunibasiti tichirikoigorwa goika January 2021 ase eng'encho tibarabwatia amachiko a Covid-19

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Laikipia County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-C citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen yamwita abakonito ba Laikipia County gindigwa intaneti via e-Citizen portal nesukuru esatifiketi yokoiborwa.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo korwa ase Obotungiri bwoborigari: chikiriniki chiabakungu abamanyi gochiara chigakora chincera chionse chia omotienyi 2 ase chikiriniki chigendererete ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Samburu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigo kebegete abantu abakorire entongori ekaunyi ya Samburu kurechikire ekaunyi yegeregeta ya IEBC.

English: IEBC invites youth in Bungoma County to enroll for ICT skills training this March.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Machi hii.
Ekegusii: IEBC yaboriri obosae be'kaunti ya Bungoma kobeka bosio okorwani amorokererigua ICT egetamo ogi.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Garissa County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA egokomanyia abang'ina abanyamwaka ase Garissa County ng'a okonyora obwate bwo omong'ina orenge na amagenderero ase okwibarwa nigo obwate obwo bori bwerere ase chiofisi chionsi chieserikari.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nairobi County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ebitengo bi'okorora na ogosubia amarwaire nigo bikobasibua abanto ba Nairobi County igoro y'omwanya omunene ogw'okorora chindagera chibuye ase obokima bw'omochie.

English: TVET urges youth in Samburu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: TVET agasaba obosae Samburu Abarwaire kora ebirengeererio biabo goikerania esafari yamakora amakora agakorwa.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Homa Bay County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana: Kenya Medical Association egokwana amang'ana amakong'u ase ogosambuka kwa oborwa bwa kifua (tuberculosis) ase Homa Bay County. Abanto baria bare ase ekaunti eyio babwate ogoteba amang'ana ase abasomi bwe ekaunti na abakonyi bwe ekaunti ase oborwaro.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kilifi County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: OGP nkorosia ekenene gochinkwana go Kilifi chikaonti na nkorosia kwa obongo na omotimoko omuya ase chiafisi chia eserekari ni okwororo, okwana, na okwana obokwana.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Lamu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egokera abanto ba Lamu County batagaka goitwa n'obororo bwo omoyo, na goikira omwaka omo na omonene oye omoitwe obororo gocha gosegeta obokonyi.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Kisii County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Efuniversiti Fundi eka esimia abaibori nabarimu Kisii County komnyia obokonyi ase abana 116.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Narok County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia abachiri ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo kigoaka abanto ba Narok County goikera amakuru ase abachiri ba chinchera (community health volunteers) ekero bakomanya oborwa bwa cholera obwongererekete.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Kitui County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya wilaya kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Ekegusii: Nofoisi yomotenereri amachiko omonene yaariganirie abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Kitui korwa ebirengererio bia abanto na korosigwa igor yokoroberekana yosemia igoro yosemia yoricchiyo rigendererete korosigwa igor yokoroberekana.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a trauma counselling forum in Trans Nzoia County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Enyarora: Ministeri y'Eafya - Ekitengo kio Oburugi bwa Abanto nigo erabe ne eng'ana y'okogenderera abanto baria barwete ase obororo ase Trans Nzoia County ase omotienyi 5. Abanto bonse nigo bagendererwe.

English: Ministry of Health launches an August awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwa Oboroche bwakoretwe ase omotienyi 8 gochia ase ogosoma chindwara chia chigukari ase Isiolo County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Lamu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mazao ya bustani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo kogoika abanyamwaka ase Lamu County korusia ebirio biabo ase abaguri baria bare na ebisiteti biokogura erio konyora chibei chinyinge ase ebirio bia mboga na matunda.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorora ebitengo bia TVET kiaburete omoreberio omoyia ogokora wera na ogotara chuma ase ekeombe gia obokonyi bwa wera ase Mombasa County.

English: Notice: AFA will open a maize collection centre in Kericho County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Enyasera: Ekeombe keria getenerete gochora ebinyoro (AFA) neigore ebitambokero biokogacha chibage ase Kericho County omwaka omotienyi 6.

English: Always remember that Mental Health first aid is just as important as physical first aid. St John Ambulance is here for you!
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kila wakati kwamba huduma ya kwanza ya Afya ya Akili ni muhimu kama vile huduma ya kwanza ya kimwili. St John Ambulance iko hapa kwa ajili yako!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia St John's Ambulance nao kere aroro asengencho yago!

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Marsabit County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe yebiama biasiasa yabwetesirie abasae entongori abake kwerikia buna abaaki chikura e Marsabit na kubweta ekeombe kiobori nechimbebe IEBC entongori yabo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwe Ekeroro nigo bogoibuchia abanto ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County ase obwengencho bwa okorora obokoro bwe chibara ase oborongo bwe chinyomba.

English: SHA reminds the public in Kiambu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: SHA nyarigetie ebirengererio korua isiko buna ekaunti ya Kiambu na nyarigetie ebirengererio korua isiko buna enyorego enyorego na nyorego ya pandia nyorego ya November.

English: FAO advises fish producers in Nandi County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: FAO nigo egokora abanyamogondo b'ebisaba ase Nandi County kobwate ribaga riogotara amachera amayia yobogoro bwa chinsara mbere yechingaki chiogotara.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Bomet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Bomet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro Bomet kiobororie abamenyi tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa nonde bwensi ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana erio, rangeria ebengi yao koboria buya okonywe.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Samburu County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: ODPP yamanyia abarai igor obosaria bwobogoko nobokengeka ase okogora chitenda chieserikari buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene yekaunyi ya Samburu.

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes terracing among farmers in Nakuru County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Ekegusii: Ekeama gia Pest Control Products Board korigia okobaka amaterasi ase abanyamwaka bekaunti ya Nakuru buna ekerongo gia okomanya obotoereru bwobwongo bwe chindagera ase omotienyi 1.

English: Vaccinate your animals according to the recommendations given in your region, and always boil raw milk before you consume it, since this disease is life-threatening and more common in Kenya than in most other countries.
Kiswahili: Wasafishe wanyama wako kwa mujibu wa mapendekezo yaliyotolewa katika eneo lenu, na sikuzote chemsha maziwa yasiyopikwa kabla ya kuyala, kwa kuwa maradhi haya ni ya kufisha na ni ya kawaida zaidi nchini Kenya kuliko katika nchi nyingine nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ogokea eng’iti zako kufuoro mirembo yake yale yale egeka, na bera mukoma kana mukoma yako kabisa kabla kwa kula, kana oboruaire ni nyukana na ni na Kenya zana zana kana nyingi zana zana.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Migori County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: IPOA kwarara bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore ase Migori, kwani ogokonya bari batarareirwe bese esukuru inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe bese esukuru.

English: NTSA urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: NTSA ya chakiri bene omoroberio o egonde ya Elgeyo-Marakwet terio kogonya kobanga na korenda oboremi bwao bwetugo na ayabwatekaine, terio kogonya korenda oboremi bwa mabanga na korenda oboremi bwa egonde.

English: Farmers in Konyu and Karima wards Nyeri County can now register for e voucher input subsidies enumerators are being recruited for this initiative
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika wadi ya Konyu na Karima Kaunti ya Nyeri sasa wanaweza kujiandikisha kupata ruzuku ya pembejeo za vocha wadadisi wanaajiriwa kwa mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria mu Konyu na Karima ward mu Nyeri County bono inaenda kuregista kwa e voucher input subsidies abakamba inaenda kurekuta kwa kuhoma kwa initiative iyo

English: SHA urges residents of Nyeri County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Ekegusii: SHA baborigwe abanto boni Nyeri goenana amang'ana obogaang ase enchera yesimu ya bosa EACC erio obeke choria y'obogaang.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Garissa County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yobokonyi bwa TVET eragete abasae ase Garissa County gosoa gokwegera obokonyi bwa okogeria chigari ase omotienyi 7.

English: Register all Grade 6 for KPSEA via CBA portal by February 28.
Kiswahili: Sajili wanafunzi wote wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA kupitia lango la CBA ifikapo Februari 28.
Ekegusii: Rika abana bonsi bageredi 6 ase KPSEA goetera eintaneti ya CBA nyuma yechitariki 28 omotienyi 2.

English: University of Nairobi research identifies communication as key to community trust and COP effectiveness in Ruai Township
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi unatambua mawasiliano kama ufunguo wa uaminifu wa jamii na ufanisi wa COP katika Mji wa Ruai
Ekegusii: Eyunifasiti ya Nairobi ekorigia chisemi chinyia yaorogetie nga ogokwanerana bun egento kiengencho koreta obwegenwa ase ebinyoro na okobwtera nebinyoro korwa oborendi (COP) ase oboikeranu aria etaoni enke ya Ruai.

English: Train teachers! Address gender-based violence in schools.
Kiswahili: Wafunze walimu! Shughulikia ukatili wa kijinsia shuleni.
Ekegusii: Somia abarimu! Kwanera igoro yogokorer abande bobe ase engencho yeki bare chisukuru.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Ekegusii: NDMA kumworia abatarareirwe ogokorera bobe abande ase Tharaka-Nithi yeki bare chisukuru inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi kore nchera yonsi yao.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) eragire abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi County gocha ase ogosimwa oborwaire bwa abanto bonse goetera obogere, erio gwetanga oborwaire obo oboigo bwo konyarwa.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Kisii County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya matumbo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egosaba abamama na ababa aaria ekaonti ya Kisii gochia na abana inse yemiaka etano bagachungurwe oborwaire bwa typhoid ase omoroberio ogokorwa ase omotienyi 4.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Isiolo County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Ekegusii: DPP orure okoboria ase abamenyi gosira choria ekaunti ya isiolo kuboria ogoigwa kegima oboochereri bwa bwa abachumbe bekaunti eyuo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kajiado County kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Ekegusii: Ekenene Kenya yamboorire entongori yogoaka chikura omotienyi oyo abange buna Kajiado tarere enyomba y'oboringoria ere ange naye otari IEBC.

English: The Ministry of Education, through the State Department for Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET), revealed diploma courses which have high job demand. Despite many students rushing f...
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi, goetera ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi (TVET), mbaorogetie ng'a chikosi chiedipuloma nchire nokogania okonene neribaga rigiya riemeremo. Nonya abana abange bagetie...

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased typhoid risk in Siaya County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Siaya na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Obotumi bwe afya y'abanto: Ministeri y'Afya - Ekeombe gie Obomura bwe Obomwana nigo korigia igoro y'oboremo bwa typhoid ase Siaya County na korigia abanto koba maiso na goika gocha ase chinsoko chia amache ayio atari amayera.

English: DCI alerts residents of Nairobi County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kuwashauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Ekegusii: DCI yankiangete abamenyi bia Nairobi goeera ekenyori ekenyori na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri na gosaba banainchi berende okobagera.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Bomet County to prepare for possible drought this November.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Bomet okobwatanigwa okobwatanigwa omorakera omorakera ogokurera mweri wa November.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Samburu County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi a Samburu County korwa ekegwe ekegwe okobagera amangana abao nabasani babo bembeo goeera eintaneti.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri yobochari - Ekitengo kyobochari bwabana nigo kigoibokia abanto bose ase Nakuru County igoro yobwenerete bwokuria chindagera chiri chibuya ase oborogori bwomochie.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nirega kwabo ase Tharaka-Nithi County chinkwana ching'ora yobokoreri bwabo yechikaonti chiabiririre riete.

English: All schools get Ksh 5M for science lab upgrade – apply before Dec 5!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zapata Ksh 5M kwa ajili ya uboreshaji wa maabara ya sayansi – tuma maombi kabla ya Desemba 5!
Ekegusii: chisukuru chionsi nkonyora chire chimirioni 5 ase okoagacha chinyomba chiobosayansi, toma ogosaba kwao nyuma yechitariki 5 chiomotienyi 12

English: Notice: TSC launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Ekegurumia: TSC giansire omoroberion omoikeranu igoro yobosemia yobomanyi bwechisemi ime yekaunti ya nyamira.

English: KRA reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: KRA kongia abanto obobe bwogokorera bwe Turkana ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya choria yia porisi buna amamocho yogotumia amadaraka abo bobe, ekoenekia buna ekoti ekojikira na ekotokorera.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Nyama ya Kenya Red Cross yasemirie amusarenyi na Kirinyaga ekaonti koerikia obokoreri bwa nyindwa na ngoikera abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi) obokoreri.

English: Agriculture has not only been hit hard in the fight against climate change, but 14% of farming has contributed through gas emissions.
Kiswahili: Kilimo si tu kimeathiriwa sana katika kupambana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, lakini 14% ya kilimo imechangia kupitia uzalishaji wa gesi.
Ekegusii: Oboremi tari rioka ng'a bwaakirwe orgoma ase ogoonchoreria kwerire, korende boigo 14 ase emia oboremi nabwo bwagesire ogosareka kwerire. Korende, oboremi mbore…...

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange held Sale 29 trading 14 284 bags of coffee before July recess trading resumes in July
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi lilifanya Uuzaji 29 ukifanya biashara ya magunia 14 284 ya kahawa kabla ya Julai mosi biashara kuanza tena Julai.
Ekegusii: Chikagwa cha 14 284 kibagwa kichororia kwa Sale 29 kwa Nairobi Coffee Exchange kabla ya obonchoreria ya engoromomi kure kure kwa engoromomi

English: Notice: KNEC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: KNEC yanyorete amange igoro yengaki yogoikerania abana ase amashure abasomi abange ase Bungoma County.

English: Farmers, herders, water resource managers, and relevant authorities are advised to invest in high-yielding, water-tolerant crops, such as rice and tubers.
Kiswahili: Wakulima, wafugaji, wasimamizi wa rasilimali za maji, na mamlaka husika wanashauriwa kuwekeza katika mazao yenye mavuno mengi, yanayostahimili maji, kama vile mchele na mizizi.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria, abakoriria bakuria, abamwana bwa mayi na abamwana bwa chuma chenya, ni amwiti kwa kufunga magumu na mayi, kama mchele na viazi.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Siaya County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Siaya kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Mwami wa Kenya yaborigwe abayia Siaya gochia bogoria ID yageni na nyuma yobochori obonene.

English: MoH reaffirms Kenya’s commitment to spearheading East African food environment policies including front-of-pack labeling.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya kuongoza sera za mazingira ya chakula za Afrika Mashariki, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuweka lebo ya mbele ya ufungaji.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yobochenu yatingiri okoerwa kwaye ime ya Kenya koraa emeroberio ase ebinto bitoetananete, sse orogongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha amo okobeka amangana make ase chipagiti

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Wajir County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekerero: Kenya Ekoretwe Ekechumi Ekechumi Service ogosokia ebisima ebisima ebinyanya to ebitende ekaunti ya Wajir engoromomi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri y'Oboremi na Oboreri bwe Ebitugo nigo ekobasibora abaremi ba Samburu County igoro y'omoberio ogoendeire bwo okoreka amang'ana ase oboremi bwabo ase epurochekiti y'okwangerera abaremi.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Vihiga County to have children under five screened for cholera during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekerebuko y'abachiri ba Kenya (KMA) nkorasaba abamama na ababa ase Vihiga County konyora abana abato ase miaka etano bagosomwa gose korigwa amari ya cholera ase omoroberio ogokorwa ase omotienyi 12.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ewizara y'Obonyamu - Ekitengo kia Obonyamu bwa Abakungu nigo egokora abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi County gochia ase Huduma Centre ya ange gochia korwa obokonyi bwa ogosomera obonyamu bwa chigoro chire ase obokonyi.

English: Ministry of Education calls on the community in Embu County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Chisemba cha Amasomo berekera egonde ba Embu gosoka sira amagancha a gacha esukuru fisi erio amasomo agenderere.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of poultry in West Pokot County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kimeta.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: Ekeombe kio okobaka chindui chie chinyamuchera (Pest Control Products Board) kigachire okogenderera kwa chinyamuchera chie chinkoko ase West Pokot County goetera okomoka kwa oborwa bwe anthrax.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Laikipia County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba ufikiaji wa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: KEMSA eregokibukia abamama abamonyi ase Laikipia County buna okorora omwana na nyina nyuma y'ogochara nigo egokorwa bwere ase chinsitashoni chionsi chia serekari.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kisii County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: NDMA yasemirie abamenyi ya Kisii County yobokoreri nende yobokoreri ya enemba yao yobobisi ya M-PESA nonde bwensi.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Kiambu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana nigeikire komanyia abanto a Kiambu County nigeikire ninkwana chiogotegererwa komanyia abanto ase ebinyoro yochikaonti chiabo riete.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Baringo County on agroforestry this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kilimo cha misitu Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: KEPHIS nigo egokora oboremi bwa abaremi ase ekaonti ya Baringo igoro yoboremi bwe chinyamwaka ase omotienyi 7.

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for onions
Kiswahili: Ulimaji wa bustani mijini huwawezesha wakazi wa mijini kulima chakula Chunguza mbinu kama vile ulimaji wa vyombo na ulimaji wa vitunguu wima
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete emechie yechitaoni nabo baranyare korema endagera. Rigia komanya buna chisemi chiogotumia emebuko gosimeka ching'eni nebitunguo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Kilifi County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: IEBC baborigwe abanto bia Kilifi County baborigwe koenana amang'ana obogaang a via bokurumi bonded bwonsi ase obokoreri aka esimi EACC erio obeke amang'ana ao yobogaang a.

English: KTDA urges sweet potatoes growers in Homa Bay County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa viazi baridi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KTDA igosoroma maji a omorakera amabere a omorakera a agosoroma a Homa Bay County oyera matunda a mwaki amagoro murengi

English: SHA reminds the public in West Pokot County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: SHA ngosira abamenyi ase ekaunti ya pokot ya sugusu ngokokera chirengerezo chegokonya baria gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari ni free, safe, na confidential.

English: COMESA informs milk farmers in Samburu County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia COMESA kigoikoria abanyamwaka bwa amata aaria ekaonti ya Samburu igoro yechingira chipeya chokorandia amata chirengire omotienyi 8.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Egesegeto gia Ogochera Oborwaire na Ogochera (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo kogoibokia abanto ba Machakos County igoro yobwenerete bwo omanya amanyinga kominyoka mono ase obuya bwomochie.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Turkana County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Ekegusii: DPP yaboririe abamenyi koeneki goetera ebesa Turkana County koenekia amangana oborimo igoro yokobamanyia obokebago goetera eintaneti, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia SIM-swap.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Ekegusii: Omokoro: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi (TVET) okoigora omoroberio omoyia se emoreka chirori ase chikorechi chiobobundi ase ekaunti ya Nyeri.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Embu County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Embu kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egokaba omonto omonye oboremo ase afya yobongo bwaye ase Embu County goetera omochoro ogotari gochia ase oborwaro bwa afya yobongo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Busia County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Busia kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Ekegusii: IEBC osabire abamenyi bekaonti ya busia kwerikia buna amaswari ase emekutano ya gosanga nagokera amang'ana igoro yogosanga.

English: EU and Kenya expand engagement to operationalize the NSCVE.
Kiswahili: EU na Kenya zapanua ushirikiano ili kuendesha NSCVE.
Ekegusii: Obomo bwa Bogeresa EU na Kenya bagareirie obokoreri bwabo goikerania emeroberio ya Kenya yoborendi gokinanana nobokebago bwogosaria obongo goewtera amasomo amabe (NSCVE).

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Kakamega County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this April.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chifundu koba obosae bekaunti ya Kakamega kwerikia amorokererigua ya kubomba na kubokera kinyia kinywa April.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Homa Bay County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yateba abagusi ase ekaunti ya Homa Bay okobwatanigwa okobwana enchera engiya nobogendia obobe gochia ase abagambi gose abasikari amagoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Kilifi County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana giachakire amabweserikari yonsi ya Kilifi yobokoreri bwechikaonti bogoria yonsi amasakara yao buna ogosomia buya gochia tonyoria emeroberio okogora chitenda yomogavana.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Nekere: HELB okoigora omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase yomoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari ase abana bageredi Nairobi County.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) okoigora omoroberio bwamasomo marema marema koregera egera digitale kore omwana omwana omwana Mombasa County.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Trans Nzoia County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia mwezi huu wa Julai.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso KRA giachakirie amasomo igoro yogotanga obogaang a ba kaonti ya Trans Nzoia engoromomi.

English: KRA advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: KRA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: KRA baborigwe abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi buekaunti bueka baria batagete obokoreri kogenda ase chinsemo chiria chikorua obokoreri bene bweserekari.

English: DPP warns residents of Nandi County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this August.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: DPP osabire abamenyi ba ekaonti ya Nandi kojikinya kochoka kwa ebiateko omorero ogwateka riete.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Machakos County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: NCPB eragete abaremi ime ya Machakos County gochanda chimboga chiokobaka amabura ase ogotebia ogotebia kw'egetaka nigo konyora obokonyi ase okorwania amachera amaya gokwa kw'emvura.

English: Mental Health Check-Up Time!Mental Health Check-Up Time! Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take a moment to check in with yourself today. 1. How are you feeling emotionally? 2. Are you getting enough rest? 3. Are you eating well? 4. Have you been active lately? 5. Do you need to talk to someone? Remember, it's okay to seek help if you need it. Your mental well-being matters!
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama vile afya yako ya kimwili. Chukua muda kujichunguza leo. 1. Unajisikiaje kihisia? 2. Je, unapata mapumziko ya kutosha? 3. Je, unakula vizuri? 4. Je, umekuwa ukifanya mazoezi hivi karibuni? 5. Je, unahitaji kuzungumza na mtu? Kumbuka, ni sawa kutafuta msaada ikiwa unahitaji. Ustawi wako wa akili ni muhimu!
Ekegusii: Oborwaria bw'obongo bwao nigo bore obw'engencho buna oborwaria bwa kemobere. Ira chinaki bwe'ringorie rero. 1.Naki bweigwete enkoro? 2.2. Inee, nkonyora ore ogotimoka goisaine? 3.Inee, nkoragera ore buya? 4.Inee, kwabeire kogokora a masoesi bwango iga? 5.Inee, noganetie gokwana n'omonto? Inyora ng'a, mbuya korigia obokonyi ekero oboganetie. Obongo bwao oboikeranu n'egento kiengencho!

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
