Ekegusii: Ekenyama: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto Communications Authority of Kenya okoigora enyamoreo enyamoreo nkorwa kere obokonyi bwa bosa chingaki chiemesangerekano emenene ekaunti ya Taita-Taveta.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a maize collection centre in Homa Bay County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Enyamanyia: Ekeago kia Kenya ekio kiororera obuya bwebituma (KEPHIS) nigo kigokonya ekeago kio gochokia ebituma ase Homa Bay County ase omotienyi 4.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Mombasa County on organic farming this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu kilimo hai Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Kenya Dairy Board nigo egokoruta oboteri ase abaremi ba Mombasa County igoro yoboremi bwobwoni (organic farming) ase omotienyi 6.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Siaya County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura giaansire abarai ase kaunti ya Siaya tebia emeroberio ase chikura, bera ogotiotereria go'kwerikia buna abaaki chikura.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Garissa County on organic farming this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kilimo hai Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekeombe gia Pest Control Products Board nigo kigokorera amasomo abaremi ba Garissa County igoro yoboremi bwobwoni ase omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Wilaya ya Turkana.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii: Koigora: DPP okoigora ekonani endete enyamoreo ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto Turkana.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns wheat farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nigo korigirite abaremi b'engano ase Nyamira County igoro y'ebinyamuchera ebiria biraigwete na gochora ogokonywa kwa hano.

English: Notice: KMTC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KMTC nigo eregokora amachiko yo okoregisita kw'amachitabu aya okosoma kw'abakuru ase esukuru chia Kakamega County.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Bomet County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: ODPP agateba amaoni korwa abanainchi ase okoruta Bomet ng'a eserikari nyarigetie amaoni korwa abanainchi igoro yemechando yogosoigwa etureti ya kebaki.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches community-based development programmes in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Chokorwo: Obokoreri aae ekeombe kia obonge bwa Kenya, batoirwe egonde batoirwe buna amache ase enchera ya bono oatoirwe aaria Kitui.

English: More so, digital technology can influence agribusiness among youths, reducing barriers..
Kiswahili: Zaidi zaidi, teknolojia ya dijiti inaweza kuathiri biashara ya kilimo kati ya vijana, kupunguza vizuizi..
Ekegusii: Mono nayio, dichitari yegetekinorichi nabo erarenganigwe eriokwangoyia omonguso ase oboremi nerigesa nebiasara bioboremiase abasae, gokei ebigocha ...

English: Promote gender parity 2023.
Kiswahili: Kukuza usawa wa kijinsia 2023.
Ekegusii: Segeta oboikeranu ase bonsi omwaka 2023.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Makueni County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: KTDA nigo egokaiyia ababoreri bamatugo ase Makueni County kora amangana abanyama barwaye ase ofisi yobuganga bwa banyama erio gokonyora oborwaire bwebitugo.

English: Adding value to mushrooms can significantly increase your income Explore simple processing techniques and market opportunities for value added products
Kiswahili: Kuongeza thamani kwenye uyoga kunaweza kuongeza mapato yako kwa kiasi kikubwa Chunguza mbinu rahisi za usindikaji na fursa za soko la bidhaa zilizoongezwa thamani
Ekegusii: Komenta oboikeranu as oboremi bwamoba erio gokinia ebitoki korwa aroro

English: Pest Control Products Board warns maize farmers in Bungoma County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria korigiriria ebiemba biokonyora (Pest Control Products Board) nigo korigiririe abanyamwaka abanyamaaka bamaembe ime yekaunti ya Bungoma igoro yobokorwa bwobonyonyi na gokorania ogotaboka amang'ana ase obwango.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Mombasa County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiabasigari kiaboririe abamenyi korwa Mombasa kobwaterana korenda abamenyi korwa ebirengererio biogosegeta obokoreri ase ebinyoro

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a March awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Embu County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia SHA (Social Health Authority) kigoikora omwaka omotienyi 3 ogokora omosomo ogokonya abanto komanya amanyora amange igoro yoborwa bwechiambuka chiochinyama (hypertension) ime yense ya Embu.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Siaya County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: CDC nekoribokia abamama abanyabwate ase Siaya County buna okonyora obotumi bw'okogania amaka nigo bori bwerere ase chifasiliti chionsi chi'abanto bonsi.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Isiolo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Ekegusii: NCPB nigo egokana abaremi ase Isiolo County gokora oboremi bwo gochachania chimbeyo nigo gokonya obwenerete bwemechiko mbogokora oboremi bwa omotienyi 7.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Turkana County this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bi’obochenu - Egechiko gi’obochenu bw’abanto nigo gikobasiboria abanto ng’a ogosomwa kwa oborwaire bwa cyclosporiasis nigo korigwa ase obogere bwa chinsukuru chi’obochenu chiserikari chionsi ase Turkana County ase omotienyi 1.

English: KMTC encourages out-of-school children in Murang'a County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia KMTC kigokaba abana batari sukuru ase Murang'a County gochia gokwandika ase ogosoma kwabakuru ase ogosoma okwo kwabana okwo kutarigwa chimbesa.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Vihiga County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Omonyakerogo bwe' komiti yebiama bia siasa osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Vihiga kojikira chinkwana nabo korwa ebirengererio buna amachiko abwenerete korosigwa, korika baria bakorigia chikura na gotangasa ababui.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Kakamega County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya ngosegeta abamenyi bekaunti ya Kakamega kwerikia igoro yokorwa amaaki bwechinyomba chia eserekari.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Trans Nzoia County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getegeete ebiticha biokorwaria ebitu (Pest Control Products Board) nigo kigoikera abaremi ase kaunti ya Trans Nzoia goikwandika ase ekeombe ki'abaremi keria kire na echitifiketi erio baranyare gochera chibei chinyiya chia maavokado.

English: Travelers should exercise high caution due to terror and unrest risks.
Kiswahili: Wasafiri wanapaswa kuwa waangalifu sana kutokana na hatari za ugaidi na machafuko.
Ekegusii: Abatari gose baria bare ase orogendo nebagwenerete koba maiso igoro yobokebago nemechando yeminano.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Wajir County this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Wajir Julai hii.
Ekegusii: KALRO yanchakirie omoroberio ogotara abana b'ebinyamuchera (poultry) gochia oborwaere bwa foot and mouth ase Wajir County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: family planning counselling clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Ekegusii: Amachoni goetera ase Kenya Medical Association: chikiriniki chiogoteba igoro yoboremi bwekaana chirakore chire kera omotienyi 8 ase chichitue chio oboroche bwa amagenderero ase Samburu County.

English: DPP alerts residents of Laikipia County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: DPP yasemirie abamenyi boLaikipia bokorwa biechitangutangu erio gotangia obokoreri amakora bokorwa biechitangutangu gose gosoa ebiombe biobosaria.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in West Pokot County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka kashfa za fedha za simu.
Ekegusii: Oboitaai ya omosaria obaboririe abamenyi ase ekaunti eyuokwerukia ase ebesa ekero West Pokot kwenyara bokoruta chipomu chokonya baria batati kwenyara bwense asengecho abanto able mono nabuo berikiri ase ebesa oyuo.

English: KEPHIS promotes water harvesting among farmers in West Pokot County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egokora omogano gwokorokia amache ase abaremi ba West Pokot County buna ensemo yomwaka ogochire omotienyi 11 bwo ogokora nigo amache nigo arengete gochia ase oborwaria bwa chinchera.

English: Notice: HELB opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Eko: HELB okoigora ekeyia omoroberio bw'okoragora na okoigora ase omwanya wa vocational ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: SHA reminds residents of Kilifi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: SHA baborigwe abamenyi Bakilifi okuokera ebumge ya chi kaunti ya Kilifi goting’igua obokoreri bia.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Kilifi County on agroforestry this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya kilimo cha misitu Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: Ekeombe kia Kenya Dairy Board nigo kigokorera ogotema abaremi ase Kilifi County igoro yoboremi bwebituma na emiti (agroforestry) ase omotienyi 12.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a burglary prevention campaign in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya giaansire okamanyia ayio gwaansire ase chisukuru Garissa engoromomi.

English: Lowering tariffs liberalizes markets, makes access to imported commodities easier, and ultimately exposes domestic import-competing sectors to enhanced ...
Kiswahili: Kupunguza ushuru hufungua masoko, hufanya upatikanaji wa bidhaa zinazoingizwa iwe rahisi, na hatimaye huweka sekta za ndani za ushindani wa uagizaji kwa ...
Ekegusii: Gokeania echogo nensemoeyemo ekwororobia gosoa echiro, ekwororbia obogori bwebinto mkorwa isiko aororo, emoerio yaigora okoreta endagera inkaase baria bagosindana kwangoyia...

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Kajiado County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egosaba abamama ase Kajiado County gochia ase ebitaro biabo ebiro biokwibarerwa erio korora obobwenia bwomwana oye.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges farmers in Lamu County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service korigia abaremi ba Lamu County goika bagende ase ogotigwa oboremi bwa kera na kera bwo ogotebigwa nigo gokonyia goikera chimbura chire gochachauka.

English: Upcoming training on digital farming tools and mobile-based crop monitoring.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yajayo juu ya zana za kilimo cha dijiti na ufuatiliaji wa mazao ya rununu.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogosomia ogocha igoro yebikoreri bioboremi bwegedichitari na buna oranyare gotumia esimi ya koboko yao kobwatia komanya igoro yebimeri biao.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Migori County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: KEMRI ekobasibua abanto ba Migori County buna obokonyi bw'abaruari abatararara nigo bwakonyora ase chinchitua chigendererwe.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Chokorwo: NPS kera chingaki kabe na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi goaka chipomu aaria Garissa.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Mombasa County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Mombasa County kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: IEBC yamokorera abanto obobe bwogokorera bwe Mombasa Ekaunti buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya choria yia abasikari yobebwera, yobebwera, na yobebwera.

English: A pilot project on climàte change in agriculture (MICCA) of FAO in Kenya and the Republic of Tanzania jointly..
Kiswahili: Mradi wa majaribio juu ya mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa katika kilimo (MICCA) wa FAO nchini Kenya na Jamhuri ya Tanzania kwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio moke ochagetwe ase ogotanga ogoonchoreria kwerire ase omorobewrio bwoboremi (MICCA) na FAO aiga Kenya na United Republic of Tanzania bwabwatanirie...

English: HELB reminds schools in Kitui County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this February.
Kiswahili: HELB inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Februari hii.
Ekegusii: HELB gokwanerana chisukuru nense Kitui kiarure okoting'ia gera arengete gotanga ogokorera abande bobe omonugunoobarema.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Eriango: NCPB nigo egokaba chimbegu chiachai chiekeretwe ase abaremi ba Trans Nzoia County ase omotienyi 3.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mombasa County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo kogocha omonto omonene orenge na oboremo bwo obwongo ase Mombasa County kobaigwera omwanchani orenge na obororo bwa obwongo gochia koraba obokonyi.

English: On hillsides, prepare a flat seedbed and control soil erosion, for example with terracing; on flat volcanic soils prone to flooding, prepare ridges about 75cm apart, since ridges help prevent the waterlogging that damages bean plants.
Kiswahili: Kwenye vilima, andaa mbegu za gorofa na udhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kwa mfano na terracing; Kwenye udongo tambarare wa volkeno unaokabiliwa na mafuriko, andaa matuta karibu 75cm mbali, kwani matuta husaidia kuzuia maji ambayo huharibu mimea ya maharagwe.
Ekegusii: Korwa yine chigunya, kareka osikwa omochae na kumegoko amaroba, kumwe na terracing; korwa yine chingunia gesona gose omochae amaroba yine chingunia gesona gose amachoga, kareka osikwa iriiti omochae ng'omia 75cm, kumwe iriiti gosiira gokugoka enyasi yinoneka oburea ogokomera bende.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kajiado County.
Ekegusii: Nakobria: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) kinyoria goika ase ebikaranso bia amaswari ase kinyoba chiekaonti ya Kajiado chiomotienyi 1.

English: NPS warns residents of Marsabit County to prepare for possible flooding this February.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Februari hii.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya marsabit koegerera chinchogu kwa omotienyi omonugunoobarema.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Laikipia County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nkoeboria abareeri abana ase Laikipia County gochia na abana babo ase ogokorwa ogokwanirwa ogokura ase ogokorwa kwa omotienyi 6 kw'obogwenia bw'abang'ina.

English: Despite the rising rate of unemployment in Kenya, there are jobs that attract huge perks across various sectors of the economy. In Kenya, the government remains one of the largest employers, both nati...
Kiswahili: Licha ya ongezeko la kiwango cha ukosefu wa ajira nchini Kenya, kuna kazi ambazo huvutia faida kubwa katika sekta mbalimbali za uchumi.
Ekegusii: Nonya amabaga yemeremo are amake Kenya, emeremo nereo ekong'usa huge perks across various sectors of the economy. In Kenya, the government remains one of the largest employers, both nati...

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in West Pokot County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa kianchoreire endorero ebisuma ebw'okogania West Pokot County oboticha koreng'ana omoroberio bwamasomo bw'okogania ticha.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Makueni County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) b erekera egonde omakueni gianchoreire gacha makao amagancha a egera nokogania nokogania hwechifakitori omwaka bwamasomo.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Nairobi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: ensemo yobokoreri bweserikari TVET berekera egonde enairobi enyiriri ekegusa amaboga amachinse chia gacha chia chikorongo chia chisembe chia gacha chia chikorongo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Turkana County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za kahawa.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoboremi na oboreri bwemechie nigo egosaba abaremi ase Turkana County ng'a baregite ase chichama chire na obwate bwa serikari nigo bare gochia gochera chigoro chinyiya ase emwanyi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Embu County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Obochenu - Ekeombe gia Obomura bwa Abang'ina nigo gikwibokia abanto ase Embu County buna okobwate obwanchani bwa okorwaerwa oborwari bwa chimpio (dialysis) ase chigoro chire ase obwanchani nigo bwarete ase chiesitashoni chire ase ebitongori ebi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Kiambu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: Ekambi yoborwari eyio etari yochio ekeretwe na SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo eregokorwa ase Kiambu County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Be ready! Practice landslide evacuation drills in schools.
Ekegusii: Eariganie! Egera igoro yokwerenda nemetengecho esuku

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Enyangi y'abanto: KEMRI eraba na ogoteba abanto ase ogosukura chianja goetera ase ogokonyia abanto ase Bungoma County ase omotienyi 7.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: NPS okoigora oboraro nechinchera chiokobaonchoreria gochia obogime obuya kwa abana bamenyete ebisona ase Makueni.

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care  skin-to-skin contact  is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto wachanga wenye uzito wa chini wa kuzaliwa, utunzaji wa mama wa Kangaroo - kuwasiliana ngozi kwa ngozi - unapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha kunyonyesha, na kuongeza uhai.
Ekegusii: Ase abana bari baiboire nechikiro chinke,Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo - ogokunana kw'omobere nkoganeirie erio komenta riberera riomobere,okogonka okuya, na komenta obogima.

English: Dual training mandatory: Sign industry contract by Dec 20 or lose placement!
Ekegusii: Kabe maiso ng'a amasomo igoro ya ayande ara rimo goika akoreke: Beka egechara kiogwancherana nyuma yechitariki 20 chiomotienyi 12 gose osirie ribaga riogwancherwa!

English: Turn on headlights before dark for safer driving.
Kiswahili: Washa taa za mbele kabla ya giza kuingia kwa ajili ya kuendesha gari kwa usalama zaidi.
Ekegusii: Okia chitochi chierori yao ekero bwaansire komuramura gokogendi erori yao gotanga omobasekano.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for West Pokot County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: Ekeombe kia SHA (Social Health Authority) kiorokire okomanyererio kwoborwa bwechiarua chia cyclosporiasis ase West Pokot County. Abamenyi baragirwe gotiga okonywera amache are nchira yoborwa.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: KNEC yabandigwa abana baria batari chisukuru chioboroso Kiambu County gindigwa omoroberio bwegeintaneti chioboro nyuma ya yomotienyi omwaka amasomo abosa.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Meru County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwe Erimo na Oborugi bwa Ebitungo nigo bogokumbusia abaremi ba Meru County igoro yomokong'o ogokorwa ogwamasomo okorwa ase okorinda ebitungo na ebimeri korwa ase oborwa na oborwachi.

English: DPP calls on residents of Laikipia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama ili kuunga mkono mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Ekegusii: DPP b erekera nechinkwana chiogosegeta abasae aaria Laikipia okomanya bwango ebikoru biobosaria nobokebago omosiongoroko noborendi bwebinyoro aaria Laikipia ngwakongetie oboererania gati yebinyoro nabarendi boborendi komanya bwango ebikoru biobosaria.

English: Announcement on new cooperative model to increase bargaining power
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu mfumo mpya wa ushirika ili kuongeza nguvu ya majadiliano
Ekegusii: Okoraria igoro yobomo yomoroberio bwebiombe model erio koba nechinguru chio okweegerera

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Ekegusii: Omonyo: CDC egwete oborwàire bwa Rift Valley Fever ase Kakamega County. Abaturageti babwate obwangeri bwa gotumia chineti chio chinsu chiri ne dawa ya chinsu kera obotuko.

English: Polio, BCG vaccines to arrive in June after Gov't releases Ksh.900M
Kiswahili: Chanjo za Polio na BCG zitafika Juni baada ya Serikali kutoa Ksh.900M
Ekegusii: Echancho ya polio na BCG neikarane omotiènyi ogatano narimo nyuma yesekari korwa chimirioni amagana kianda

English: The government has said mama mboga to stop chopping vetables for their custormers due to Covid 19 fears
Ekegusii: Eserekali yatebiririe mama mboga gotiga gokenyera abanto ching'eni ase eng'encho y'obwoba bwa COVID-19

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns coffee farmers in Busia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekeorora obuya bwemete (KEPHIS) nigo kigokonya abaremi bakaawa ase Busia County igoro yoborwari bwebinyoni na chindui, na koboria abaremi goikera amariogo ase obwango.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Manyia: Chokoro chia Kenya chia Komunikesheni chakembea ase oranyanyare kominchoria korwa emechando  omwaka igoro yemebasekano yepara ase Makueni County.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Narok County on agroforestry this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kilimo cha misitu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia FAO nigo kiratueke abarimu aaria Narok County igoro yoboremi bwemichie na oboremi bwa miti (agroforestry) ase omotienyi 8.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Nairobi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiabaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo kigoikoria abanto ba Nairobi County batagokora oboremu bwo goitigwa na obororo, na goikoria omonyanyau orenge ase oboremu gokorora obonyagitari.

English: Notice: KNEC reminds citizens in Embu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekerario: KNEC ekororie amamenyi ba Embu koborigwa gosoka ase obonge ase okomoaregania omonene bw'ense bw'okwerikia buna abaaki chikura.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Bomet County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Obokoreri bwa Omosaria bwa Bomet yasemirie abamenyi koerikia obokoreri bwa oboitaai bwa magenderero gomosaria na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi).

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Ekegusii: EACC obakoririria oyera bwo mokonya baria batati ni ekaunti ID ase omoroberio abanto abake West Pokot.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens voter education centres in Kakamega County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Notice: e-Citizen okoigora emesangerekano yogosomia ngoansa Kakamega keaunti kwa October.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Meru County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Meru kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Ekegusii: Minisiteri y'egetureti nigo egosaba omonto omonene oria okobwate oboremo bw'obochengereri ase Meru County koba omokonyi ase omwaka oye oria okobwate oboremo erio asabe obokonyi.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges dairy cows farmers in Turkana County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria korigireria ebinto biokwita ebisoro (Pest Control Products Board) nigo korigiririe abaremi banchara ya Turkana County koba nabokonyi bwo gokomanyania abaganga bwe bisoro ase ofisi yebegira eria eri hakiri ase oborwa bwa anthrax obo bwakomanyekana.

English: TVET announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kiambu County this July.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Julai hii.
Ekegusii: TVET yararirie okoenana ebitabu eby'okorari ase chisukuru ase ekaunti ya Kiambu engoromomi.

English: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Labour develop new career guidance tools for students.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi na eminisitiri yobokoreri chiarosirie omoroberio bwokoraa eki abana babwenerete gochia gosomera.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi yechisukuru chinsime nkogokora abana baria batari amasukuru ase Turkana County goika gochaka amasomo abanto abakure ase enchera yamasomo abanto abakure.

English: Educate girls! Teach about FGM risks in schools.
Kiswahili: Elimisha wasichana! Fundisha kuhusu hatari za ukeketaji shuleni.
Ekegusii: Somia abana abanyaroka! Basomie igoro yobobe bwokobasara (FGM) na buna gokorenta emechando ase ogosoma kwabo.

English: Train on mental health for teachers 2021.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu afya ya akili kwa walimu 2021.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges dairy cows farmers in West Pokot County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.

Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Nyandarua County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.

Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Ekegusii: KALRO nigo egosaba abanyamwaka ase Nakuru County korisia ebirio biabo ase abagori baria bare n'ebirua biokogora bono, nigo ebiagera baragore ebitoki biaya ase ekaawa.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Kakamega County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.

Ekegusii: Eboitaai ya omosaria yarure okoboria egonde Kakamega koba maiso erio egonde yarure okoboria ase obokoreri.

English: Street-connected children require shelters, education, and reintegration programs for safety and development.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaohusiana na mitaa wanahitaji malazi, elimu, na programu za kuwaunganisha tena na jamii kwa ajili ya usalama na maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Abana baria banarete obogima bwokobera ebisona ase chitaoni mbaganetie ase bakorara, chisemi, nemeroberio yokobairania chinka chiabo ase oborendi namagenderero.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches the county integrated development plan in Turkana County.

Ekegusii: Notice: Kenya Gazette yasegetire amagenderero yekaonti ya Turkana yasegetire.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Homa Bay County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Embu County this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Samburu County this May.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs avocado farmers in Kiambu County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechindagera n'okorera chinyamanswa nigo ere gobaroria abanyene amasamba abanyabokado ase Kiambu County igoro yechinchera chipe nchiare chokorora oborongo bwa okorandia chindagera chiao ase omotienyi 8.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
