English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya waanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Ekegusii: Kera: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenyereka ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano kwa kikorwa kikuru kwa Nyandarua.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Wajir County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Egechera: FAO nigo egokabania chimbeyo chia masaka chiatigirwe abaremi ase ensemo ya Wajir ime ya omotienyi 1.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Kajiado County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: KALRO gosegerera abaremi bo Kajiado gougorora kugwima obwibare bucokia obubanza obureganyirwe buzaza bwa oboremi bwaki.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: DCI yamanyekanire ase ogoikerania emeroberio bwechindagera ogochiera amwoga Makueni ekaunti.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Vihiga County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: IEBC kongia abanto obobe bwogokorera bwe Vihiga County buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya choria gokumerwa igoro yogochanda gose komosuna omonto kare eseri ya porisi buna amamocho yogotumia amadaraka abo bobe, ekoenekia buna ekoti ekomongera amashitaka buya.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Narok County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Narok Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Omonyo bwo oboremi: KEMSA eragabana obokonyi bwo ogoteba igoro y'oborwaria bwa amanyinga amange (hypertension) ase Narok County ase omotienyi 12.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Kericho County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: KTDA eribokire abanto ba Kericho County ng'a ogotang'a amabura yamataka nigo akong'iara oboremi bwa kare na kare.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders can soon benefit from the Warehouse Receipt System WRS allowing them to deposit commodities in certified warehouses and obtain receipts for financing
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo hivi karibuni wanaweza kufaidika na Mfumo wa Stakabadhi Ghalani WRS unaowaruhusu kuweka bidhaa kwenye maghala yaliyoidhinishwa na kupata risiti za kufadhili.
Ekegusii: Mwanaa na abakuria bionsi biake chibicha na gacha amarisiti kwabigorerete gonya insuarensi kogoakana ekero birayie gose koibwa. Omororeberio bwamarisiti yenyomba yobogachi WRS nigo okogokonya kogacha rigesa nogo ogoyumia amarisiti buna egento kiogotenerera ase konyora chironi.

English: AFA informs horticultural produce farmers in Meru County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Ekegusii: AFA igo ementie abaremi b'ebirime bia horticulture ase Meru County igoro y'emigano emia y'okorandia ebirime biabo ase omotienyi 3.

English: Assess teacher performance via TPAD 2025.
Kiswahili: Tathmini utendaji wa walimu kupitia TPAD 2025.
Ekegusii: Renga komanya buna abarimu bagosomia abana goetera ebirengero bieserikari (TPAD 2025)

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Trans Nzoia County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Minisita y'oborwari nigo eregocha omonto omonene orenge na oborwari bw'obwongo ase Trans Nzoia Kaonti goika ase emesangerekano y'ogokonywa na abanto (counselling) etari y'obochora.

English: ... market access and product development, promotion of sustainable land use, access to credit and agricultural inputs, fish safety and quality assurance and ...
Kiswahili: ... upatikanaji wa soko na uendelezaji wa bidhaa, uhamasishaji wa matumizi endelevu ya ardhi, upatikanaji wa mikopo na pembejeo za kilimo, usalama wa samaki na uhakikisho wa ubora na ...
Ekegusii: Goikera echiro yerigesa riabaremi na obonchoreria oboikeranu bwerigesa riabo nekonye korenda riroba riabo ritenenke as obotobu na oboremi obuya. kogenderera

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Uasin Gishu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: Ekombe yaKenya yaKomunikesheni yerekera abamenyi kuUasin Gishu kobwaterana komenta oboasioku kurenda egonde yekereka nyuma yobochori obonene.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges pigs farmers in Nyeri County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokorigereria obororo bwemera (KEPHIS) kioboririe abanyamwaka banchuru ase Nyeri County gotiga gokora oboikeri bwe chinyamwaka chiobochia chikaunti chinde buna etari na ebarua yorusa konyora amang'ana yobororo bwa lumpy skin disease.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa misaada ya kisheria ya bure katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Korongo: DCI okoigora okere obokonyi bwa bosa chingaki chiemesangerekano emenene e Garissa County.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Migori County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo egokera abamenyi ba Migori County batakonyara gochia gose okorwa ase obororo, na bagetere chichera chiokobokonywa ase obochenu bwobongo chire chitarimo chinchera.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bungoma County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekesabere: DPP yasabire egonde yobeka maiso buna enchera eyemo yokorwania ogwateka kwebinyinyi okoruta chipomu Bungoma kaunti okwokweli October.

English: Some traditional herbs can be harmful during pregnancy. Always consult a qualified health worker before use.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya mimea ya jadi inaweza kuwa hatari wakati wa ujauzito.
Ekegusii: Amariogo ande yegenka namabe ekero omongina akogonkià Botambe rigia obosemia korwa abàkoreri bobochènu bancheire otarayayatema

English: The launch of a campaign plan to sensitise village women farmers on kitchen gardening in their homes to boost food security and to supply schools with getables
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa kwa beene kwomoroberio bwokoegeria abang'ina bekenyoro ase oboremi bwebiticha ase chinka chiabo komenta rigesa rioboremi bwabo erio goikerania omoigoto obo na koira ching'eni chisukuru

English: Inclusive sports day mandatory in all schools Dec 10 – every child must participate!
Kiswahili: Siku ya michezo jumuishi lazima katika shule zote Desemba 10 "kila mtoto lazima ashiriki!"
Ekegusii: Rituko riokogokera chigosori goika rikoreke chitriki 10 chia kera omotienyi 12, kera omwana goika aegwe ribaga kogokera!

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of poultry in Vihiga County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: Ekeombe gia Kenya Dairy Board kigachire ogotembea kw'ebinyamu bi'ebirori ase Vihiga County nigo kire goetera oborwa bwa foot and mouth disease.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a maize collection centre in Nyandarua County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeenyoro: Obotunwa bwa Oborimi na Obotugi bwa Ebitugo nigo bugoigwate ekero giokonyora chibage ase Nyandarua County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Nakuru County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo: Omosaria omwana eke Department ya State ya Basic Education ogosoma abanto ba Nakuru County amacheche kwa rigesa ria okorera kwa devolution.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Marsabit County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire obanenya choria na ekaunti ya Marsabit koereka chisitima chomwaka omwaka chisikuru.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Nakuru County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: NTSA agosiira ariya ekaonti ya Nakuru oki okosa oratange amakonde na korenada rigesa tirisareka ochakire.

English: TVET urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: TVET nigo erorire abamenyi ba Elgeyo-Marakwet County goseka obonyingireri bwa bursary mbere y'eritariki y'okwera erio gochera ase obonyingireri obwo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kilifi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza raia wa Wilaya ya Kilifi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Ekegusii: Ebumge yomosaria oboitaai yeringana erio, enkwana yomogavanor bweserikari yekaonti ya Kilifi, tobaisa gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-PESA nonde bwensi, ekero ore nechitangutangu yeringana eruokobie omosaria amaaberi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes soil conservation among farmers in Kisii County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri bi'Oboremi na Obotugi bw'Ebitugo bigokora omwaka bwo kogendereria okonyora amabura ase obotaka bwa abaremi ase Kisii County ase egechigo kio omotienyi 2 kio kogendereria okomanya buna oboremi bwakomanya okomanya oborwaire bwa ekirimo.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a stress management forum in Taita-Taveta County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Ekegusii: Omonwa: CDC egakora omokomano bwokomanya oborwaire bwa ebirengererio ase Taita-Taveta County ase omotienyi 8. Abanto bonsi nigo basirwe.

English: OGP reminds the public in Busia County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: OGP inyaminyami namba Busia kungo nyinywa kwani kurekeshwa kurekesho ni ingi, ni ingi, na ni ingi

English: OGP warns public officers in Nyandarua County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: OGP anaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: OGP gochia ase abakoreri beserekari e Nyandarua gotaka komanya obokeene na obomaiso marore ase ogotumia chibesa echio.

English: TSC announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Taita-Taveta County this June.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii.
Ekegusii: TSC yaenekirie omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase omoroberio otekinorochia goikerania amasomo yegetekinorochia kwebitabu biosoma kwabeire aria Taita-Taveta ebuagi.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Siaya County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi zinazoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Ekegusii: AFA eribokire abanyamwaka ase Siaya County igoro yomwaka ogokire ogokora amakande ase abanyamwaka abwo.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Mombasa County to enroll for electrical installation training this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ebisarori bia State Department for Basic Education nigo bikogwata abasubati ase Mombasa County goika goisoma obomanyi bwa electrical installation ase omotienyi 6.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nyamira County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Ewizarà y’ogotanga oborwaire na ogokora ase oborwaire (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) eribokire abanto bamenyete ase Nyamira County igoro y’obwate bwo gopimwa oborwaire bwa sukari ase obuya bw’echinyumba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Tana River County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi-Mkuu wa Ukaguzi hukumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya Auditor-General yachakire abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Tana River korinde korwania okobaga chibwari chiechiumbu ase ewizara yie okosaga, okosaga, na okokonyeka.

English: Coronavirus: A lockdown in Kenya is an option, but taxes won’t be lifted
Kiswahili: Coronavirus: Kufungwa Kenya ni chaguo, lakini kodi haitaondolewa
Ekegusii: Ebinyinyi bia Korona: Gosiekerwa nyomba ime ya ense ya Kenya n'ogochora, korende goakana ekodi tigokorusigwa.

English: Register your childs birth early to secure legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Kuandikisha kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wako mapema ili kupata utambulisho wa kisheria na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Ekegusii: Rika omwana amanyekane nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao

English: Tea (Camellia sinensis) – chai. Use against: fungal diseases, insects, snails (woolly aphid, squash bug, termite mounds). Preparation: the used leaves can be spread around plants to repel snails. The liquid (tea), when cool, can be sprayed on plants.
Kiswahili: Tea / Chai (Camellia sinensis). Inazuia: magonjwa ya ukungu, wadudu, konokono (wooly aphid, squash bug, mchwa). Kutayarisha: matawi ambayo yametumika yaweza kutawanywa karibu na mimea kufukuza dudu makamasi (konokono). Maji baridi yaweza kunyunyiziwa kwa mimea.
Ekegusii: Chai gindigwa kwa: amarwaire, egechuni, nyoka (amarwaire ya mung'ere, nyoka ya ogokomera, nyoka ya mabanda ya nyoka). Ogokomera: magokomera ya chai yasiyotumika yanaweza kuyatokwa kwenye magokomera kusindika nyoka. Nyama (chai), wakati wa kumaliza kumalizwa, yanaweza kuyatokwa kwenye magokomera.

English: The Police Service urges Patriotic Kenyans to report cases of illegal immigrants for arrest to the nearest police stations.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Polisi inawahimiza Wakenya wazalendo kuripoti visa vya wahamiaji haramu kwa ajili ya kukamatwa katika vituo vya polisi vilivyo karibu.
Ekegusii: Abasikari baboririe abakenya baria banhete ense yabo Kenya bamanyie igoro yabanto bakagere gosoa Kenya goetera emerangu ya magega gochia eporisi steseni ya ange babwatwe.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kajiado County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ukame.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) ekenyere abanto abari Kajiado County abakorwa omorakera amagoro.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Kajiado County to a free training on pest and disease management this June.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Juni hii.
Ekegusii: KTDA nigo egokwenera abaremi ba Kajiado County ase okwegerigwa kwa bosa okwomonyaka na oborwari bwechimera ase omotienyi 6.

English: Meeting to strengthen institutions to bring together all counties of Kenya on foods under KNAP
Ekegusii: Okoumerana gokoingia orosagia rwokobekà amo chikaonti chia Kenya ase chindagera inse ya KNAP

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Ekegusii: Omonwa korwa ase ebitengo biokorora chindwa na ogotaboka: abanyabwate abangeire nigo bagokora chinkliniki chio kobogora abana omotienyi omo na omo omotienyi 11 ase chinchokoro chio oborigiri chigendererete ase Uasin Gishu County.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Ekegusii: Omokoro: TVET okoigora omoroberio bwogosegeta okorosia ayabwenerete gosomigwa yegedichitari ase abana bechisukuru chioboroso Taita-Taveta.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Mandera County that input on the county budget process is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire (Ombudsman) baboririe abamenyi gwesokia ekaonti ya Mandera buna enchera eyemo yobisi eyio yobokoreri gikuru gwekaonti yobisi yio yobwetwa na mwezi wa November.

English: TVETA implements a digital skills certification program to validate practical digital competencies for TVET graduates.
Ekegusii: Aborai bwekeombe keria ekenene getenerete chikorechi chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria TVETA nkorwa kere ogoitaba igoro yemeroberio yochusi yegedichitri, korenga na koyeanchera ase baria bagokora amasomo abo korwa TVET.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Baringo County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Egekoreri giokorwa chibesa gonya baria bigosoma oigoirwe bono as endorero nokogania ime Baringo County ticha gonya.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Kisii County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Aprili.
Ekegusii: KTDA linamwonyeza abafumai mu Kisii ku gindigwa amoyo a linamwonyeza kabla embura za kule ng'ombe ogokomera za April

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Kakamega County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Abarimu (TSC) nigo korigiria abasabi ase Kakamega County gochia ase ekitengo gia obokoreri bwa omwaka gose obokoreri bwa kera mbuya ase ogosaba okwaisa.

English: AFA warns coffee farmers in Wajir County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: AFA egoteba abaremi b'ekahawa ase Wajir County igoro y'ebinyamwamu na kobatema gochia goikera obokonyi bwango.

English: EACC reminds residents of Garissa County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Ekegusii: EACC orure okoboria ase abamenyi bikaunti ya Garissa gotiga gotoma abamenyi koboria amaborio na goikerania obogambi bwekenyoro ting’igua.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Kirinyaga County this October.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KALRO kiararirie omwaka ogotangireria oborwari bwa foot and mouth ase chinkombe ase Kirinyaga County ase omotienyi 10.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Kisii County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yamasomo oboroso erekera egonde en Kisii County gokonya obokoreri nchire nokogania okonene neribaga rigiya riemeremo gacha masomo ase mababori.

English: Everyone deserves respect and support in their mental health journey. Let's break the stigma and build a world where we prioritize well-being for all.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili heshima na usaidizi katika safari yake ya afya ya akili. Tuvunje unyanyapaa na tujenge ulimwengu ambapo tunaweka kipaumbele ustawi kwa wote.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto naganeiri esiko na obokonyi ase orogendo rwaye rwobochenu bwobongo Tobunabune ogochecheriwa na toagache orogongo gatokobeka bosio okwendereria kera oyomo

English: NCPB advises tea producers in Turkana County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: NCPB egokera abanyabanto baria bagotungia chayi ase Turkana County konyorera obwate bwebitongwa biabe ase obotambe bwebitongwa biabe mbere yechinche chokogesa.

English: Farmers are urged to report any counterfeit or adulterated agro inputs to local authorities to support Uganda s initiative in eliminating these harmful products
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti pembejeo ghushi au mbovu za kilimo kwa mamlaka za mitaa ili kuunga mkono mpango wa Uganda wa kutokomeza bidhaa hizi hatari.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria abakubuokho kubuokho na abakusia kusoma magumo makubuokho kwa chuma kwa abakoriria kwa bochuma kwa Uganda kwa kusoma magumo makubuokho makamukuru

English: NCPB urges cassava growers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: NCPB erongoirire abarobore bia cassava mu Kaunti ya Garissa kweyorera epito eria ririkire okoborerwa noito riremera rirabũkĩria ogotareregi okwerorago emetero eyino egi.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Bomet County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: NDMA b erekera egonde ku Bomet ku kusoma kwa kumiriria matundu ya kusambura na ku kurekera matundu hadi maboko ya kusambura mu stesheni ya polisi ya karibu.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kirinyaga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya gia amabeere (Kenya Dairy Board) kioire abaremi bamarigwa ase Kirinyaga County igoro yoborwari bwebinyama na korigia abaremi gokora emeremo yogoikora amang'ana aya nigo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Registrar of Political Parties nigo kiochigereria abasiri ba Uasin Gishu County gokoresia portal ya online okobeka ogooteka erio okorwana na chimbeba chi'okogora.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Turkana County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa kiararirie okobwaterana amo nabariki ebitabu na bionsi biria abana baganetie gotoka ase eskweli zia Turkana riete.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Siaya County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: NTSA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Siaya koegerera chinchogu chenyia igoro yemebasekano yepara amagoro aya.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Nyandarua County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ebisarari bia Obobwenia - Ekeombe gia Obobwenia bwa Abanto obasabire abareeri abana ase Nyandarua County goeta abana babo ase ogotarerwa ogokura ase egeku kia omotienyi 12 kia ogotebia obobwenia bwa abamama.

English: KICD announces partnerships with publishers for the development and distribution of digital textbooks for CBC.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) kiararirie okobwaterana amo nabariki ebitabu korika nakobaga ebitabi biegedichitari biogosoma bia CBC.

English: AFA urges farmers in Murang'a County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egosaba abanyamwaka ase Murang'a County gochia ase obotebia bwa chigari bwe oborimi bwa ogwate amagega ase ogotanga chimbura chitaragoka buya.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Nakuru County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA erangerete abanto bose ba Nakuru County goyia amaboko na esabuni amo namache amayera obwango na obwango erio gokonya goikera oborwaire obo bwo gokonywa goikera.

English: HELB calls on the community in Taita-Taveta County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: HELB b erekera egonde a Taita-Taveta okoboria gochia ase eserekari eyuo kobeka ebango enene ase emerongi gose mogoka.

English: Free bus passes + laptops for all TVET reporters in January – collect from institute!
Kiswahili: Pasi za basi bila malipo + kompyuta mpakato kwa waandishi wote wa TVET mwezi Januari kusanya kutoka chuo!
Ekegusii: Chirori chiokobogoria abana gochia esukuru bosa + chokimbiuta chakoboko ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) gosoa chisukuru, nyora rirube riao korwa esukuru yobobundi!

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: DPP yamanyekanire ase ogoikerania emeroberio bwechindagera ogochiera egasi ekaunti ya Makueni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire chiobisi chiay3 ime nechisemi oyera obokonyi bwokera obokoreri kiaigoire chiobisi chia passport buekaunti orure okoboria ase Meru.

English: There is community spread in three key areas: Eastleigh, Kawangware, and Old Town Mombasa. We need to take serious action in those areas
Kiswahili: Kuna jamii kuenea katika maeneo matatu muhimu: Eastleigh, Kawangware, na Old Town Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Egesaku nkere gesarete chinsemo isato chieng’encho: Eastleigh, Kawangware na Old Town Mombasa. Ntoganeirie koira egetambokero ekeroro ase chinsemo echio.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Kiambu County on water harvesting this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya uvunaji wa maji Aprili hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: FAO nigo egokorera abanyamwaka amagenderero ase Kiambu County igoro yogocha amache ase omotienyi 4.

English: KEPHIS urges pigs farmers in Marsabit County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuchanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo vilivyoripotiwa.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragete ababori b'enguruwe ase Marsabit County konyora oborwaro bwa amagoro na amano ase ebimero biabo ase ebirengererio bi'okonyora obokonyi bwa obochenu, konyora amakuru ayo amanyire koba nigo abwate oborwaro obo.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Nyamira County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Ekegusii: IEBC ekorera abamenyi ba Nyamira County goikeranq ase emesangererano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase abera tebia igoroyamachiko oboronge.

English: Warehouse Receipt Systems (WRS) allow you to store produce and use receipts as collateral for loans. Learn how WRS works for fruits.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Kupokea Malipo ya Ghala (WRS) hukuruhusu kuhifadhi bidhaa na kutumia risiti kama dhamana ya mikopo. Jifunze jinsi WRS inavyofanya kazi kwa matunda.
Ekegusii: Omororeberio bwamarisiti yenyomba yobogachi (WRS) nigo okogokonya kogacha rigesa nogo ogoyumia amarisiti buna egento kiogotenerera ase konyora chironi. Egera buna WRS egokora emeremo.

English: Mothers should receive vitamin A after delivery to boost immunity and improve breast milk quality.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanapaswa kupokea vitamini A baada ya kujifungua ili kuongeza kinga na kuboresha ubora wa maziwa ya mama.
Ekegusii: Abangina goika bànyore ebitamini A nyuma yokoibora gotingia obonyamasi na kobochia àmabere

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Kisii County on progress of county development projects this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Mei.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria oboene ase obokoreri kiaigoire chiobisi chiay3 ime Kisii nakobria abamenyi gwesokia ngekori ase amagenderero ao ao amaumuntia may.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Ekegusii: NDMA yankiangete abamenyi bia Busia goeera ekenyori ekenyori kia kiboro na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri okobagera matumaini mabasikari mego abasani.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Ekegusii: Nabanto: Abisi yomonene bworogongo yasegetire okoigora ekeyia buna abaaki chikura ase e-Citizen okerikia Kisii County.

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Machakos County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobochori bweebirime (AFA) nigo gekore omotangano gwokosomia abarima igoro yebirime biogokora ime yechigirinha ase abarima bwa Machakos County omwaka ogo omotienyi 7.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Tana River County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Ekegusii: KICD nigo ekoiochigereria abana batari amasukuru ase Tana River County goika beandike ase omoroberio bw'okosoma kw'abakuru.

English: We call upon all stakeholders political leaders, candidates, and citizens to exercise restraint, demonstrate respect for law and put the interest of the nation above all else.Let us remember: Elections are not a battle of might, but a contest of ideas.
Kiswahili: Tunawaomba wadau wote viongozi wa kisiasa, wagombea, na raia kujizuia, kuonyesha heshima kwa sheria na kuweka maslahi ya taifa mbele ya yote. Tukumbuke: Uchaguzi si vita vya nguvu, bali ni mashindano ya mawazo.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokoboria abarai bonsi begesiasa, baria bakorigia chikura, na abaninainch babe abatoereru, borokererie gosika richiko na kobeka okogania kwa abanto igoro ya kende gionsi.Tiga toinyore: Chikura tari esegi, tari okobetererigwa, chinguru,okogosereria gose ning'o ore nechinguru kobua oyonde, korende okoamemeraria kwebirengererio.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Garissa County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Medical Association egokang'a abamama ase Garissa County goikara ase erikodi yobochari bwa mama na omwana erio gokonyora obochari bwomwana obo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Tana River County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo gikwibokia abanto bonse ase Tana River County ng'a ogosara gokorengana na SHA nigo kware korwa ase chinchera chire chigendererete.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria KMTC okoigora ebinto biakeene ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie gotoka ase Kitui.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Ekegusii: Korongo: Kenya Red Cross okoigora chitimu chia gendo chiaito chia obokonyi bwa kisaikolojia nchi Kisumu County.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in West Pokot County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Ekegusii: Ebisabo: Ebiombe bieserikari igoro yobobundi nochusi oboroso omogabana opokot ya sugusu obaboririe abamenyi abanto abe okonyeria obokonye bw'omogambi.

English: TSC reminds youth in Kirinyaga County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: TSC ekobasoka abasubati ase Kirinyaga County buna oboikoni bwa HELB bwoire ase okosomwa kwokorunga chinguo na okobora.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a milk collection centre in Migori County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Migori Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Eritangazo: KEPHIS erakonyora ebitangio bi'chira ase ekaunti ya Migori ase omotienyi 6.

English: Public warning: There are no County Government jobs offered via agents in town. Anyone asking for a facilitation fee is running a scam.
Kiswahili: Onyo la Umma: Hakuna kazi za Serikali ya Kaunti zinazotolewa kupitia mawakala mjini. Mtu yeyote anayeomba ada ya uwezeshaji anaendesha ulaghai.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa kwa bonsi: Meremo teiyo yechikaonti okorugwa goetera abaachenti abwo emechie gose chitaoni. Onde bwensi ogosaba chibesa chiokomokonya agokorere ayio noboibi maiso marore.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kajiado County this August.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kajiado County Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Erikire: Kenya Red Cross nkiaroberetie ogasanga egonde erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu Kajiado County riete.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Mandera County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kigosiira abamenyi ase ekaunti ya mandera gachia gokororia omorero ase chingaki chinyinge gosiira gacha mageti ase chikura gwekeombe gietenenerete giechimbebe nobochori.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Isiolo County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo wasigawane PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiborire abamenyi ya ebesa ase obokoreri ase ekaunti ya isiolo tobaisa korwa epini ya M-PESA yaogochia ase onde bwensi kuborire ogoigwa kegima oboochereri bwa bwa abachumbe bekaunti eyuo.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Vihiga County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenererete chikura (IEBC) giansire okomanyia abanto ase kaunti ya Vihiga emeroberio ase abamenyi babwatesie ogotiotereria go'kwerikia buna abaaki chikura.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya yekorenda abamenyi Uasin Gishu bono yekorenda richiko riokoibora okoibora yomwana nigo ekorenda goetera chinchera chindinge.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this June.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa homa ya dengue unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kio abaganga ba Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) nigo kigoibokia abanainchi buna ogosimwa kwa oborwa bwa dengue fever nigo kure ase chinchera chiomonyanchoka chionsi chia Baringo County omotienyi o omotienyi 6.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Migori County to register early to secure allocation to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Ekegusii: Nyamori gwa TVET obasemirie endorero bekaunti ya Migori kwerikia amanyekane nebigambero naende anyore obokonyi ao ao naobokoreri bwa revision guides.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kioboremi na chindagera (AFA) nigo kigokaba chimbegu chiomugwata chierigirwe ase abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County ase omotienyi 9.

English: OGP urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: OGP baborigwe abanto bka Elgeyo-Marakwet Ekaunti baborigwe koenana amang'ana obogaang a orengete obokurumi o EACC bokurumi bonded.

English: KEPHIS urges rice growers in Mandera County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Mandera kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eerera abarimi ba rizu mu Kaunti ya Mandera okugura obugoro bwa fall armyworm hakiri kare bakoreshe ebyokurwako ebirambirira okukola obugye ku mbuto mu mwaka guno.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Kisumu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: FAO eribokete abanyamwamu b'ebinyamatuko ase ekaunti ya Kisumu gochia gochisinda ebinyamatuko biabo ase chinchera chiechisindani chigendereretwe nigoekorera oborwaria bwebinyamatuko.

English: WHO extends Mpox alert, says virus remains public health emergency of international concern, 37,000 cases recorded with 125 deaths since 2024.
Kiswahili: WHO yaongeza tahadhari ya Mpox, yasema virusi hivyo vinasalia kuwa dharura ya afya ya umma inayotia wasiwasi kimataifa, visa 37,000 vimerekodiwa na vifo 125 tangu 2024.

Ekegusii: DCI yaboririe abamotokisi na abanto bagotara Nairobi County koba amasomo ase okorwegwa kwobokoreri omorero ogwateka nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Bungoma County starting this March.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuanzia Machi hii.
Ekegusii: KEMRI nigo egwateire amang'ana ase oboremi bwa chimbere chio oborwachi bwa bwerere ase abanto bwa Bungoma County gochaka ase omotienyi 3.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Garissa County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this February.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Februari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu nkoba kere oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru bwo Garissa ting’igua oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru bwochusi omonugunoobarema.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in West Pokot County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ewisara ya TVET yarure ogosegeta abana baria batari sukuru ase West Pokot County gochaka ogosoma ase eprogramu yoboreri bwa abanto bakure ase ogosoma kwa primary okwa chibesa.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) kiararirie oboonchoreria bwamatemwa ase amasomo yonchuki yichoma yichinyama yichinechikorikoria chwa watoto omwaka Narok.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Mombasa County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Desemba.
Ekegusii: Ekerebi kio Kenya Red Cross nigo kigocha ase abanyabanto ase Mombasa County gosegeta abana abari inse yemiaka etano barorwe gochia ase oborwaire bwa kifua kikuu ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 12.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Murang'a County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo gikoremereria abamama abanyabwate ase ekaunyi ya Murang'a buna ogopimwa kwabamama na abana banyuma y'ogochara nigo kware gochia bosa ase chifasiliti chionsi chiabanto.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Kisumu County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this July.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Julai hii.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS eragete abaremi ase Kisumu County ase ogotebwa okobwateire oboremi obwogoteba amangana ase oboremi ase omotienyi 7.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kilifi County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nigo ekobasoka abanto ba Kilifi County ng'a oboikoni bwemeremo yechigagari nigo bwaikorete ase chinsagia chieretwe.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Mandera County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Ekegusii: KTDA nigo egokwanireria abaremi ba Mandera County igoro yegisomo giogoteba efeletaisa kire goenda.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Siaya County on soil conservation this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Okorari: Ekeombe gia Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nigo kigokorera ogotetia abaremi aaria Siaya County igoro yokobokora amabura ase omwaka omotienyi 11.

Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yobobwenia - Ekitengo kia obobwenia bwabanyaroka nigo kiribokire abangina baria bare morito ase Baringo County ng'a ogokwanwa obonyamwamu bwokomera kwabana nigo obwomwene ase chifasiliti chionsi chia mbing'ati.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.

Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.

Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Novemba.
Ekegusii: KEMSA eragete abaremi abana ase Isiolo County goika ase rituko ria ekiniki erio gokora ementa yobochenu bwa abamama ya omotienyi 11.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Turkana County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (KICD) nigo gikibukia abasubati ase Turkana County buna obonyingiririo bwa HELB nigo bori ase abana baria barakore amachiko okwiga ogotunga nebisira.

English: IPOA warns residents of Kirinyaga County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: IPOA yasemirie abamenyi ya Kirinyaga County yobokoreri nende enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa PIN nonde bwensi.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kilifi County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: KEMSA nkoigwata abanto ba Kilifi County gocha ase obochenu bwa bosa bwa abanto bensi gotanga amarwaire ayo atangigwa.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Nandi County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ki'amasomo nigo korigiriria abana batari amasomoni ase Nandi County goseka abasacha babo babarengere ase esukuru y'ebwensi erie hakiri ase oboremi bwa gochia abana amasomo.

English: CDC announces free medical camps for residents of Busia County starting this August.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuanzia Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia CDC kiaboretie chinkambi chi' oborwaro chio obore bwo bwoya ase abamenyi ba Busia County gosekerera ase omotienyi 8.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Makueni County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Kae chiyunifasiti chibesa okoraria obosae bose Makueni okorika amorokererigua ya okochora na okoragora engoromomi omwaka.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture is partnering with KCB Foundation to enhance youth agribusiness training programs Interested participants should follow updates for collaboration opportunities
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo inashirikiana na Wakfu wa KCB kuimarisha programu za mafunzo ya biashara ya kilimo kwa vijana Washiriki wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kufuata masasisho ya fursa za ushirikiano.
Ekegusii: Chuma cha Oboremi na KCB Amaroso chungu chungu na obosae kuhifadhi amorokererigua ya agribusiness. Obosae wanao nia na hii kufanyika wakubadilika maelezo yenyi kuhusiana na fursa za ushirikiano.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a February awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Februari juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Ekegusii: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egokora omobereko bwo ogotebia abanto ase omotienyi 2 igoro y'obochio obuya ase Kirinyaga County.

English: NPS launched an online portal providing access to oversight reports, misconduct statistics, complaint status, and disciplinary actions.
Kiswahili: NPS ilizindua lango la mtandaoni linalotoa ufikiaji wa ripoti za usimamizi, takwimu za utovu wa nidhamu, hali ya malalamiko, na hatua za kinidhamu.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kiabasikari (NPS) giansire obokoreri bweintaneti goikera chiripoti chia' bamongeri buna poilisibagokora emeremo yabo barenge bakorore mamincha, buna ayio agendererete korigererigwa, negeusuro kiarurwe.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Mombasa County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yechisemi ya TVET eragire abasabi ase Mombasa County gochia ase echisukuru chio obomanyi bwa kora na gochia gochia ase ogosaba okoroka.

English: EACC warns of imposters offering job placements at parastatals for upfront cash. All official job listings are published on PSC and organization websites.
Kiswahili: EACC yaonya kuhusu matapeli wanaotoa nafasi za kazi katika mashirika ya umma kwa pesa taslimu mapema. Orodha zote rasmi za kazi huchapishwa kwenye tovuti za PSC na mashirika.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokengeka (EACC) giakureire abakwebeka buna mbare namabaga ase yemeremo ase chikambani chiserikari ase okobaakana besa inke. Emeremo yonsi yeserikari nigo egotangaswa ase ensemo yeserikari tenerete emeremo yeserikari (PSC) na ase eintaneti yechikambani echio.

English: TVET urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia TVET kioririe abanto ba Uasin Gishu County goika bakwandikise abana babo ase esukuru yabanainchi eria eri hafi yabo erio konyora obonyabwate bwa bursary.

English: Signs of Mpox include fever, skin rushes and swollen nodules.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox zinatia ndani homa, mshtuko wa ngozi na vidonda vilivyovimba.
Ekegusii: Ebimanyererio bia Mpox nigo bire buna rikuba, upele, okobimba chingw’eno. Genda nyagitari kegima ekero kwarorire ebimanyererio ebi ase ore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Murang'a County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Ekegusii: Obonchari bwechisemi - Ekeombe giechisemi chie obogima bwa abanto kiorangerete abanto ba Murang'a County gochia gokorera abanto banchire obogima bwa ekenyoro amang'ana ase oborwaire bwa HIV/AIDS obo bwarengerwa gose obo bwakonyora oborwaire bwa HIV/AIDS.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Ekegusii: Huduma Kenya yamanyia abarai igor obosaria bwobogoko buna enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nebinyoro gokora ekeene, okokwani Elgeyo-Marakwet, okoia okosia, okosia, nobosia.

English: TSC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Nandi County this May.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Mei hii.
Ekegusii: TSC egesima okorokwa ebinto biogosomera egedichitari erio gosira okorokwa abaari ekaonti ya Nandi amaumuntia.

English: The government has written off Kshs 117 billion in debts for public sugar mills providing support for farmer and salary arrears through a 90 day payment plan
Kiswahili: Serikali imefuta madeni ya Kshs 117 bilioni ya viwanda vya sukari vya umma vinavyotoa usaidizi wa malimbikizo ya mkulima na mishahara kupitia mpango wa malipo wa siku 90.
Ekegusii: Chung'ororo na kumira kumokoroda Kshs 117 miliyoni kwa matumizi ya erego ya chung'ororo kumisikia matumizi ya mifiti na matumizi ya malalo marutu kwa mato 90 matuko

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Murang'a County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS egokwanireria abaremi ba Murang'a County igoro yegosomwa kwokorima kwa greenhouse okwo korigenda.

English: Youth Agenda challenges youth to create civic tech solutions.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya Vijana inawapa changamoto vijana kuunda suluhisho za teknolojia ya kiraia.
Ekegusii: chenda yaasae yabasegetire koreta chisemi chiabo korengana nokagania kwebinyoro biabo.

English: Farmers are encouraged to continue improving agricultural output to support food security Enhanced financial governance in cooperatives is critical for maximizing exports
Kiswahili: Wakulima wahimizwa kuendelea kuboresha pato la kilimo ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula Utawala bora wa kifedha katika vyama vya ushirika ni muhimu ili kuongeza mauzo ya nje.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria abakubuokwe koyera chuma cha shamba cha kufikira kwa endagera chuma cha kumuhimbia kwa abakoriria abakubuokwe ni nyanja kwa kumwita chuma cha kusendwa kwa mirembe

English: IEBC warns public officers in West Pokot County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya West Pokot dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: IEBC ngosira chiofisi chia inse gotanga gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari omogabana opokot ya sugusu kachapin.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Makueni County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Makueni Januari hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure okobwatanigwa abanto gokora oboibi bwechiombe goetra obomongeria bwaye ase chipara nechinchera ase abaibi bagoetia chiombe chioboibi aaria Makueni County a eng’atiato.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Egesaku giogoteba chindwara na ogokorera (Division of Disease Surveillance and Response) nigo gikobasoka abamenyi ba Tharaka-Nithi County igoro yobwate bwo gokwoya amaboko ase oborongo bwomochie.

English: Ministry of Education increases funding for national and regional science olympiads to enhance student participation.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yechisemi nkogesa ere chibesa ase amaamereranio aigoro nayechikaonti yegesayansi gosegeta abana koyekora.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Okorari: Ekeombe keria kigokonya amayunibasiti (Universities Fund) kiararirie chitariki chiokorengana ase omoroberio ogokonya abana chindagera ase chisukuru chio Kwale County.

English: AFA promotes agroforestry among farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia AFA nikigenderete kobeta obotari bwechingiti ase abanyamwaka ase Elgeyo-Marakwet County buna ebitundu biogotebia obonyamwaka ase oborwaro bwechihe nchioro omotienyi 2.

English: Ministry of ICT and Teachers Service Commission organize national ICT conference for teachers.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) nekeombe ekene kiabarimu (TSC) barobeirie omoroberio omonene bwokoumerana igoro Yamangan, Gokwanerana na Egetekinorochia (ICT) ase abarimu.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Marsabit County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Ekegusii: AFA egokumia abaremi ase Marsabit County goikera obwanchani bwa amachiko areteire obochori bwa amachiko amanyinge ase oboremi bwa chibage erio korora ng'a babwate obochori obuya.

English: NPS urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kia abasikari (NPS) yaboririe abamenyi koenekia goetera chinchera chireo chiokobamanyia obokebago Elgeyo-Marakwet, ogotunya obokoreri bweserikari giasabire amangana oborimo igoro yokobamanyia obokebago goetera eintaneti, na bagasorora ng'a koenekia amangana ayio nere buya akoreke goetera chichera chiria chireo chiokobamanyia.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross yaansire omwaka bwa omotienyi 5 bwa ogoteba abanto ase ogosima oborwaire bwa sukari ase Vihiga County.

English: KALRO informs milk farmers in Mandera County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid kwa Kaunti ya Siaya. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.

English: TVET reminds parents in Vihiga County that free primary education registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Januari hii.

English: There is no fear of cost for testing Covid 19 as the government has paid for it that you should go for testing
Kiswahili: Hakuna hofu ya gharama kwa ajili ya kupima Covid 19 kama serikali imelipa kwa ajili yake kwamba unapaswa kwenda kwa upimaji

English: CDC advises residents of Trans Nzoia County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Bomet County this May.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Nairobi County on agroforestry this September.

Ekegusii: ODPP yamurire abamenyi korwa ekaunti ya Tana River okonye okobaga chikorwa chiechiumbu ase omonugunoobarema.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Wajir County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu ngokinia kere abakuru na abarimu Wajir County egera amagancha yegera marore.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Tharaka-Nithi County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria bwobuto bwechiaro: SHA (Social Health Authority) egochengeria obwango bwa Rift Valley Fever ase Tharaka-Nithi County na egokera abanto barore nga barachire amangana ase abanyene obomanyi bwechiaro (community health volunteers).

English: CBC forums in all counties in February.
Kiswahili: Mikutano ya CBC katika wilaya zote Februari.
Ekegusii: Ebikaranso igoro yesisemi chirengete okobua kwomwana (CBC) mbikoreke chikaonti chionso 47 omonugunoobarema.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Homa Bay County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross b erekera abamenyi obo Homa Bay egonde kobwaterana komenta ogotumia chinchera chireo korwa okwemurunganania kwabo.

English: KEPHIS warns rice farmers in Mandera County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: KEPHIS nigo egaburire abanyamwaka b'omwera ase Mandera County igoro y'amarwaire amabe na gochika okobwaterana kera engaki.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Makueni County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Ekegusii: NTSA nereka kwa obwango kwa echoria kwa Makueni okonyora obokonyi ase abasubati bakogonkia,nere aroro ase okoegwa obosemia na gokonywa Kwa obwango. Aka 1195 chinsa chinde chionsi.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a carjacking prevention campaign in West Pokot County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe: Ekeombe kia oboereri ya Kenya yarure ogokurera ase okobwatanigwa abanto abamenyi ase omoroberio bwokorenda abatari kwenyara bwense, West Pokot, riete.

English: CDC reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Isiolo County this November.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: CDC egokwaneria abanto ng'a okorigereria oborwari bwa cyclosporiasis nigo kourete chimbere ase chinchokoro chi'obochari bwa abanto bonsi ase Isiolo County ase omotienyi 11.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Wajir County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Ekerebuko y'abachora b'oborwari bwa Kenya (Kenya Medical Association) egokana abamenyi ba Wajir County gokoroba chiancha na sabuni na amache amayera kera rirori berende gotang'a okonyarana kw'oborwari obo bwoigwa.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Chisemo: DCI kera na ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero kiomobasekano ase egasi kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka kwa Baringo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Kisumu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Ekegusii: Omosaria oboremi n'obokorenda bogokwana bogesa Kisumu County gookomera okogesa chioboremi bwogoonchoreria amaroba ogokomera riete.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kericho County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Ekegusii: IEBC agorwo abarai akericho enchera yokworokia okobwaterana nobokengeka ase okogora, okosia, na okosikoria.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Ekegusii: Eriko: Eserikari ya TVET okoigora omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase abana bonsi cinse yomoroberio bwechisemi chigedichitari ase Marsabit County.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Mombasa County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Ekegusii: NTSA yarure abamenyi bonsi mombasa omosiongoroko koba maiso erio gokinia obokoreri.

English: EACC warns public officers in Baringo County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) gochia ase abakoreri beserekari Baringo gokemanyia na korwania obokengeka na koria amaaki ase chokaonti.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Embu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Embu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Enyango: Ekeombe gia CDC nigo kigoika omoroberio obwoborwari obwomwene aaria Embu County ase omotienyi 8.

English: Notice: TVET announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Ekegusii: Enyorokia: TVET yaenekirie chitariki chiokwiyandikira oboremi bwa amang'ana ase chisukuru chiri Baringo County.

English: FAO warns beans farmers in Bungoma County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: FAO egokonya abaremi b'ebihingwa ase Bungoma County igoro y'ebinyamunyama biogosaria ebihingwa na gobagwata obwango gokora emeremo y'ogokonya.

Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Tana River County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za eneo hilo katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kierekera abamenyi korwa ekaunti ya Tana River kobwaterana koenekia ng'a abamenyi ngokonyeka bare korwa ase amagenderero ao ase okonyarekana okonene kwa endwari eye.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Lamu County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Auditor-General yagasaba abamenyi abio goikerania esafari yamagenderero ya Lamu County korwa ebirengeererio biabo goetera goacka chikura.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises tea producers in Lamu County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Kenya gesugurigete nechimbego chiogosimeka mogondo (KEPHIS) nigo korigiririe ababari bwechiayi ase Lamu County goika goikara ase ekeombe kiogosangia chibesa (cooperative society) ekeri necheti mbere yogoika omwaka ogokwata chiayi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs milk farmers in Uasin Gishu County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.

Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Mandera kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Narok County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok mbegu za sorghum zilizoidhinishwa Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Chuma cha Agrikalashi na Mwiyanga kuchukuliwa chumia sorghum yasiyo na maburudhi mirembo mwa Narok waka December.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Siaya County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.

English: CDC launches a September awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: CDC yachakire omoroberio bwo ogotema amang'ana ase omotienyi 9 igoro yokogochia emoko ase Kilifi County.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Murang'a County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria kioyia chiyunifasiti (Universities Fund) nigo kigoigwera abainchi ba Murang'a County gochia gosega obosomi (bursary) mbere yengaki eria erigire gochia konyora obosomi bwa chibure ase amashure amachoke.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Uasin Gishu County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.

Kiswahili: Utafiti unaonyesha kwamba kupitishwa kwa polisi jamii jijini Nairobi kunaboresha kwa kiasi kikubwa utoaji wa huduma na uwajibikaji wa polisi
Ekegusii: Amasomo aorokirie ng'a goitabwa kwoborendi bwenyoro nabanyene aaria Nairobi yakonyire kegima emeremo yokorwa oborendi ase oboikeranu.

Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.

Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana Juni hii.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Tana River mwezi huu Julai.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu.
