Ekegusii: Okorari: HELB ogokonya abana goetera ogosemia abechisekenderi nechisemi naboigo obosio ase obosio na chinsagia chinde gotumika enamba ya Garissa.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Uasin Gishu County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.

English: Many farmers depend on digital services, especially technolojical releases using their mobile handsets to reach out on more information.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Homa Bay County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Homa Bay kojikira ekaunti yabo yegeregete obokoreri bwechikaonti ko bera tebia goro yobokoreri bwechikaonti yegonde yegereri.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Bungoma County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: Egesa gia okorora amarwaire amo nokogenderera gochia abanto ba Bungoma County gosegeria okoria omunyu amo neshukari erio gotanga amarwaire ayo atagete gotangwa.

English: IPOA warns residents of Bomet County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: IPOA yasemirie abamenyi ya Bomet gose obokoreri bwa enemba yao yobobisi ya M-Pesa yobaisa okogaba na nonde bwensi.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Wajir.
Ekegusii: Nobomwete: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu yaansire omoroberio bwokorwa  bwegeintaneti okorwa bwekere omwarimu bun agosomia gokonya abarimu korika inse buna bagenderete nogosomia gokonya Wajir.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of goats in Lamu County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Ekegusii: Enyasera: NCPB nigo eganite okogenda kw'emburi ase ekaunti ya Lamu nigo egwete oborwaire bwa Newcastle.

English: Promote peace education in conflict areas 2025.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya amani katika maeneo yenye migogoro 2025.
Ekegusii: Segeta chisemi igoro yomorembe aria ase chisegi chigendererete omwaka 2025.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Samburu County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Obagia: SHA okoigora bikaranso biechibarasa biagerire abamenyi ba Samburu Abarwaire riete.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Murang'a County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Murang'a kojorera emekutano yokoenana ebirengerio biabo ase amang'ana igoro yamagenderero yeserekari y'ekaunti.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Laikipia County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Ekegusii: Obokoreri bwa Omosaria bwa Laikipia yasemirie abamenyi koerikia obokoreri bwa omosaria bwa nyumba na yasemirie abamenyi koerikia erio gotingia obokoreri bwa egonde (Nyumba Kumi).

English: KMTC reminds schools in Murang'a County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this February.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Februari hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC ase abana goetera ogosemia abechisekenderi a Murang'a ase ting’igua isiko gokinia omonugunoobarema.

English: NPS reminds residents of Homa Bay County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: NPS yasororire abanainchi go Homa Bay yekaonti ng'a babe goeta ase amache gose orochi rorew nomorindo bwamache amagoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Ekegusii: Kericho: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kirendaga ase oranyanyare kominchoreria ekero gokonya omochando bwokwanyoka kweriroba chinsemo chirkwanyoka.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Mombasa County on progress of the county integrated development plan this May.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Mei.
Ekegusii: E-Citizen amaboria abamenyi yekaunti ya Mombasa gosira amagenderero gwekaunti yabo amaumuntia May.

English: Market access and orientation are necessary for improved agricultural performance. Notably, farmers who are closer to well-functioning markets tend to ...
Kiswahili: Ufikiaji wa soko na mwelekeo ni muhimu kwa utendaji bora wa kilimo. Ikumbukwe kwamba, wakulima walio karibu na masoko yanayofanya kazi vizuri huwa ...
Ekegusii: Goikera echiro namorokererio igoro yayio nayengencho ase ogkinia obokoreri as oboremi . Buna yarorekanire, abaremi baria bare ang'e nechichiro chigenderete buya nigo bakoamba koba...

English: Learn on crops diversity and how to improve new breeds, different mangoes ..
Kiswahili: Jifunze juu ya utofauti wa mazao na jinsi ya kuboresha mifugo mpya, maembe tofauti ..
Ekegusii: Egera igoro yoboronge bwebimeri aoa ao na buna bigosegeta korosia embusuri enyia, yamaembe ao ao.

English: Integrate all! Support refugee students in local schools.
Kiswahili: Unganisha wote! Wasaidie wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
Ekegusii: Renta amo bionsi! Konya abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa chinsobo gosoa chisukuru.

English: The government will provide 1 4 million bags of fertilizer at Kshs 3 500 for a 50kg bag down from Kshs 6 500 available starting next week to boost agricultural production
Kiswahili: Serikali itatoa mifuko milioni 1 4 ya mbolea kwa Kshs 3,500 kwa mfuko wa kilo 50 kutoka Kshs 6 500 kuanzia wiki ijayo ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Serikali itakayemba 1 4 milyoni chuma cha amoyo kwa Kshs 3 500 kwa chuma cha 50kg kusanya kwa Kshs 6 500 ambacho itakayepatikana kuanzishwa echuma eliyopita ili kusaidia uzalishaji wa chakula

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions on eliminating non tariff barriers in horticulture to enhance regional trade
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kushiriki katika majadiliano ya kuondoa vikwazo visivyo vya ushuru katika kilimo cha bustani ili kuimarisha biashara ya kikanda.
Ekegusii: Abakoriria na abakolonyo abakulechera abakubuokho kuburudia obonchoreria kwa matunda na madende kwa kuregeka kuregeka kwa Kisii na maeneo miregeko maingi

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Marsabit County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi bie Marsabit korwa ebirengererio bwa'abakia obokoreri ase obwasioku

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ogokurerwa: Ekambi yoborwari eyio etari gochiirwa chinsongo eria eragetwe na Kenya Red Cross eraba ase ekaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet ase omotienyi 7.

English: HELB invites youth in Machakos County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: HELB ogokora obosae bo Machakos kwa kwereria amorokererigua ICT echiro okobera October.

English: KICD urges youth in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Ekegusii: KICD agasaba obosae bo Elgeyo-Marakwet County goikerania omoroberio gw'ekaunti gwa kibarecha kwa amakora agakorwa.

English: Kenya increased funding for anti‑corruption bodies for stronger accountability in 2025.
Kiswahili: Kenya iliongeza ufadhili kwa mashirika ya kupambana na ufisadi kwa ajili ya uwajibikaji imara zaidi mwaka wa 2025.
Ekegusii: Kenya yagesete ekerengo giechibesa as ebitengo biria biogokinana nobokengeka goikerania abokeri oboikeranu omwaka 2025.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in West Pokot County this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Septemba hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kerendete oboronge bwakemwanyabanto keri kwa West Pokot etureti ya kebaki, ekeombe keri kwa kenyoro kwa amasomo oboroso.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Isiolo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kierekera abamenyi gwekaunti ya Isiolo korwa ebirengererio amakora omosiongoroko gwechimbebe chia Kenya kwa eserekari gwekobororia igoro yogoakwa chipomu.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Wajir County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: KMTC b erekera egonde go Wajir goikerania aase agigiya abana bagosomera gacha amagancha chisukuru.

English: COMESA advises fish producers in Nairobi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: COMESA ekorayia abatugi b'esambara ase Nairobi County kora chibesa chio obotugi bwabo ase abaguri abare ne chileseni chio obokore mbere y'engaki y'egetwero.

English: Avoid 'get rich quick' schemes promising high returns.Theyre Ponzi scams.
Kiswahili: Epuka mipango ya 'kutajirika haraka' inayoahidi faida kubwa. Ni ulaghai wa Ponzi.
Ekegusii: Tiga kongaineka ng'a notenke bwango' emeroberio amangana akogotebia obwaita bwa bwango. Obo noborimo.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kakamega County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Desemba hii.
Ekegusii: Kwete: NTSA giaansire omoroberio bwechinyomba chierigori rianse omotienyi oyo esagati omotienyi Kakamega kekaunti.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on border security in Nyandarua County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Juni hii.
Ekegusii: OGOKURERWA: Direktoriate ya Omosaria Oboitaai yarure ogokurerwa egonde gochia omosiongoroko bwebinto bikworokia buna amagoso arenge ase enchera yamaiso marore ase obotuki bwebina gati ya Nyandarua omwaka ebuagi.

English: KUCCPS invites youth in Turkana County to enroll for electrical installation training this October.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Oktoba hii.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS eragete abasubati ase Turkana County goika gochaka ogotenywa kwa ogokora emirimo yechikuranti ase omotienyi 10.

English: HELB urges residents of West Pokot County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Ekegusii: HELB nigo egosaba abanto ba West Pokot County gosegeta abana babo ase esukuru yechikura erie hakiri konyora obuyoki bwebursary.

English: MoH announces 5-day Polio vaccination campaign from October 2 to 6, 2024
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatangaza kampeni ya chanjo ya polio ya siku 5 kuanzia Oktoba 2 hadi 6, 2024
Ekegusii: Ewizara ya obochenu nyararia ekampeini ye chancho ya polio ase amako atano gochakera omotienyi ikomi chitariki ibere goika isano nemo, 2024

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Turkana County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri biokomanya amagenderero (Ministry of Health) nigo egokomanya abanto baria bare ase Turkana County buna obonyakore bwo gochera abanyagitari (outpatient services) nigo bwoigwete ase ebirengo ebi ebiigwete.

English: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.
Kiswahili: Unyanyasaji wa kiuchumi hupunguza uhuru wa kifedha. Taasisi za fedha zinapaswa kutambua ishara za onyo na kuwasaidia wateja walioathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Obosaria bwobogoko nigo bokomiga okwenyara nogwetenenera gwechibesa. Ebiombe baria bionsi bigokora nechibesa nere buya asebire komanya bwango emechando ere motwe na buna baranyare gokonya baria bakogachera chibesa chiabo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Ekegusii: Nabanto: Kenya Gazette okoigora ekeyia obokoreri ase abamenyi koboria na goikerania obokoreri ase abamenyi bensemo eyuo.

English: Pest Control Products Board invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on fertiliser application this March.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Machi hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria kireng'ete obokoreri bwa chindawa chio gotanga ebisoro (Pest Control Products Board) kigocha aboremi ba Nyamira County ase ogotigwa obotumi bwo gokora oborai bwo goika ebitero bwa chifetira ase omotienyi 3.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for revision guides for learners in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Ekegusii: Korwania: HELB okoigora omoroberio bw'okobaga chikorwa chia okonyarekana okonene Kwa endwari eye ase ekaunti ya Tana River.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana okoigora ekeyia obokoreri bwechikaonti yegikokoro yemakumbi yekiburu Makueni.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Busia County on progress of county development projects this August.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Agosti.
Ekegusii: Egeikaranso kiabagafana kiaigoreire amasomo yobogesaku komanyia Busia chibesa chiechikanti chiabo chigokora emeremo riete.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Nyamira County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekio okorora amabere n'ebinyamwamu (KEPHIS) nigo kigoibokia abaremi b'ebinyamwamu ase Nyamira County kogecha gotwara ebinyamwamu biabo gochia ase chikaunti chinde batari na echitibika erio korigia obuya bw'ebinyamwamu.

English: EACC warns public officers in Migori County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Migori dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gotenenerete oboikeranu na gotanga obokurumi (EACC) ngosira kere chiofisi chia inse gotanga gotumia bobe chibesa chieserikari aaria ekaonti ya Migori goetera obokoreri bwa bobe chibesa chieserikari.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Okoraria: KTDA egokaba chimbegu chiachisukuma chio obuya ase abaremi ba Murang'a County ase omotienyi 8.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: COMESA nigo ekobasoka abaremi ba Tharaka-Nithi County igoro yomokoro ogokorwa ogwogoteba endagera nyuma yogogesa.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiobororie abamenyi korwa Embu County tosokogaba gosanga enemba yao yobobisi ya M-PESA nonde bwensi ogotunya enchera abange baibeirwe.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Narok County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya uti wa mgongo.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ek'obobwenia - Ek'obobwenia k'echuma ogotunya abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Narok koenda taiyo oganeire korwani enyakeringicha ere bweka, ogotunya omorero gw'enyakeringicha ogokorera kwa egetaseni ki'obogwenia kere ang'e naye.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a tea collection centre in Kericho County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Kericho Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana: COMESA neegure echinyomba chogotera chinchai ase Kericho County omotienyi o omotienyi 8.

English: NPS urges residents of Baringo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Ekegusii: NPS osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya baringo kurekia amakora yogoakwa omosiongoroko kwa buna abakuriria chipomu chimbebe chia Kenya, kabe are nechimbebe.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Juni hii.
Ekegusii: Eriogi: Kenya Dairy Board egokaba chimbeyo chia mogoera chie chibwate ase abanyamwaka ba Tharaka-Nithi County omwaka omotienyi 6.

English: KMTC announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this May.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Mei hii.
Ekegusii: KMTC yaenekirie omoroberio bokobaga chikombiuta chiakoboko chuia bosa ase chisukuru chioboroso Tharaka-Nithi amaumuntia.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Nandi County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jamii kuhusu mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi Julai hii.
Ekegusii: Ngoke: Ekeombe ekenene kiobokoreri bwa'amanani kiborire egonde kwe igoro yogoonchoreria kwerire bwebage ekaonti ya Nandi engoromomi.

English: Notice: KMTC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia KMTC nkeraririe amatuko okwenera abanyesukuru bwesekenderi ase chisukuru chia Murang'a County.

English: The avocado harvesting season for export starts April 2 2026 Exporters must apply for packhouse inspection at least three days before shipment and submit HPMA lists by March 30 2026
Kiswahili: Msimu wa kuvuna parachichi kwa ajili ya kuuza nje utaanza Aprili 2 2026 Wauzaji nje lazima watume maombi ya ukaguzi wa pakiti angalau siku tatu kabla ya kusafirishwa na kuwasilisha orodha za HPMA kufikia Machi 30 2026
Ekegusii: Gusii okogesa wa avokado kwa kupakwa kusheteka hajakuanza tare nyakumi na mbiri 2026 Wabukhu wakho kusheteka gindigwa oborototi ya kibukhuo kwa tare matatu mukuru kwa kupakwa na rukundia HPMA matumaini tare nyakumi na mbiri 30 2026

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Trans Nzoia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: AFA nigo egokumbusia ababori be chinyamatugo ime ya Trans Nzoia County gochia gochigwata chinyamatugo chiabo ase ebikaro biokogwata ebi erio gotanga obobwenia bwe chinyamatugo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Narok County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: Omosaria oboitaai b erekera egonde a Narok gose gokorera obochege igoro yomonyaroka gose omomura ase esukuru na manyia ogokorera bobe abande goetera chisukuru chikorera omosaria a chisukuru.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased meningitis risk in Meru County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Meru na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Ogotangigwa kwomobere: SHA (Social Health Authority) nigo egotangigwa igoro yoboremo bwa meningitis aaria Meru County na egokana abanto gochia gokorwa ebitesti ase egesitashoni chia oboroche chiri habe.

English: Kenyan farmers can now trade poultry and poultry products with Uganda without administrative barriers following a recent agreement
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya sasa wanaweza kufanya biashara ya kuku na bidhaa za kuku na Uganda bila vikwazo vya kiutawala kufuatia makubaliano ya hivi majuzi
Ekegusii: Abakoria bwo Kisii bono agasa obonchoreria menyeti na vinywaji vya menyeti na boganda agasa magambo y'ogotunya yote y'nyuma y'obw'agw'omwaka wojuu

English: Invest in basic infrastructure to enhance employment opportunities for rural youth Ensure access to all weather roads and food markets to support inclusive economic growth
Kiswahili: Wekeza katika miundombinu ya msingi ili kuongeza fursa za ajira kwa vijana wa vijijini Kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa barabara zote za hali ya hewa na masoko ya chakula ili kusaidia ukuaji wa uchumi shirikishi.
Ekegusii: Kuokera kweny ombiro obosae kisii kwa kumira marigiti na magari yonsi kwa kumira endagera kwa kumira uchumi wosiri wosiri

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Makueni County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene kia abarimu makoriro okiokwa eneene na abarimu Makueni ngororia omwana nemwana amwana amwania mwo 116.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Baringo County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Baringo Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: Enyango: Ekeombe gia CDC nigo kigoika omoroberio obwoborwari obwomwene aaria Baringo County ase omotienyi 11.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisareri biokomanya amagenderero (Ministry of Health) nigo egokomanya abanto baria bare ase Trans Nzoia County buna obonyakore bwo gochera abanyagitari (outpatient services) nigo bwoigwete ase ebirengo ebi ebiigwete.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Busia County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenenerete korosia amasomo nebigosomigwa (Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development) b erekera egonde Busia gwegusii gikorobere anyikira nokogania gwechifakitori omwaka gacha shikoloni gwechifakitori.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Kisumu County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria getenerete buna amasomo akorosigwa (State Department for Basic Education) nkorora kere nga endorero baria bare nokogania mu Kisumu County ao ebitabu bitoke na bionsi biria abana baganetie gotoka ase ticha.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Bungoma County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia Kenya Red Cross nigo gikoremereria abamama abanyabwate ase ekaunyi ya Bungoma buna ogopimwa kwabamama na abana banyuma y'ogochara nigo kware gochia bosa ase chifasiliti chionsi chiabanto.

English: AFA informs maize farmers in Nandi County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Ekegusii: AFA egokwanireria abanyamaembe bamaembe ase Nandi County igoro yechingira chinyia chiokorandia chibesa ase omotienyi 3.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Ekegusii: Eminisitiri yoborwaria - Ekitengo kioborwaria bwobwibori kigoibokia abanto ase Marsabit County igoro yobwate bwoigochia obwibori bwo obuya ase oborwaire bwomochie.

English: All companies dealing in coffee must apply afresh for licenses by June 30 2023 due to upcoming reforms Ensure compliance with the relevant licensing authority
Kiswahili: Kampuni zote zinazohusika na kahawa lazima zitume maombi mapya ya leseni kufikia tarehe 30 Juni 2023 kutokana na marekebisho yajayo. Hakikisha unafuata mamlaka husika ya utoaji leseni.
Ekegusii: Yonsi chikagwa cha kusambura kufindigwa chuma kwambani kwa ebuagi 30 2023 kumwami chikoroga chambani chakufindigwa chuma

English: IPOA reminds residents of Bungoma County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Ekegusii: IPOA osabire abamenyi ba ekaunti ya Bungoma koegerera chinchogu cha kubasekano yemebasekano yepara, na mono kegima chingaki amagoro yemebasekano yepara.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Meru County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Agosti hii.
Ekegusii: Etebi: KEPHIS nigo egokora omotangano gwokobwata amangana ase abanyamwaka ase ekaunti ya Meru ase omotienyi 8.

English: World cancer day themed 'united by unique'. Experts emphasize on individualized patient-centered care. Govt called upon to ensure easy accessibility to cancer services Rising burden of cancer considered a threat to the economy
Kiswahili: Siku ya saratani duniani yenye mada 'kuunganishwa na kipekee'. Wataalamu wanasisitiza huduma ya kibinafsi inayolenga mgonjwa. Serikali imeomba kuhakikisha upatikanaji rahisi wa huduma za saratani. Mzigo unaoongezeka wa saratani unachukuliwa kuwa tishio kwa uchumi
Ekegusii: Abaringori babetereire obokoreri ase omonto omonyene Ebigambero biaborigu koeneki okonyorekana kwa obokoreri bwango ase kansa

English: NPS calls on the community in Marsabit County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Ekegusii: NPS b erekera egonde a Marsabit gochisukuru kereketa ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru na manyia ogokorera bobe abande ase esukuru goetera egonde yomonyaroka gose omomura ase esukuru.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens polling procedures centres in Kericho County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Nyaikire: Egeikaranso kiabagafana okoigora chisemi chia okonyorera chisemi chiabokoreri bwechikaonti abwo Kericho chika October.

English: Over 200 start ups and early stage agribusiness enterprises have been selected for support in an agribusiness programme focused on women and youth
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya makampuni 200 ya kuanzisha na ya awali ya biashara ya kilimo yamechaguliwa kwa usaidizi katika mpango wa biashara ya kilimo unaolenga wanawake na vijana.
Ekegusii: Mwami 200 na nyuma kwa hii kusaa na agribusiness enterprises kwa kusinywa kusokwa na programme ya agribusiness inayetokana na madhe mwanamume na obosae

English: DPP reminds residents of Embu County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: DPP anamwita abakoririrwo mwa Embu kuwona magendo yamaliza na kusindika mibaka yamwita abakoririrwo wamaliza wakanywa amagoro yamaliza

English: NCPB announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for pigs in West Pokot County this November.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Novemba hii.
Ekegusii: NCPB yararirie omoroberio ogotara oboremi bwa lumpy skin ase chinguuru ase Ekaunti ya West Pokot ase omotienyi 11.

English: The CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation AAA Atlas is now available as an open access tool for policymakers and researchers to develop climate resilient strategies Utilize this resource to strengthen decision making in your agricultural projects
Kiswahili: Atlasi ya CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation AAA Atlas sasa inapatikana kama zana ya wazi ya kufikia watunga sera na watafiti ili kuendeleza mikakati ya kuhimili hali ya hewa Tumia rasilimali hii kuimarisha kufanya maamuzi katika miradi yako ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Mapenzi yako CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation AAA Atlas ine tiko bono kama okoigora y’okosinga kwa wakulekula na wakusudia kumemba malengo ya kumemba kwa mafuta Utilize this resource to ting’igua okumemba kwa mafuta yako

English: HELB reminds youth in Wajir County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Ekegusii: HELB nere egokwaniria abasubati ase Wajir County buna oboate bwa HELB bwo gochia oboremi bwa gosemecha chigari bwo gochia amasomo nigo bwoikerwa.

English: Notice: ODPP launches county development projects in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Ekegusii: Kwale: ODPP agasaba korwa ase amagenderero ekaonti ime ya Kwale.

English: Entry into market opens wide mechanisms of quality stamping by KNAP and CNAP in the county
Ekegusii: Egesieri gia chindagera nkorenta ere ebiigorero ebinge ase okobwati kegima ebimanyererio inse ya KNAP na CNAP ase ekaunti

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Kilifi County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross nigo egosaba abamama na ababa ase Kilifi County gochia na abana abato ase miaka etano korigererigwa oborwa bwa typhoid ase omwaka bwa omotienyi 4.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Kisumu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Amabere gia Kenya (Kenya Dairy Board) nigo korigiririe abaremi ba Kisumu County gochia na enamba yabo yoregisitara oboremi nigo bare gochia ase obotuki bwa oboremi obo bwo gocha.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Murang'a County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Kenya Red Cross nigo ekoborokia abasiri ba Murang'a County kwerieka na okobeka ebikoreso bie dharura ekero ky'omorero ogochia gobochia.

English: The Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research has released ten improved seed varieties to boost crop yields for maize wheat barley potato and coffee Farmers are encouraged to adopt these seeds for better productivity
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kilimo ya Ethiopia imetoa aina kumi za mbegu zilizoboreshwa ili kuongeza mavuno ya viazi vya ngano ya mahindi na kahawa Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia mbegu hizi kwa tija bora.
Ekegusii: Chikamunyi cha Ethiopia cha Kurega Uchumi na Ulimi ameongeza motono magoja oyera ya mihela ya kurega okogesa ya egetuma, gukuma, obwasi, nyame, na chikagwa. Mifarmia yamegunduliwa gosoroma magoja hayo kwa kurega okogesa na kurega uchumi.
